Description:
Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.

Description:
Greetings from Wipro
We are pleased to share an exciting opportunity for the ASIC RTL Architect role at Wipro. Please find the role details below and share your updated resume at swetha.janardhan@wipro.com
Role Details
Requirement Name : ASIC RTL Architect
Experience:15 Years +
Work location : Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Kochi / Chennai / Any Location
Work Mode : Hybrid
Job Type: Full-Time with Wipro

JD
What You Bring:
15+ years in RTL design and integration, with multiple tape-outs in a lead or architect role.
Expert Verilog / SystemVerilog and strong micro-architecture skills.
Deep experience with AMBA (AXI/AHB/APB), NoC and high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB.
Solid grasp of low-power design (UPF), clocking, CDC/RDC and timing-driven RTL.
Proficiency with front-end tools: lint, CDC, synthesis, STA; scripting in Python, Perl or Tcl.
Clear technical communication with customers and cross-functional teams.

What You Will Do:
Define micro-architecture, block partitioning and interface specifications from system requirements.
Own PPA trade-offs and RTL quality: lint, CDC/RDC, synthesis and constraints (SDC, UPF).
Lead subsystem and SoC integration, and drive design and code reviews.
Partner with DV, DFT and PD to close verification, testability, timing and power.
Mentor and technically guide RTL teams; act as the escalation point for design issues.
Support emulation, FPGA prototyping, silicon bring-up and root-cause analysis.

Good to Have :
ARM or RISC-V subsystem integration
Die-to-die / UCIe and chiplet architectures
Post-silicon debug experience

Description:
Greetings from Wipro
We are pleased to share an exciting opportunity for the DFT Architect role at Wipro.
Please find the role details below and share your updated resume at swetha.janardhan@wipro.com Role Details
Requirement Name : DFT Architect
Experience:15 Years +
Work location : Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Kochi / Chennai / Any Location
Work Mode : Hybrid
Job Type: Full-Time with Wipro
JD
Define DFT architecture and test strategy for complex SoCs, and own scan, MBIST, ATPG and pattern delivery from design through silicon bring-up.
What You Bring(Mandatory):
15+ years in DFT with multiple SoC tape-outs and silicon bring-up.
Expert in scan, ATPG, MBIST, at-speed test and hierarchical DFT methodologies.
Hands-on with Synopsys (DFTMAX / TestMAX), Siemens Tessent or Cadence Modus flows.
Strong with IEEE 1149.1, 1500 and 1687 standards.
Working knowledge of STA, synthesis and ATE test flows.
Scripting in Tcl, Python or Perl.

Plan and implement hierarchical DFT for full-chip and block-level designs.
Own ATPG, fault-coverage targets, and pattern verification (zero-delay and SDF).

Description:
EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

Educational Criteria : Must be a Qualified CA - Fresher or Upto 1 yr exp.

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

Ideally, you’ll also have
Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Role Overview
The role involves developing and maintaining relationships with leading architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients, including HNI and UHNI customers.

This is a relationship-driven business development role, rather than a conventional field sales position. The selected candidates will represent a premium brand, identify high-value projects, develop market connections, coordinate client visits, and nurture business opportunities through to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Identify and develop business opportunities in luxury residential projects, villas, hospitality, and premium commercial interiors.
Conduct regular market visits to architect studios, design firms, project sites, and client locations.
Promote MCI's premium collections of natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, and surface solutions.
Generate leads through networking, market mapping, referrals, industry contacts, and architect/designer databases.
Understand project requirements and coordinate with architects and designers to recommend suitable products.
Arrange and coordinate visits to MCI's Experience Centre for architects, designers, and prospective clients, wherever applicable.
Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospects and project stakeholders to convert opportunities into business.
Track enquiries, quotations, samples, project requirements, and lead conversion status.
Develop and maintain an updated database of architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium customers.
Support the development of the assigned market and achievement of business targets.
Maintain disciplined daily and weekly activity reports, lead updates, and follow-up records.
Represent MCI professionally at client meetings, exhibitions, industry events, and design-related networking activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, upcoming projects, and emerging business opportunities.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
Natural stone, marble, granite, and imported stone
Premium tiles, sanitaryware, and surface materials
Luxury furniture, modular kitchens, and premium interiors
Architectural products, high-end lighting, and home automation
Luxury real estate, project sales, and premium construction materials
Other premium product segments involving regular interaction with architects, interior designers, builders, and developers

Experience in natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, or premium surface materials will be an added advantage.
Freshers are also welcome if they demonstrate strong communication skills, confidence, professionalism, a willingness to learn, and an interest in architecture and luxury interiors.

Required Skills & Qualities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Confident, energetic, well-groomed, and professionally presentable.
Strong relationship-building, networking, and negotiation skills.
Genuine interest in luxury interiors, architecture, and premium products.
Ability to engage effectively with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Proactive, self-motivated, and target-oriented approach.
Strong follow-up, lead-management, and reporting discipline.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and travel within the assigned market.
Knowledge of the local market and established industry contacts will be an advantage.
Fluency in English and the relevant local language is essential. Hindi proficiency will be an added advantage.

Salary Range:
- Freshers: 20,000 30,000 per month
- Experienced candidates: 25,000 40,000 per month
Final compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, communication skills, market exposure, relevant industry knowledge, and overall suitability for the role

Interested Candidates
Candidates who are passionate about premium products, relationship management, and business development in the luxury architecture and interior-design segment are encouraged to apply.

Job Summary
We are seeking a senior UX leader who guides delivery, supports pursuits, maintains project-level client relationships mentors teams through selective hands-on design work. The role involves leading end-to-end UX initiatives, defining user-centric design strategies, collaborating with product and engineering teams, and ensuring user-centric design solutions that deliver business value. The ideal candidate will combine strong design leadership with strategic thinking, business acumen, and a deep understanding of user research and design best practices.
Roles and Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end UX initiatives, guiding teams through research, discovery, ideation, design, prototyping, testing, and implementation.
Translate customer insights, business requirements, and complex challenges into intuitive, impactful, and user-centered experiences.
Define and drive the UX vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with user needs and organizational objectives.
Establish and govern UX standards, design systems, frameworks, and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, accessibility, and design excellence.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Business, and leadership stakeholders to align UX solutions with project and organizational goals.
Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and stakeholder discussions to drive innovation, alignment, and informed decision-making.
Present UX strategies, research findings, design concepts, and recommendations to senior leadership and project stakeholders.
Drive data-informed design decisions through user research, usability testing, analytics, and performance insights.
Guide UX planning, prioritization, and coordination across initiatives to support effective and successful delivery.
Build and maintain trusted working relationships with client and internal stakeholders within assigned projects.
Participate in discovery discussions, solution workshops, and pursuit activities to help define user-centered approaches for prospective engagements.
Provide selective hands-on design leadership for complex user journeys, workshops, prototypes, and critical design challenges, while mentoring teams and maintaining design quality.
Lead, mentor, and develop UX designers, researchers, and design leads, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
Contribute UX expertise to shape compelling experience strategies and delivery approaches for new opportunities.
Lead UX transformation and design maturity initiatives, leveraging emerging trends, tools, and technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
Support digital transformation initiatives through customer-centric and research-driven design approaches.



Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
15+ years of experience in UX/UI Design, Product Design, Service Design, or Experience Design, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Strong expertise in Human-Centered Design (HCD), Design Thinking, and user-centered design principles.
Proficiency in UX design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Axure, InVision, or similar platforms.
Proven ability to shape UX solutions for new opportunities by defining approaches, delivery models, resource requirements, and experience strategies.
Extensive experience in user research, usability testing, customer journey mapping, information architecture, interaction design, and data-informed design practices.
Experience leading the creation, implementation, and governance of enterprise design systems.
Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance development, and capability building.
Strong portfolio showcasing expertise in UX strategy, interaction design, problem-solving, and visual storytelling.
Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Lean UX, and product development environments with cross-functional teams.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with clients and stakeholders within project engagements, building trusted relationships and driving alignment.
Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
Ability to leverage user insights, analytics, and UX metrics to drive data-informed design decisions.

Hands-on Interaction Design and Prototyping

Description:
Respond to any questions from guests and follow up with guests to ensure their requests have been met to their satisfaction.
Take and confirm reservations and cancellations.
Supply guests with information regarding property amenities, services, room features, and local areas of interest and activities.
Respond to guest requests for special arrangements or services (eg, spa services, transportation, religious services, babysitting, ficial services, business center services, interpretation services, reservations, dry cleaning, entertainment/sporting events, shopping) by making arrangements or identifying appropriate providers.
Contact appropriate individual or department as necessary to resolve guest requests.
Collaborate with management to develop and carry-out ideas and procedures and set goals to continuously improve department performance.
Assign and ensure work tasks are completed on time and that they meet appropriate quality standards.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Associate Agency Development Manager is responsible for driving business growth through the recruitment, development, and management of a team of insurance agents. - Collaborate with management to align team goals with organizational objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements in the insurance sector.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

Title: Manager - Test Automation 2
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, agile, aiapisapplication architecturearchitectureautomated testingautomationautomation solutionsci/cd pipelinescloudcloud platformscloud technologiescompliancecomponent testingcontinuous deliverycontinuous integration, About company, About Accenture
Description:
Management Level: Level 7 Manager
Location: Kochi
Must have skills: Quality Assurance (QA) Strategy/Automation Architecture/AI Transformation
Good to have skills: Experience in Digital Commerce
Experience: 13 - 15 years of experience in Testing
Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Manager-Test Automation with 13-15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI-enabled testing. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large-scale customer-facing platforms is highly desirable.
Roles and Responsibilities
Define and lead enterprise and programme-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
Design scalable, maintainable, and fit-for-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end-to-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
Define and implement CI/CD-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end-to-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift-left, continuous testing, and engineering-led quality practices.
Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.
Act as a trusted Quality Assurance advisor to senior stakeholders and clients, providing technical direction, influencing technology and delivery decisions, communicating risks and recommendations, and aligning QA outcomes with broader business objectives.



Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Extensive experience defining and executing Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering strategies, driving testing transformation initiatives, and establishing Testing Centres of Excellence (TCoE) across enterprise programmes.
Proven expertise in Test Automation Strategy, Architecture, and Framework Design, with the ability to build scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation solutions across web, mobile, API, and cloud-based applications selecting appropriate technologies based on application architecture, business risk, scalability, maintainability, and delivery requirements.
Strong technical leadership in modern Quality Engineering practices, including automation-first approaches, shift-left and shift-right testing, test optimisation, and continuous quality improvement.
Demonstrated success in managing and growing a Testing Practice, including capability development, competency building, resource planning, governance, offshore delivery management, and mentoring of QA and automation teams.
Strong hands-on experience across API, Contract, Component, Integration, End-to-End, and Performance Testing, with a thorough understanding of modern testing strategies and the appropriate balance across test levels based on architecture, risk, and delivery requirements.
Strong practical experience in Performance Testing, including workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability and capacity assessment, performance regression, and optimisation. Demonstrated ability to analyse and correlate application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify bottlenecks, resource constraints, and scalability limitations and provide actionable engineering recommendations.
Strong practical experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery models, with the ability to design continuous testing strategies and address real-world challenges including test reliability, execution time, environment dependencies, test data, parallelisation, selective execution, pipeline stability, quality gates, and feedback optimisation.
Experience with test execution optimisation practices such as risk-based test selection, test impact analysis, parallel execution, test tagging, mocking, test-data management, environment strategy, and automation maintenance.
Strong understanding and practical experience of cloud technologies and cloud-native architectures, including validation of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, serverless architectures, and modern cloud platforms. Strong knowledge of containerisation technologies such as Docker and their application in test environment management and scalable automation execution.
Proven experience in RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning including proposal development, QA solution design, effort estimation, resource planning, costing, technical presentations, client workshops, and solution defence. Ability to translate client requirements into competitive, practical QE solutions covering strategy, automation architecture, CI/CD, performance, delivery model, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated experience adopting AI and GenAI for Software Testing and Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on identifying practical, high-value use cases that improve automation productivity, coverage, execution efficiency, maintenance, defect detection, and engineering effectiveness.
Mandatory hands-on experience with AI-assisted, Agentic, or MCP-based Testing including evaluating, designing, building, or implementing AI agents and frameworks for test generation, automation code generation, test execution, test maintenance, intelligent test selection, failure analysis, and test-result interpretation. Ability to establish responsible AI adoption by evaluating solutions against criteria of accuracy, reliability, maintainability, security, governance, and appropriate human oversight.
Ability to define and drive enterprise-wide automation roadmaps, technology adoption strategies, and testing innovation initiatives including AI and agentic testing aligned with organisational objectives and measurable business outcomes.
Experience establishing quality governance frameworks, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures to provide leadership visibility into quality, delivery performance, and engineering outcomes.
Extensive experience in client engagement, stakeholder management, and executive communication with the ability to influence decision-making, manage expectations, and build long-term client relationships across business, technology, architecture, development, DevOps, and delivery stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead large, distributed, and cross-functional testing teams, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence.
Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, Shift-Left, Shift-Right, and Continuous Testing practices, with experience embedding quality throughout the software development lifecycle
Additional Information
Good to have experience in:
Programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, and Python, and test automation frameworks including Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent UI automation technologies.
Performance testing and workload modelling using tools such as Gatling, along with practical experience in API, component, and contract testing.
Implementing CI/CD and DevOps practices using platforms such as Jenkins, GitLab, and GitHub, with a strong understanding of continuous testing and pipeline automation.
Cloud technologies, cloud-native architectures, microservices-based applications, containers, and Docker, including testing strategies for distributed systems.
Monitoring and observability solutions such as Grafana, New Relic, and Site24x7 to support performance analysis, quality monitoring, and production readiness.
Knowledge of accessibility and web quality engineering tools, including Google Lighthouse, to drive quality, usability, and compliance across digital platforms.

Description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life

This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
Partner with key implant centers to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

Required Knowledge and Experience:
High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
OR Associate s Degree AND 6+ years experience
OR Bachelor s Degree AND 4+ years experience

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
Masters degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses.

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com .

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Job Title - Pricing & CPQ - Analyst - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 11 - Analyst
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad
Must have skills:PROS Smart Price Optimization

Good to have skills:Pricing Tools
Experience:2-3 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote-to-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams-sales, finance, product, and IT-to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client-s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis & Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best-in-class KPIs
Work as an integral part of the client-s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing & CPQ area.
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
2-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications & High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization & Management (POM) & Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Knowledge of other Pricing & CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

Additional Information
Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management
PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Job Description

About the Role:

We are looking for an energetic, persuasive, and empathetic Senior Academic Counsellor to guide prospective students toward suitable courses and educational pathways. In this role, you will interact with students and parents, understand their career goals, recommend tailored learning solutions, and assist them through the enrollment process.
Key Responsibilities:

Student Guidance: Conduct telephonic, online, or face-to-face counselling sessions with prospective students and parents to understand their career goals and educational requirements.

Lead Management: Handle warm leads provided by marketing and perform timely follow-ups via phone calls, WhatsApp, and emails.

Program Pitching: Explain course structures, curriculum, certification details, fee structures, and career outcomes clearly to potential candidates.

Admissions & Conversions: Drive course enrollments and meet individual and team monthly targets.

CRM Management: Maintain accurate student records, track lead statuses, and update log details regularly in the company CRM.

Relationship Building: Build trust and strong rapport with students to provide ongoing assistance throughout their admission process.

Desired Candidate Profile

Qualification: Any Graduate / Postgraduate degree (Education, Psychology, Business Administration, or related fields preferred).

Experience: 0 to 5 years in EdTech, admissions counselling, tele-calling, or inside sales.

Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication in Malayalam and English

Skills: Excellent active listening, active persuasion, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.

Target-Oriented: Proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable working towards monthly targets.

Tech-Savvy: Basic knowledge of MS Excel, and online communication platforms.
Perks & Benefits

Uncapped attractive performance incentives
Structured career progression & promotion path
Paid leaves and health coverage
Friendly and supportive work culture
Competitive salary

Description:
EY- Assurance Assistant Manager
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity
We’re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills. GDS Assistant Manager’s, would have Associate level or Senior level personnel to work with at GDS and get the tasks executed from them along with performing a review as an Assistant Manager  , which is defined by the Global client serving assurance teams.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures, and ensure these are embedded in to the engagement team’s work.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training.
Ability to Lead by example.

Skills and attributes for success
Expert Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Ability to confidently lead conversations and discussions with key stakeholders
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Robust logical and reasoning skills.
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have
Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / ACCA / CPA
1-5 years post-qualification experience with either
a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews
b) MNC or larger domestic Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
     Environment.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Proficiency in MS – MS office and Outlook.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Develop and execute category growth strategies aligned with overall business objectives.
Drive revenue, margin, and market share growth for assigned jewellery categories.
Analyze market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
Define category roadmap, product mix, and expansion plans.
Curate and optimize online assortment across gold, diamond, platinum, gemstone, and fashion jewellery categories.
Ensure the right product mix based on customer demand and seasonal trends.
Manage product lifecycle from launch to discontinuation.
Coordinate with buying and merchandising teams for new launches and exclusive collections.
Own category performance across website, mobile app, marketplaces, and omni-channel touchpoints.
Collaborate with retail stores to ensure seamless omnichannel experience including Click & Collect, Endless Aisle, and Store Fulfilment.
Drive online merchandising, product visibility, and conversion optimization.
Ensure inventory availability across channels.
Define pricing strategies while maintaining profitability.
Plan promotional calendars, festive campaigns, and category-specific offers.
Analyze promotion effectiveness and optimize future campaigns.
Monitor stock levels and inventory turnover.
Work closely with planning and supply chain teams to minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
Forecast category demand and ensure inventory availability during peak seasons.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Marketing, Retail Operations, Product, Technology, and Supply Chain teams.
Manage relationships with jewellery vendors and suppliers.
Negotiate commercial terms and drive joint business planning initiatives.
Improve customer journey across digital and physical touchpoints.
Monitor customer feedback, reviews, and category performance metrics.
Drive initiatives to enhance customer engagement and conversion.

Responsibilities
A day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

Service line - Position Title: Resource Management Associate
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
We’re looking for candidates with knowledge and capability in terms of managing resources /
manpower using different resource management and deployment tools within EY GDS.
You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Timely updation of resource schedules on scheduling tools (Retain/Profinda)
Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
Proactive review of resource availability /resource requirements.
Mailbox management and fulfilling the scheduling requests coming through emails in defined TAT.
Optimization of resource utilization through effective schedule management.
Reporting and analysis – Resource availability, utilization, forecasting reports etc
Skills and attributes for success:
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Advance knowledge of MS Excel.
Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Professionals with 0-3 years of relevant resource management/workforce management/exposure in General Operations with strong acumen in resource management preferred.
Ideally, you’ll also:
Advance knowledge of MS – Excel Ms - Office. Interest in business and commerciality.
Power BI Basics
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job Title: Technology Sourcing Manager
Function: Supply Chain Services
Sub-Function: Global Procurement
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
The purpose of the global EY organization is to Build a Better Working World. The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS), is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS’s value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain.
A key component of SCS is Global Procurement, whose purpose is to drive significant synergies and value creation from sourcing to contract lifecycle management, deliver exceptional client experiences and build more vital collaboration to manage Technology, Talent, Alliances and Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) categories. We forge meaningful supplier relationships and strengthen supplier resilience to help EY maximize long-term value for its people, clients and communities.
Technology Sourcing is part of Global Procurement focusing on the requirements from the Technology team and managing circa $2.3B of spend annually. The Technology Sourcing team supports infrastructure and services at a global enterprise scale and supports key programs and solutions globally in partnership with our EYT colleagues in order to continue to enhance EY’s position as a technology driven industry leader.
Why this role matters
Global Procurement drives synergy from sourcing through contract lifecycle management, strengthens supplier resilience and delivers exceptional internal client experience across Technology, Talent, Alliances and BMC categories.
Your key responsibilities
The Technology Sourcing Assistant Director reports into a Technology Sourcing Leader within the Technology Sourcing team and is responsible for sourcing strategy and execution, customer engagement and experience, and vendor management in line with the Global Procurement Policy and processes.
The role of the Technology Sourcing Assistant Director may include:
Responsibility as a senior individual contributor on an Enterprise Technology Sourcing team, aligned to one or more technology categories.
Act as an individual contributor and trusted business advisor - managing multiple complex transactions directly or indirectly and working closely with senior stakeholders to deliver successful results.
Working closely with risk management business partners to minimize contractual risks to the firm whilst demonstrating year on year improvement in value for money.
Partnering with GCO (legal) to lead key negotiations and reporting on the quantitative and brand value delivered.
Effectively build a pipeline of deals and develop the appropriate resourcing plans.
Supporting improvement in processes, policy, systems, management information and reporting.
Successfully leading negotiations for global and regional deals meeting the timelines, scope, and requirements agreed with key stakeholders.
Working with senior EYT and Service Line stakeholders to help develop a category strategy which supports the overall global technology strategy.
Supporting the broader Technology Sourcing team in the delivery and management of procurement activities may include the following activities:
Manage full lifecycle of contracts for assigned programs of work and key suppliers
Pro-actively manage contract and license renewals
Build and foster collaborative working relationships with EYT and other internal business partners
Supporting and leading stakeholders through the Onboarding of Technology Goods and Services end- to-end process.
Socialization and facilitation of the Technology Sourcing policy and processes, ensuring that the project team and stakeholders understand the value of the policy and adhere to it accordingly
Timely and frequent submission of management information, including project status and savings reporting
Support for the Enterprise Technology Sourcing team in developing a strategy which adheres to the overall global technology strategy while supporting local engagements
Facilitation of any needed market research to identify potential suppliers, ensure competitive pricing and terms, etc.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience with senior stakeholder management with the ability to collaboratively co-develop strategies and set and manage expectations.
Extensive experience negotiating contracts related to technology services – ideally including managed services / outsourcing
Heavy experience with negotiating contracts globally.
Experience of managing complex service agreements both from the commercial and service delivery side
Experience of working in a Sourcing/Procurement/Vendor Management team in a complex and global environment
Experience working in an IT role as part of delivering technology solutions is a plus
Strong influencing and networking skills as the organization relies on working in cross functional teams across borders
Good knowledge of technology vendors and new technologies is important to successfully work with the EYT teams
Up to date with all issues in the services space including Outsourcing, Infrastructure as a Service and offshoring / rightshoring
Strong communication skills required; must have the ability communicate in English effectively, transparently, and timely across multiple mediums (email, voice, IM, etc) in a global environment
The ability to independently manage and prioritize workload
Strong organizational skills
Demonstrate a positive attitude and have an appetite for challenge
Provide Exceptional Client Service
To qualify for the role, you must have
Required
Degree educated with:
Minimum of 8 years experience in a strategic sourcing role
Alternatively, technology or business operations experience may be considered in lieu of some of the sourcing experience for the right candidate.
In depth experience negotiating for multiple Service delivery models (Outsourcing, Platform as a Service, Infrastructure as a Service, Software as a Service etc)
Experience of stakeholder management at a senior level in their current or previous role
Ideally, you will also have
Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English.
Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization.
Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently.
Certification Requirements:
CPSM qualification or equivalent desired
What we look for
We are looking for a high-energy individual who embraces change to ensure we continue to strategically deliver world class innovative solutions to the global EY organization in an ever-changing business environment.
You simplify complexity, align diverse stakeholders, and turn business strategy / roadmaps into repeatable delivery and realized benefits.
What we offer
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
