Description:
Your key responsibilities
Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and success measures for assigned BMC technology (Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and enablement of products or capabilities.
Partner with BMC stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, operational pain points, adoption barriers, and opportunities to improve product value.
Translate business priorities into clear product outcomes, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and backlog items that guide delivery teams.
Own backlog prioritization and trade-off decisions, balancing business value, user impact, delivery complexity, risk, dependencies and available capacity.
Work closely with project managers, business analysts, data engineers, Power BI developers, EY Technology and vendors to ensure delivery is aligned to product intent and agreed outcomes.
Lead product discovery, option assessment and stakeholder alignment activity, ensuring decisions are based on strong evidence, clear requirements and realistic delivery considerations.
Monitor product performance, adoption, benefits, feedback and user experience to identify enhancements and inform future roadmap decisions.
Support governance, planning, and leadership reporting by providing clear updates on product priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected value.
Contribute to continuous improvement across BMC Enablement by helping standardize product management practices, roadmap governance, backlog discipline and value measurement.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience working with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer.
Strong product management capability in complex, matrixed organizations, ideally working across business, technology, data and vendor teams.
Strong understanding of customer data platforms (CDPs), audience management, customer profile architecture and marketing activation ecosystems.
Good understanding of marketing, communications, or enterprise technology environments, with the ability to quickly understand user needs, business processes, and platform implications.
Commercial and outcome-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect product decisions to strategic priorities, user value and measurable business impact.
Structured thinker who can turn ambiguity into clear product direction, practical priorities and actionable delivery requirements.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage roadmaps, backlogs, stakeholders and competing priorities without losing sight of outcomes.
Clear communicator who can translate product complexity into concise messages, decisions and recommendations for delivery teams and senior stakeholders.
Confident stakeholder manager with the ability to build trust, challenge constructively, influence without formal authority and keep teams aligned around shared goals.
Solution-focused and resilient, with the persistence to resolve blockers, manage trade-offs and maintain product momentum through ambiguity.
Committed to quality, governance and operational discipline, acting as a dependable point of product ownership across teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Proven experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner or Digital Product Lead supporting Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP/CDP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) or related MarTech platforms.
Experience supporting technology, digital, marketing, communications, transformation, analytics or enablement of products or platforms.
Strong practical skills in roadmap management, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, requirements shaping, user story definition, and value tracking.
Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams, including project managers, business analysts, data, engineering, technology, vendors and/or offshore resources.
Ability to manage competing priorities, make clear product trade-offs, and produce high-quality product artefacts, leadership updates and decision materials.
Experience using agile, product-led or iterative delivery approaches to deliver measurable improvements for users and the business.
Ideally, youll also have
Product management certification or working knowledge of agile, SAFe, Scrum, design thinking, service design or similar delivery approaches.
Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign and related customer experience technologies.
Experience with product discovery, user research, adoption planning, benefits measurement, OKRs, KPIs or product performance reporting.
Experience with marketing technology, content platforms, campaign operations, data products, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities or enterprise workflow tools.
A continuous improvement mindset and confidence proposing practical ways to simplify, standardize and strengthen product management ways of working.
Experience working in a cross-border role or supporting globally distributed teams.
Technologies and Tools
Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
Software or Marketing technology products
MS Office tools (Word, Excel, IE); web/production technologies such as HTML, XML, JavaScript, and CSS
What we look for 
Analytical mind-set and problem-solving capability.
Passionate about new technologies and digital products
Enthusiastic and self-motivated, with the ability to lead projects proactively.
Meticulous attention to detail, with an overall passion for continual improvement.
Innovative and creative, with a logical and methodical approach to problem solving.

Description:
Position: Instructional Designer Senior Associate
Education: Any Graduate
Experience: 4 7 years of relevant experience
The opportunity
This position will support the design of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The instructional designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. In addition, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), learning and performance consultants, developers, deployment teams, and vendors.
Your key responsibilities
Actively participate in Skills Needs Analysis (SNA) conversations leading to the design of learning solutions.
Draft learning objectives that meet EY quality standards
Apply effective learning strategies and design guidelines to ensure the creation of impactful learning materials.
Assist in drafting Learning Solution Plans and contribute to the continuous improvement of learning solutions.
Create comprehensive learning documents (e.g., Storyboards, trainer/participant decks for Physical and Virtual Classroom programs) that contribute to the development of final learning assets.
Maintain strong working relationships with Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), graphic designers, and other stakeholders to produce effective learning solutions.
Review all learning deliverables for content flow, accuracy, language, and adherence to quality standards.
Independently liaise with SMRs for technical reviews and feedback to enhance learning materials.
Conduct quality assurance checks with SMRs, technical reviewers, and deployment teams; utilize their feedback to revise design documents.
Utilize rapid authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, and Articulate Studio to create engaging and interactive learning modules.
Ensure deliverables align with EY design and quality standards related to written materials.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, deployment teams, and other members of the learning team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write effective instructional text, and facilitator materials.
Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment.
Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset.
Proactive in mentoring junior team members and facilitating effective teamwork.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3 to 6 years of experience in designing courses and other learning items.
Experience in designing effective learning solutions across different modalities
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and rapid authoring tools.
Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients.
Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.
What we look for
An experienced instructional designer who can support multiple projects concurrently.
A professional who can quickly problem-solve and can offer perspective on solutions

Description:
Role summary
The Lead AI Process Transformation Engineer leads larger, complex and cross-functional workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation opportunities. The role is the senior process-and-AI engineering anchor for OEE, combining enterprise process transformation, capability and maturity assessment, portfolio leadership, practical solution architecture, hands-on technical credibility, executive influence and coaching.
Role purpose and scope
This role operates within OEEs process-first transformation model. It owns the path from ambiguous enterprise problem to validated current state, redesigned workflow, bounded AI-enabled solution, governance approval, adoption and realized value. The role leads the second AI Process Engineer, supports the AI Builders Network and works across business and technology teams to ensure that technical choices follow process evidence rather than lead it.
Enterprise workflow transformation leadership
Lead complex, cross-functional workflow discovery across people, process, technology, data, policies, controls, systems and organizational boundaries.
Frame ambiguous business challenges into clear outcomes, process boundaries, operating assumptions, measures and decision requirements.
Guide current-state and future-state design using process maps, SIPOCs, value-stream views, service blueprints, decision flows and operating-model views.
Challenge solution-first requests and ensure the sequence Eliminate, Simplify, Standardize, Integrate, then Automate or apply AI is followed.
Define process ownership, roles, decision rights, controls, exception paths, escalation routes, service expectations and management routines.
Review and assure the quality of transformation charters, process designs, value cases, implementation plans and control approaches.
Capability mapping and transformation portfolio leadership
Lead capability-mapping and maturity-assessment activities linking enterprise outcomes to capabilities, workflows, owners, KPIs, systems, data and dependencies.
Build and govern a prioritized pipeline of workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation opportunities.
Assess opportunities using strategic alignment, customer impact, volume, effort, cycle time, quality, risk, controls, data readiness, feasibility, reuse and value potential.
Establish decision gates for discovery, redesign, prototype, pilot, production handoff, scale, remediation and retirement.
Manage dependencies, risks, decisions and capacity across multiple transformation opportunities and technical partners.
Provide concise executive views of portfolio health, value, risks, readiness and decisions required.
AI solution architecture and technical direction
Translate redesigned workflows into AI-enabled solution strategies covering tasks, inputs, outputs, context, knowledge, integrations, controls, human review and operational ownership.
Define solution patterns for agentic workflows, AI assistants, retrieval-based solutions, workflow automation and deterministic controls.
Lead or co-lead proofs of concept and bounded implementations using enterprise-approved platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI capabilities, approved APIs and Python.
Provide technical direction on prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, evaluation and integration patterns.
Determine when bounded low-code or coded implementation is appropriate and when production engineering, architecture or data-platform support is required.
Assure that solution design includes human-in-the-loop decisions, exception handling, fallback, access controls, auditability, supportability and lifecycle ownership.
AI Builders Network and team leadership
Act as the senior process-transformation partner for Principal AI Leads, AI Builders and business leaders on complex or cross-functional opportunities.
Coach the second AI Process Engineer and builders on workflow discovery, process-first solutioning, value measurement, agent design, testing and adoption.
Establish reusable playbooks, templates, prompts, test packs, control patterns and solution assets for enterprise reuse.
Conduct design reviews and provide escalation support where process, technology, risk or ownership choices are unclear.
Build practical process-transformation and AI fluency across OEE and participating business teams.
Value realization, governance and adoption
Own the measurement strategy across baselines, targets, leading indicators, lagging indicators and balancing measures.
Develop and challenge value cases covering financial savings, cost avoidance, capacity release, cycle time, quality, risk, service and customer or associate value.
Ensure forecast and realized value are validated with appropriate business and Finance partners.
Lead governance readiness across Responsible AI, Architecture, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, Accessibility and Records requirements.
Guide adoption, stabilization, operational handover and scale, remediate or retire decisions.
Ensure accountable business owners retain ownership for workflow decisions, adoption and sustained outcomes.
Required qualifications and experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data, Business, Operations or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of relevant experience, including significant leadership across process transformation, business architecture, solution engineering, automation or AI-enabled delivery.
Demonstrated experience independently leading complex cross-functional current-state discovery, future-state redesign and implementation.
Experience in capability mapping, maturity assessment, transformation portfolio prioritization and executive decision support.
Strong practical Lean and process-engineering capability covering process mapping, SIPOC, VSM, waste analysis, root-cause analysis, standard work, controls and benefit measurement.
Hands-on credibility building or co-building AI agents, intelligent workflows, automation prototypes or small digital solutions on enterprise platforms.
Strong working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG, prompt engineering, grounding, orchestration and solution evaluation.
Ability to work with APIs, structured data and scripting; working proficiency in Python or an equivalent language.
Demonstrated ability to coach practitioners, influence senior leaders, challenge solution-first requests and drive outcomes without direct authority.
Excellent executive communication and ability to convert complex evidence into clear choices, trade-offs and decisions.
Preferred qualifications and experience
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, or equivalent advanced process-transformation qualification supported by practical application.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of API integration, JSON, authentication, connectors, data preparation, vector search and enterprise knowledge sources.
Experience leading or supporting an AI Center of Excellence, Builders Network, transformation studio or enterprise automation program.
Experience with Agile delivery, product thinking, service design, organizational change, operating-model design or program management.
Experience in Finance, Operations, Technology, shared services, customer operations or another complex enterprise environment.
Cloud, AI, business architecture, process-improvement or automation certifications.
Expected outcomes
A governed portfolio of high-value workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation opportunities with clear sequencing, owners and decision gates.
Priority capabilities and workflows have validated current states, maturity gaps, baselines, future states, controls and readiness decisions.
Complex opportunities progress from discovery through redesign, bounded solution, governance, adoption and measurable value realization.
AI Builders and the second AI Process Engineer receive effective technical and process-transformation direction.
Reusable process, solution, testing and control patterns are adopted across multiple opportunities.
Leadership receives transparent and decision-ready evidence on value, risk, dependencies, adoption and scale.
What success looks like
Creates clarity and a credible path forward from ambiguous enterprise problems.
Improves the complete workflow and operating mechanism, not merely one automated task.
Balances process rigor, technical feasibility, control requirements, speed and business value.
Can challenge leaders constructively and guide multiple stakeholders toward an evidence-based decision.
Builds team and enterprise capability while personally retaining technical and transformation credibility.
Delivers sustained outcomes and reusable transformation capability.

Description:
EY Assurance Manager (Real Estate Practice)
As part of our EY Assurance Real Estate practice, you will serve as the primary point of contact from GDS for engagements assigned for the Americas regions. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end engagement delivery, including quality, timeliness, stakeholder management, operational oversight, resource planning and team leadership. The role requires working closely with engagement teams and client-serving professionals to deliver high-quality assurance services while driving continuous improvement, digital adoption, risk management and process standardization across a portfolio of Real Estate clients.

The Opportunity
EY's Real Estate Assurance practice serves a broad range of clients across the real estate ecosystem, including real estate investment trusts (REITs), real estate private equity funds, property owners, developers, asset managers and other real estate-related entities. The practice provides exposure to complex accounting, reporting and assurance matters unique to the real estate industry, including property acquisitions and disposals, fair value measurements (level III), leasing, joint ventures, investment funds and capital markets transactions. We're looking for qualified accountants with strong leadership, stakeholder management and project management skills. The incumbent will have an excellent opportunity to work directly with engagement teams across the Americas, develop deep industry knowledge, gain exposure to leading global Real Estate clients and contribute to the growth and transformation of the EY Assurance Real Estate practice.

Your key responsibilities
- Support a portfolio of engagements by leading teams of Associate Managers, Assistant Managers and staffs, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery in line with EY methodology, engagement expectations and quality standards.
- Demonstrate strong technical and methodological expertise through service delivery, pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, hot reviews and other quality initiatives, while proactively identifying and mitigating engagement risks.
- Develop and maintain productive relationships with Assurance executives, Partners and key engagement stakeholders across Americas, acting as a trusted advisor and proactively managing stakeholder expectations.
- Develop a strong understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure compliance requirements are embedded across all engagement activities and team deliverables.
- Work closely with engagement teams to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance, expand GDS scope and identify opportunities for increased participation across audit phases.
- Proactively manage engagement workflow, resource allocation, staffing mix, utilization, budgets, capacity planning and engagement economics, while monitoring performance against established operational goals and KPIs.
- Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clear communication when working with both GDS and engagement teams, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of issues where necessary.
- Establish and continuously reinforce expectations regarding value delivery, service quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction for aligned engagements.
- Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work, increase GDS adoption and support portfolio growth through new wins, centralization and standardization initiatives.
- Drive process improvement, automation, digital adoption and the sharing of leading practices to enhance audit quality, efficiency and consistency across engagements.
- Lead by example, build high-performing teams and create an inclusive culture through effective coaching, delegation, mentorship and career development.
- Conduct timely performance reviews, provide regular feedback, support counselor responsibilities and actively contribute to talent development, retention and succession planning.
- Leverage technology, analytics and EY tools to enhance service delivery, monitor engagement performance and support productivity improvement initiatives.
- Contribute to technical, digital and soft-skills training programs to continuously develop team capabilities and strengthen the overall talent pipeline.

Skills and attributes for success
- Knowledge of US GAAP and International Standards on Auditing (ISA).
- Understanding of Real Estate industry accounting, reporting and assurance requirements.
- Experience with REITs, Real Estate Funds, Property Owners, Developers and Asset Management entities.
- Knowledge of fair value measurements, lease accounting, acquisitions/dispositions and joint venture structures.
- Ability to identify and assess industry-specific risks, controls and financial reporting considerations.
- Strong stakeholder management, project management and team leadership skills.
- Experience leveraging audit technologies, data analytics and digital tools to drive quality and efficiency.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
- Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience.

- Articleship with a Big 4, top-tier or mid-tier accounting firm.
- Experience in external audit and assurance engagements, preferably with exposure to Real Estate, REITs, Private Equity Real Estate Funds, Asset Management or Hospitality clients.
- Experience working on US-based Real Estate engagements and applying US GAAP reporting requirements is preferred.
- Experience managing engagement teams, stakeholder relationships and multiple concurrent audit engagements.
- Experience with audit technology, data analytics and digital audit tools is preferred.
- Experience in either:
a) A Big 4, top-tier or mid-tier accounting firm focused on external audit and assurance engagements.
b) An MNC or large Indian organization, preferably within a Shared Services environment.
c) Big 4 firms serving both Indian and global assurance practices.

Ideally, you'll also have
- Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office and audit technology tools.
- Interest in business, commerciality and industry trends.
- Exposure to Real Estate clients, including REITs, Real Estate Funds, Developers and Property Management entities.
- Understanding of key Real Estate accounting areas such as lease accounting, fair value measurements and investment properties.
- Strong analytical, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to drive process improvements, digital adoption and continuous learning initiatives.

What we look for
- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
- An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
- Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

Description:
Role summary
The Senior AI Process Transformation Engineer provides delivery capacity for workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation. The role combines practical process discovery and redesign with hands-on implementation of bounded agents, intelligent workflows, automation prototypes and small digital solutions, while partnering with the Lead AI Process Transformation Engineer on complex or enterprise-wide opportunities.
Role purpose and scope
This role operates within OEEs process-first transformation model. It moves assigned opportunities from business problem and evidence through current-state discovery, future-state redesign, functional and technical requirements, prototype or small implementation, testing, adoption and value tracking. The role is expected to execute independently within an agreed scope and escalate architecture, risk or enterprise decisions with clear evidence.
Workflow discovery and process redesign
Partner with process owners and subject-matter experts to define the business outcome, customer need, scope, process boundary and measures of success.
Conduct current-state discovery across people, process, technology, data, policies, controls, systems and handoffs.
Create current-state and future-state process maps, SIPOCs, value-stream views, service blueprints and decision flows.
Identify waste, delays, queues, rework, duplicate activity, failure demand, inconsistent rules, control gaps and avoidable variation.
Facilitate focused root-cause analysis using Problem Trees, 5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto and targeted data analysis.
Design future-state workflows using Eliminate, Simplify, Standardize, Integrate, then Automate or apply AI.
Document process owners, roles, controls, exceptions, escalation paths, service expectations and operational measures.
Capability evidence and opportunity assessment
Connect assigned workflows to relevant capabilities, outcomes, owners, KPIs, systems, data and dependencies.
Prepare evidence, workflow inventories and assessment views to support capability mapping and maturity assessment.
Assess opportunities using volume, effort, cycle time, quality, customer impact, risk, data readiness, feasibility and value potential.
Distinguish process problems from technology problems and flag solution requests where ownership, baseline, controls or expected outcomes are unclear.
Create transformation charters, use-case definitions, implementation backlogs, testable value hypotheses and decision packs.
Applied AI solution engineering
Translate redesigned workflows into functional and technical requirements covering tasks, inputs, outputs, decision rules, context, knowledge, integrations, controls and human review.
Design and build or co-build bounded agents, AI assistants, retrieval-based solutions and workflow automations using approved platforms and patterns.
Create proofs of concept and small implementations using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI capabilities, approved APIs and Python where appropriate.
Apply prompt engineering, grounding, RAG, orchestration and evaluation techniques suitable for the use case.
Configure human-in-the-loop decisions, exception handling, fallback behavior, auditability and access controls.
Create and execute test cases covering business accuracy, groundedness, usability, process performance, controls and failure conditions.
Partner with Lead Engineer, Engineering and Architecture where production software, complex integration or enterprise data engineering is required.
Builders Network delivery support
Support Principal AI Leads and AI Builders in translating business problems and backlogs into process-ready use cases.
Facilitate workflow discovery and identify what should be removed, simplified or standardized before agent development.
Provide hands-on guidance on prompt structure, grounding, testing, controls, adoption and value measurement.
Document and publish reusable workflows, prompts, test scripts, control approaches and solution assets.
Escalate complex, high-risk or cross-functional choices to the Lead AI Process Transformation Engineer and the appropriate Responsible AI, Architecture, Information Security, Privacy, Legal and Risk partners.
Measurement, adoption and sustainment
Establish operational definitions, baselines, targets, leading indicators, lagging indicators and balancing measures for assigned opportunities.
Prepare value cases covering capacity, cycle time, quality, risk, service and customer or associate value.
Track adoption, usage, performance, reliability, exceptions, control results and forecast versus realized value.
Support change, training, operational handover and stabilization activities.
Provide clear status updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and outcomes.
Required qualifications and experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data, Business, Operations or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant experience spanning process improvement, business analysis, workflow transformation, automation, solution engineering or AI-enabled delivery.
Demonstrated experience conducting cross-functional current-state discovery and contributing to future-state workflow redesign.
Practical Lean knowledge covering process mapping, SIPOC, waste analysis, root-cause analysis, standard work, controls and benefit measurement.
Hands-on experience building AI agents, intelligent workflows, automation prototypes or small digital solutions using at least one enterprise platform.
Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG, prompt engineering, knowledge grounding and solution evaluation.
Ability to translate business and process requirements into functional designs, technical requirements, test cases and implementation tasks.
Ability to work with APIs, structured data and basic scripting; working proficiency in Python or an equivalent language.
Strong facilitation, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management and written and verbal communication.
Ability to work through ambiguity, manage assigned work independently and escalate decisions with clear evidence.
Preferred qualifications and experience
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification supported by practical application.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of API integration, JSON, authentication, connectors, data preparation, vector search and enterprise knowledge sources.
Experience supporting an AI Builders Network, AI Center of Excellence, transformation studio or enterprise automation program.
Experience with Agile delivery, product thinking, service design, change management or program coordination.
Experience in Finance, Operations, Technology, shared services, customer operations or another complex enterprise environment.
Cloud, AI, business analysis, process-improvement or automation certifications.
Expected outcomes
Assigned workflows have validated current states, owners, baselines, target outcomes, controls and documented readiness decisions.
Prioritized opportunities progress efficiently from discovery to redesigned workflow, bounded prototype or implementation, adoption and measurable outcome.
Builders receive practical process and solution-engineering support for assigned opportunities.
Prototypes and small implementations demonstrate value without creating unmanaged production risk.
Reusable process, prompt, testing and control assets are captured and published.
Business owners receive clear evidence on performance, adoption, risks and realized value.
What success looks like
Diagnoses the workflow before prescribing technology.
Produces accurate, usable process, requirement, test and implementation artifacts.
Builds enough of the solution to accelerate learning and delivery while respecting production boundaries.
Escalates evidence-based choices early and collaborates effectively with business and technical specialists.
Delivers adopted and controlled improvements with measurable outcomes.
Continually builds proficiency in both process transformation and applied AI engineering.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
A. Sales & Business Development
Source customers for New Car loans & Pre Owned Car Loans.
Build and maintain strong relations with dealers, DSA, Brokers, and local influencers.
Achieve monthly sales targets for loan disbursement.
Conduct field visits to identify new business opportunities.
B. Customer Handling
Understand customer needs and recommend suitable loan products.
Explain loan terms, interest rates, EMI plans, and documentation requirements.
Assist customers in application filling and ensure end-to-end support.
C. Documentation & Verification
Collect and verify customer KYC, income proof, bank statements, and other required documents.
Ensure accuracy and compliance as per company policies.
Coordinate with credit and operations teams for file processing.
D. Loan Processing
Submit cases for credit approval and follow up until disbursal.
Update tracking sheets or CRM systems with real-time loan status.
Resolve discrepancies and support verification officers during field investigations.
E. Post-Disbursement Support
Ensure onboarding and welcome call completion.
Coordinate with customers for repayment-related queries.

Preferred candidate profile

Graduated
Willing to travel with in district ( 20 %)
2 wheeler license

Perks and benefits

24 k CTC / Month
Incentive + TA

Description:
Job description
Designation: Executive- HRBP
Department: Human Resource
Location: Kochi
Experience: 2-5

Role Description: The candidate must be from HR background. Must have at least 2+ years similar field experience.

We are looking for a skilled HR Officer who will recruit, support and develop talent through developing policies and managing procedures. You will be responsible for administrative tasks and youll contribute to making the company a better place to work. If you are passionate about HR and highly efficient, give us a chance to meet you. We want to see a committed and approachable individual and be impressed with your character and skills.

Duties/Responsibilities:
Support the development and implementation of HR initiatives and systems
Create and implement effective onboarding plans
Assist in performance management processes
Support the management of disciplinary and grievance issues
Maintain employee records (attendance, EEO data etc.) according to policy and legal requirements
Review employment and working conditions to ensure legal compliance

Required Skills/Abilities:
Proven experience as HR officer, administrator or other HR position
Knowledge of HR functions (pay & benefits, recruitment, training & development etc.)
Proficient in MS Office; knowledge of HRMS is a plus
Outstanding organizational and time-management abilities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Problem-solving and decision-making aptitude
Strong ethics and reliability

Education Qualifications: -
BSc/BA in business administration, social studies or relevant field; further training will be a plus
HR Credentials (e.g. PHR from the HR Certification Institute)

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Obstetric anesthesia: Provide anesthesia and pain relief during normal delivery (epidural, where available) and cesarean sections.
Gynecological surgeries: Administer anesthesia for procedures such as hysterectomy and other gynecological operations.
Pediatric anesthesia: Provide safe anesthesia for infants, newborns, and children undergoing surgery.
Pre-anesthesia assessment: Review medical history, allergies, investigations, and fitness for anesthesia before surgery.
Intraoperative monitoring: Monitor vital signs, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and breathing.
Postoperative care: Manage pain, nausea, and recovery after anesthesia.
Emergency management: Respond to obstetric emergencies, difficult airways, severe bleeding, and other critical situations.
Team coordination: Work closely with obstetricians, pediatricians, neonatologists, surgeons, nurses, and operating theatre staff.
Documentation: Maintain anesthesia records, consent documentation, and postoperative monitoring records.

Title: Area Sales Officer
Skills: Retail Sales and Customer Handling, Product Knowledge and Sales Pitching, Lead Generation and Follow-up, Negotiation and Order Closing, Billing and Documentation, Inventory Coordination, Relationship Management, Target Achievement
Description:
Job Description: Retail Sales Officer
Company Name: Noble Steel (Sangam Steel)
Job Title: Retail Sales Officer
Department: Sales
Job Location: Kozhikode, Salem, Kochi, Namakkal, tuticorin, Chennai, Chengalapattu
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: HOD
Website: https://www.noblesteels.com/

Job Summary
Sangam Steel is looking for a motivated and customer-oriented Retail Sales Executive to manage retail sales, assist customers, promote steel products, and achieve sales targets. The ideal candidate should have good communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to develop strong relationships with customers, contractors, fabricators, and dealers.

Key Responsibilities
Attend to walk-in customers and understand their steel product requirements.
Explain product specifications, quality, pricing, sizes, and availability.
Generate sales leads and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
Prepare quotations, sales orders, invoices, and other sales documents.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and develop new customers.
Coordinate with the store, warehouse, and dispatch teams to ensure timely delivery.
Monitor stock availability and communicate inventory requirements to the concerned team.
Handle customer queries, complaints, and after-sales service.
Follow up on pending quotations, customer orders, and outstanding payments.
Maintain accurate sales records and prepare daily sales reports.
Ensure proper product display, store cleanliness, and adherence to company policies.
Keep track of local market trends, competitor pricing, and customer preferences.

Required Qualifications
Minimum graduate degree in any discipline is preferred.
13 years of experience in retail sales, preferably in steel, hardware, building materials, or construction-related products.
Knowledge of steel products such as TMT bars, MS angles, channels, flats, pipes, sheets, and other steel items is an advantage.
Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and billing or inventory software.
Good communication, customer service, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple customer enquiries.

Key Skills
Retail Sales and Customer Handling
Product Knowledge and Sales Pitching
Lead Generation and Follow-up
Negotiation and Order Closing
Billing and Documentation
Inventory Coordination
Relationship Management
Target Achievement

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly sales targets.
Number of new customers acquired.
Conversion rate of customer enquiries into orders.
Repeat business and customer satisfaction.
Timely follow-up on quotations and pending orders.
Accuracy of sales documentation and billing.
Collection of outstanding payments, wherever applicable.

Compensation and Benefits
Salary: As per industry standards and candidate experience.
Incentives based on sales performance, as per company policy.
Training and career growth opportunities.
Other benefits as per company policy.

Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be energetic, trustworthy, proactive, and commercially oriented, with a strong interest in retail sales. Experience in steel trading, hardware, construction materials, or a building materials showroom will be an added advantage.
CompanyAddress: Floor No.: 6th Floor Building No./Flat No Tower A Global Business Park, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana, GURGAON, Haryana, India

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Job Description -
Job Title - Area Sales Head-Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan)
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Amritsar Br.
Reporting To Product head
Supervising- Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan) division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

5-8 Years
Salary

Best In industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda

The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits

Job Description -

Job Title - Area Sales Head-Standard Building (Wire, Switch & BCP )
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Amritsar Br.
Reporting To Product head
Supervising- Individual Contributor

Job responsibilities
1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Standard Building (Wire, Switch & BCP )division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.

Candidates profile -
Education
Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience
5-8 Years
Salary
Best In industry
Personal Attributes
Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age
Maximum 32 Years
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

KeyDeliverables (Essentialfunctions Responsibilities of the Job) :

Asa Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role isto assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basicsof store operations. Your key responsibilities include:

1.Customer Service:
Greet Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.

2.Store Standards:
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the stores appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.

3.Basic Operations:
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.

4.Growth Learning:
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Description:
Job Description
Principal Accountabilities
Focus on customer engagement & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Manage error free valuation & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Responsible for correct valuation & maintenance of 100% process compliance at branch.
Joint custodian of the Vault with responsibility of safekeeping of pledge ornaments as per company policy.
Verify customer KYC documents, application requests and initiate loan disbursals.
Process foreclosure, part release, closure, interest payment transactions basis customer requests.
Initiate transactions for disbursal, foreclosure, release and accept customer payments.
Responsible for keeping NPAs in control through strong follow ups from the customers for interest collections.
Follow up with existing customers for repeat gold loan business
Good planning abilities are required for smooth functioning of the branch & for developing cohesiveness within the company and co-workers.
Maintaining quality & performance of the business, preparing various reports and submit to supervisors.

Description:
Job Title:Shift Incharge Electrical
Department: Electrical Maintenance
Location: Rajpura
Reporting To: Section Head Electrical
Grade: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
JobPurpose
To ensureuninterrupted operation of downstream steel manufacturing lines by effectivelymanaging electrical maintenance activities during the shift, minimizingequipment downtime, ensuring safety compliance, and leading the shiftelectrical team to achieve production and maintenance objectives.
KeyResponsibilities
1.Shift Operations
Ensure smooth operation of all electrical systems during the assigned shift.
Attend electrical breakdowns promptly and restore equipment within targeted downtime.
Coordinate with Production, Mechanical, Instrumentation, and Utility teams for seamless plant operations.
Ensure proper shift handover and maintain detailed shift logs.
2.Preventive Predictive Maintenance
Execute preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for all electrical equipment.
Monitor the health of motors, drives, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, PCCs, UPS, DG sets, and electrical panels.
Ensure timely inspection, testing, and maintenance of critical electrical assets.
3.Breakdown Maintenance
Analyze root causes of electrical failures and implement corrective actions.
Troubleshoot PLC, VFD, servo drives, sensors, HMI, and field electrical equipment.
Minimize downtime through effective troubleshooting and resource management.
4.Safety Compliance
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards, statutory regulations, and company safety procedures.
Implement Lockout-Tagout (LOTO), Permit-to-Work (PTW), and electrical isolation procedures.
Conduct safety toolbox talks and ensure the use of appropriate PPE.
Participate in safety audits and incident investigations.
5.Team Management
Supervise shift electricians and contract manpower.
Allocate work, monitor execution, and ensure adherence to maintenance standards.
Provide on-the-job training and technical guidance to team members.
Evaluate contractor performance and ensure work quality.
6.Reliability Improvement
Identify recurring equipment failures and implement reliability improvement initiatives.
Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Kaizen, TPM, and continuous improvement projects.
Recommend equipment modifications to improve reliability and energy efficiency.
7.Documentation Reporting
Maintain maintenance records, equipment history, breakdown reports, and shift reports.
Update maintenance activities in SAP/CMMS.
Monitor spare parts consumption and raise material requisitions.
8.Energy Management
Monitor electrical power consumption and recommend energy-saving initiatives.
Ensure efficient utilization of electrical resources.
KeyEquipment Exposure
HT/LT Distribution Systems
Transformers
VFDs and Soft Starters
AC/DC Motors
MCC PCC Panels
PLC Systems (Siemens / ABB / Rockwell / Mitsubishi)
HMI SCADA
Industrial Sensors and Instrument Interfaces
UPS and Battery Banks
DG Sets
Cranes and Material Handling Equipment
Galvanizing, Color Coating, Pickling, Slitting, and CTL Line Electrical Systems
EducationalQualification
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
Diploma in Electrical Engineering (with relevant experience may also be considered)
Experience
510 years of experience in electrical maintenance in a steel manufacturing or continuous process industry.
Minimum 23 years of experience in a shift handling role in a downstream steel plant is preferred.
TechnicalCompetencies
Electrical troubleshooting and fault diagnosis
PLC and VFD knowledge
HT/LT maintenance
Electrical drawings and schematics
Preventive and predictive maintenance
SAP/CMMS knowledge
Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
TPM, 5S, Kaizen
LOTO and PTW systems
BehavioralCompetencies
Leadership and team management
Decision-making under pressure
Problem-solving and analytical skills
Communication and coordination
Planning and execution
Safety consciousness
Continuous improvement mindset
KeyPerformance Indicators (KPIs)
Electrical equipment availability (%)
Breakdown frequency and MTTR
Preventive maintenance compliance
Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
Safety compliance and zero electrical incidents
Energy consumption reduction
Maintenance cost control
Shift-wise equipment uptime
Spare parts optimization
Implementation of reliability improvement initiatives
ThisJD is suitable for downstream steel facilities such as Cold Rolling Mill(CRM), Continuous Galvanizing Line (CGL), Color Coating Line (CCL), PicklingLine, Slitting Line, and Cut-to-Length (CTL) operations .

Description:
Role and Responsibility:
Note: Two wheeler and DL is Mandatory for this role.


To monitor closely the HL data and cross sell insurance (HDFC Life and Non
Life), fixed deposits and other products as introduced by the company to
home loan customers of HDFC Sales
To source open market business too and achieve the targets assigned
To be completely aware of the products being offered by the company and
understand competition offering and handle customer objections
To ensure proper customer profiling on each call / customer visit, to identify
and understand his/her needs and accordingly recommend investment and
Insurance options
Relationship building with the Home Loan Executives to which he is mapped
and to ensure joint calls with the HLE to ensure maximum attachments of the
files being disbursed
To build a relationship with the customer so that he/ she is able to cross sell
other product offering basis the need of the customer, thereby managing the
entire account of customer. FSA to ensure to source customers family details,
other general insurance details, other loan details etc
To be in sync and work together with the partner representatives
Understanding the joint ownership of the customer at the time of servicing
etc
To ensure timely renewal of the business sourced
To ensure appropriate processes defined are being followed and undergo the
training and certification for being compliant towards selling of various
products (insurance, mutual funds etc)
To always be well groomed and his sales kit should be organized and
complete
To maintain company first attitude and be respectful in attitude towards
other fellow colleagues, seniors , partners etc

Description:
Position title: Cluster Visual Merchandising - Upper North (Third Party)

Location: Ludhiana

Reports to: Regional Visual Merchandiser North

Position Summary: To ensure enhancement of visual representation of each Puma store by continuously updating the look and feel of the space.
Fostering VM creativity to front end team through VM trainings, Competitions & Store Audits
Alpha execution of Resec which includes Campaigns, Seasonal visual change overs and Key story roll outs
Responsible for all formats of stores- EBOs, Partner, SIS & LFR
A planned journey for the responsible set of stores (beat plan) to be adhered and shared month on month

Key Objectives:
Provide support to store teams to ensure brand and visual merchandising standards are understood and consistently upheld
Plan, order and coordinate for VM supplies for seasonal / monthly changes for the set of stores.
Train Store Management and Support teams on merchandising standards, proper fixture utilization and techniques
Organizing and sending weekly/monthly reports to the Head Office and implementing feedback
Maintaining a vendor base for various branded supply elements for the region
Fostering VM creativity to front end through VM trainings, Competitions & Store Audits
Supporting Key initiatives roll outs by covering all store formats.

Key Performance Indicators:
Net Sales
Stock Cover
Maintaining Vendor Base

Organizational Relationships:
Internal: Visual Merchandising Team , Sales Ops Team, Merchandising Team and Project Team
External: Execution partners for hangers, Execution partners for mannequins, Execution partners for branded supplies and Execution partners for print media

Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:
Bachelors/Masters degree in Fashion Communication / Fashion /Accessories/ Textile Design
Work experience as a Visual Merchandiser including design/ execution
Demonstrable visual design skills with a strong retail merchandising portfolio
Proficiency in Microsoft presentation & excel, Photoshop, Illustrator and other visual design tools
Well versed with best practices of VM in Global industry
Excelling Photography skill
Creative and innovative thinker
Acing Number game- analyzing and tracking of the executions done
A proficient communicator.

Description:
A2. Job Purpose
Buy raw materials (base oil, additives) and packaging materials on time. Buy at the right price and in the right quantity. Make sure production never stops for want of material. Make sure domestic and export dispatches are not delayed. Avoid extra stock that blocks money. Keep all purchase records correct and complete.


A3. Main Responsibilities

A3.1 Purchase Orders
Receive material requirements (indents) from production, stores and quality.
Check the requirement is approved before buying.
Send enquiries to suppliers.
Take at least 3 quotations.
Prepare a comparison of quotations (price, freight, tax, credit days).
Make purchase orders (PO) in Tally / ERP.
Get the PO approved by the Purchase Manager.
Send the PO to the supplier.
Get written confirmation of quantity, rate and delivery date.
Change or close POs when needed, with approval.


A3.2 Follow-up and Delivery
Keep a list of all pending orders.
Follow up with suppliers every day.
Confirm vehicle number and driver phone number in advance.
Confirm expected arrival date and time.
Coordinate base oil tanker deliveries.
Coordinate packaging material truck deliveries.
Plan deliveries as per the production plan.
Check storage space before material arrives.
Inform the Purchase Manager early about any delay.
Handle urgent purchases with proper approval.


A3.3 Stock Control
Check stock of all materials regularly.
Order before stock reaches the reorder level.
Check stock plus pending orders before ordering again.
Calculate how many days the stock will last.
Keep supplier minimum order quantity (MOQ) in mind.
Report slow-moving and unused materials.
Report materials near expiry.
Help in monthly physical stock count.


A3.4 Import Support
Follow up with overseas suppliers for proforma invoice.
Request advance / LC payment through accounts.
Collect shipping documents (invoice, packing list, bill of lading, COA, MSDS).
Coordinate with customs agent (CHA) for clearance.
Track shipment arrival date.
Keep an import shipment list updated.


A3.5 Export Support
Get export order details from the export team.
Arrange export labels and cartons.
Arrange pallets (fumigated where needed).
Arrange shrink wrap and other export packing.
Make sure all material reaches before the loading date.


A3.6 Material Receipt and Quality
Check invoice and e-way bill with every delivery.
Check test certificate (COA) with every oil / chemical delivery.
Match received material with the PO.
Inform quality team for testing.
Do not allow use of material before quality approval.
Inform supplier in writing about shortage or rejection.
Arrange return or replacement of rejected material.
Raise debit notes through accounts.


A3.7 Bills and Payments
Match PO, material receipt (GRN) and supplier bill.
Sort out rate or quantity differences with supplier.
Check GST number and GST details on bills.
Check e-way bill details.
Give accounts a weekly list of payments due.
Mark MSME suppliers for payment within 45 days.
Track advances paid to suppliers.


A3.8 Suppliers
Collect documents from new suppliers (GST, PAN, bank, MSME).
Create new suppliers in Tally / ERP.
Keep supplier phone, email and contact person updated.
Keep supplier lead time and MOQ updated.
Find new suppliers for important materials.
Keep record of supplier delivery and quality performance.


A3.9 Reports
Daily report of pending orders and deliveries.
Weekly report of late deliveries.
Monthly report of purchases by material and supplier.
Monthly report of price changes.
Report of slow-moving stock.
Check all figures and units before sending.


A3.10 Records and Ethics
Keep a complete file for every purchase.
Keep files ready for audit.
Keep supplier prices confidential.
Do not accept gifts or favours from suppliers.
Follow company purchase rules.


A3.11 General & Sales Coordination
Coordinate with the sales team on customer order requirements and dispatch dates.
Share material availability status with sales before order confirmation.
Arrange packing material for urgent and special customer orders.
Coordinate with production, stores, dispatch and accounts for smooth order execution.
Handle general coordination work assigned by the Purchase Manager / management.
Attend internal meetings and follow up on action points.


A3.12 Reports Generation from Software
Generate purchase, stock and pending-order reports from Tally / ERP.
Export data from software to Excel and prepare summaries.
Prepare supplier-wise and material-wise purchase reports.
Prepare stock ageing and reorder-level reports.
Check software data against physical records and correct errors.
Share MIS reports with management on time.


A4. Daily / Weekly / Monthly Work
Daily
Check pending orders and follow up.
Check deliveries due today.
Check stock of important materials.
Update order tracker.
Weekly
Review stock against reorder levels.
Send payment-due list to accounts.
Report late deliveries.
Monthly
Monthly purchase report.
Slow-moving stock report.
Help in physical stock count.
Close completed purchase orders.

About Us

We are a premier executive search organization, trusted by leading corporations to identify and attract senior-level talent. Our commitment to excellence, discretion, and strategic insight has positioned us as a partner of choice for organizations seeking leadership solutions.

Role Summary

The Team Leader will be responsible for managing a high-performing recruitment team, ensuring delivery of executive mandates, and strengthening client partnerships. This role requires a blend of leadership acumen, operational discipline, and deep understanding of executive search methodologies.

Key Responsibilities
Provide strategic direction and operational oversight to the recruitment team.
Drive execution of executive search assignments with precision and timeliness.
Cultivate and sustain long-term client relationships through consultative engagement.
Monitor team performance against KPIs and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities for growth and expansion.

Minimum 3 years of experience in executive search, recruitment, or talent advisory.

Strong client management and stakeholder engagement skills.
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
Postgraduate qualification in HR, Business, or related discipline preferred.

What We Offer

Performance-linked incentives and career advancement opportunities.
Exposure to marquee clients and senior leadership mandates.
A collaborative, growth-oriented organizational culture.

Description:
Senior Executive Industrial Sales and Procurement
Anand Enterprises | Brand Anand Bharat Mart
Full time on site | Mohali | 2 to 5 years of relevant experience | Openings 2
Fixed annual gross salary INR 4.00 to 6.00 lakh, based on relevant experience, skills and interview assessment. Performance incentives are additional, under a written company policy.
Work location: Plot 1542, Sector 82 JLPL, Mohali, Punjab 140306. Reporting to Divyansh Aggarwal. Approved official travel is reimbursed under company policy; statutory benefits apply as eligible.
About Anand Bharat Mart
Anand Bharat Mart, a brand of Anand Enterprises, is built on 25+ years of trust in industrial supplies and B2B procurement. We are a channel partner of KARAM and offer products from other reputed industrial brands across safety and PPE, welding supplies, tools, MRO consumables and electrical items. We help factories and businesses meet their procurement needs through reliable sourcing, competitive pricing, specification compliance and timely delivery.
The role
Own an assigned client portfolio from requirement understanding and vendor sourcing through quotation, order execution and collection follow-up. Develop new industrial accounts through planned outreach and plant visits. Success means profitable repeat business, reliable service and complete commercial records.
Responsibilities
Understand RFQs, technical specifications, brands, models, quantities, units, delivery deadlines and client purchase procedures; obtain clarification before quoting.
Find suitable OEMs and verified suppliers, compare equivalent offers and negotiate purchase prices, freight, lead times, warranty and payment terms.
Prepare accurate cost comparisons and client quotations; distinguish markup from margin and obtain approval for pricing, credit or specification exceptions.
Follow up on quotations and customer POs, confirm approved purchase orders and coordinate stock, QC, dispatch, delivery, GRN or POD and invoice documentation.
Maintain professional client and vendor relationships and coordinate receivable follow-up with the billing team. Record commitments and escalate overdue or disputed cases promptly.


Responsibilities continued
Identify new manufacturing accounts, arrange procurement or maintenance meetings, support vendor registration and develop repeat opportunities in the assigned territory.
Update the company CRM daily with requirement lines, quote versions, approved commercials, documents, owners, next actions and due dates.
Use approved company communication channels; protect pricing and commercial information, disclose conflicts of interest and maintain an auditable transaction trail.
What you should bring
2 to 5 years in industrial B2B sales, MRO distribution, technical sales or procurement with substantial customer interaction. Strong candidates with directly relevant experience will be considered.
Practical sourcing and sales exposure to industrial consumables, safety products, welding, tools, electrical or mechanical items; ability to learn unfamiliar specifications.
Evidence of quotations handled, vendor negotiation, repeat accounts developed and sales or purchase portfolios managed. Use anonymised examples rather than another employer's confidential records.
Working knowledge of GST quotation basics, purchase and sales orders, delivery terms and credit discipline; comfort with Excel or Sheets, email and a CRM.
Clear written English and confident client communication in Hindi; Punjabi is helpful. Willingness to visit clients in the Tricity, Dera Bassi, Baddi and nearby industrial areas.
A diploma or degree in engineering, commerce or business is preferred. Relevant practical experience is more important than a particular qualification.
How performance will be measured
Agreed billing and contribution targets after a defined ramp-up; new and repeat customer development; quotation turnaround; collection follow-up; order accuracy; and CRM completeness. Incentives are linked to eligible collected contribution and recorded growth, under a written policy.
Selection and growth
The selection process includes a discussion of relevant experience, a short simulated RFQ and quotation exercise, and reference checks with your consent. The role offers the opportunity to develop into an account lead as portfolio performance and responsibility grow.
Apply
Apply through the job posting with your CV, current location, notice period, expected fixed salary, product categories handled and an anonymised example of your sales or procurement responsibilities. Do not submit confidential client lists or vendor rate sheets.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About us
We are a distinguished executive search firm, recognized for our ability to deliver strategic leadership talent to organizations across industries. Our consultative approach, market intelligence, and commitment to excellence enable us to serve as trusted advisors to clients navigating complex talent landscapes.

Role Summary
The Manager will oversee multiple teams within the executive search function, ensuring operational excellence, client satisfaction, and revenue growth. This role requires a seasoned professional with strong leadership capabilities, business acumen, and a proven track record in executive recruitment.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage Team Leaders and their respective recruitment teams.
Drive execution of senior-level search mandates with precision and confidentiality.
Develop and nurture long-term client relationships, positioning the firm as a strategic partner.
Establish performance metrics, monitor delivery, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to organizational growth through business development and market expansion.
Provide strategic insights on talent trends and industry developments to clients and internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile
Minimum 6 years of experience in executive search, recruitment consulting, or talent advisory.
Demonstrated success in managing teams and delivering leadership mandates.
Strong client engagement and relationship management skills.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and analytical abilities.
Postgraduate qualification in HR, Business Management, or related discipline preferred.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation package.
Performance-based incentives and leadership growth opportunities.
Exposure to marquee clients and strategic leadership assignments.
A collaborative, high-performance culture with emphasis on professional excellence.

To apply / Schedule your interview, Kindly contact Vishal Talwar, +91 95697 04567 or share your updated resume at vishal.talwar@lavyaassociates.com
