Work on Customer Service (CS) processes including service orders, warranty management, and service contracts.
Participate in end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout, and enhancement projects.
Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and user acceptance testing support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including MM, FI, PP, and technical teams.
Prepare functional specifications and support developments, integrations, and interfaces.
Conduct client workshops, provide solution recommendations, and support go-live activities.
Ensure adherence to SAP best practices and project standards.
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD).
Mandatory experience in Vistex.
Mandatory experience in SAP Customer Service (CS).
Strong knowledge of:
Order-to-Cash (O2C)
Pricing
Sales Orders
Deliveries
Billing
Credit Management
Returns Process
Experience in Vistex modules such as:
Rebates
Chargebacks
Incentives
Claims Management
Pricing Programs
Minimum one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Implementation project.
Experience in requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Integration knowledge with MM, FI, and other SAP modules.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.
Working at HGS
At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills :Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI)

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer
The Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise-wide Smartsheet solutions and Power BI analytics platforms to automate workflows, improve collaboration, enhance project/program management, and deliver actionable business insights. This role focuses on building executive-grade dashboards and reports, integrating Smartsheet with Power BI, and enabling data-driven decision-making through advanced reporting, automation, and system integrations.
Key

Roles & Responsibilities
Smartsheet Solution Development & Automation
Design, develop, and maintain scalable Smartsheet solutions utilizing Sheets, Workspaces, Reports, Forms, Dashboards, Dynamic Views, WorkApps, Pivot App, Functions, and Advanced Formulas.
Create automated workflows for approvals, notifications, reminders, status updates, and data validations using Smartsheet Automation.
Develop cross-sheet references and rollup solutions to consolidate project, program, and portfolio data into centralized views.
Build and optimize enterprise-wide project tracking, resource management, governance, and operational reporting solutions.
Configure Dynamic Views and WorkApps to deliver role-based access and personalized user experiences.
Design and implement governance standards, templates, and best practices for Smartsheet adoption.
Power BI Development & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive leadership and business stakeholders.
Develop complex data models, DAX measures, KPIs, scorecards, and drill-through analytics using Power BI.
Create executive-level visualizations for project health, resource utilization, financial metrics, operational performance, and program governance.
Develop and optimize Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting frameworks for enterprise-scale analytics.
Implement Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace governance, and data refresh strategies.
Smartsheet - Power BI Integration
Integrate Smartsheet data with Power BI using native connectors, APIs, dataflows, and ETL pipelines.
Design automated data ingestion processes to combine Smartsheet data with enterprise systems such as SharePoint, SQL Server, Azure, Salesforce, and other business applications.
Build consolidated reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth across multiple business functions.
Develop data transformation and cleansing processes using Power Query, Power BI Dataflows, and ETL tools.
Integrations & Technical Enablement
Develop integrations using Smartsheet REST APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and middleware platforms.
Connect Smartsheet with Microsoft ecosystem tools including SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Outlook, and Excel.
Support implementation of third-party connectors and integrations with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, and other operational systems.
Troubleshoot and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, data models, and workflow automations.
Required Skills
Smartsheet:
Sheets, Workspaces, Reports, Dashboards
Forms and Data Collection
Workflows and Automation
Dynamic View
Pivot App
WorkApps
Resource & Project Tracking Solutions
Smartsheet Control Center (Preferred)
VLOOKUP
INDEX/MATCH
COUNTIF / COUNTIFS
SUMIFS
Cross-Sheet References
Nested IF Statements
Date Functions
Lookup and Rollup Logic
Power BI:
Dashboard & Report Development
Data Modeling
DAX Measures and Calculations
Power Query (M Language)
Dataflows
Row-Level Security (RLS)
Performance Optimization
Workspace Administration
Semantic Models and KPI Reporting
Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and automation solutions.
Provide technical guidance and best practices for Smartsheet and Power BI adoption.
Conduct solution reviews, user training, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Maintain technical documentation, governance standards, and solution architecture artifacts
Shift B Support: Availability to provide support until 11 AM PST.
Return to Office: Mandatory 5-day RTO from 4 strategic office locations. (Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad and Bangalore).

SUMMARY
Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Jaipur Local / Ajmer / Jhunjhunu Local / Merta / Dhidwana / Bhimmal / Kuchhmancity / Jalore / Jodhpur / Suratgarh 
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

  Other Job Pointers / Additional Details: 
           Location:Jaipur Local / Ajmer / Jhunjhunu Local / Merta / Dhidwana / Bhimmal / Kuchhmancity / Jalore / Jodhpur / Suratgarh

           Gender: Male preferred
           Eligibility:   Graduates Freshers & up to 11 months sales exp Local candidates only Bike mandatory with DL.
           Qualification:   Graduate (any stream)
           Pass-out Year: 2021 to 2025 pass-out candidates only
           Shift: Day shift 6 days working Sunday fixed off
           Payroll:   Direct company payroll
           Communication:  Basic good communication Product pitching to retailers/distributors
           Salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand) + incentives
           Relocation:  Not available

Description:
Job Description: Senior GCP Architect
HGS is a global provider of technology, AI, and business services that helps organizations transform with confidence. At HGS, we combine technology, AI, and human expertise to deliver Intelligent Experiences that drive growth and transformation. Our strong foundation in CX enables us to create impactful solutions across industries. Through our Realized AI approach, we deliver practical innovation with measurable outcomes. Part of the multi-billion-dollar Hinduja Group, HGS takes a globally local” approach with 17,000+ employees across 10 countries and 23 delivery centers.”

Position Summary:
As a Senior Architect, you are the primary technical architect and strategic advisor for our most complex Google Cloud data engagements. You will own the high-level design of the data ecosystem, lead large-scale digital transformations, and ensure that technical solutions translate into tangible business ROI. This role requires a balance of architectural mastery, commercial awareness, and technical mentorship.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Architecture: Design end-to-end data ecosystems using Data Mesh or Medallion patterns.
Technical Authority: Hands on knowledge in BigQuery and Dataflow/Dataproc ETL design and automation using workflows or Airflow, Should be able to efficiently do RCA using logging and monitoring tools.
Performance & Cost Governance: Conduct deep-dive audits of BigQuery usage.
FinOps Strategy: Own the BigQuery Reservation strategy and optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets.
Governance Frameworks: Architect organization-wide standards for Dataplex, security, and PII compliance.
Platform Security: Establish advanced security perimeters using VPC Service Controls and CMEK.
Team Leadership: Mentor Senior Engineers and define the technical standard for the entire practice. Participate in design discussions, code review, production deployment planning/cutover, data discovery sessions
Modernization Lead: Drive large-scale migrations from legacy on-prem systems to GCP Native solutions. Experience with third party data ingestion to GCP BQ/GCS

Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field;

Experience and Requirements:
Experience: 12+ years in Data Engineering, with 5+ years of specialized experience in Google Cloud.
Expertise: Deep, internal-level knowledge of BigQuery, BigLake, Dataflow, Dataproc, GCS, Data transfer services, Pubsub, cloud DLP.
AI/ML: Familiarity with operationalizing ML models via BigQuery ML and Vertex AI Pipelines (optional).
Ecosystem: Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and proficiency in Terraform/Cloudbuild/docker, CI/CD pipelines.
Certification: Professional Data Engineer (GCP) is mandatory.
Tools: Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines building for automated code deployments.
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.
AboutCompany: Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!

Description:
Job Purpose
Project Details :
We want to establish early support systems to empower family caregivers of children identified with delays or at risk of delays falling under the age group of 0 to 6 years.
Key objectives of the project are :
Build capacity among frontline workers to do early identification of children with developmental delays and disabilities and deliver home-based caregiver effectively
Early identification of children with developmental delays and disabilities through screening tool by Anganwadi workers
Early caregiver support through home visits by Anganwadi workers
Support in reinforcing referral channels like DEIC,NIMHR,DDRC,etc
Role
The Operations Manager will lead the day-to-day field operations of the project, ensuring effective implementation, team performance, quality, stakeholder coordination, and achievement of project milestones. The role will work closely with the Project Manager, Field Coordinators, government stakeholders, frontline workers, and implementation partners.
Job Description
1. Operations & Execution
Lead field-level planning and execution across project locations
Translate project plans, targets and SOPs into actionable field plans
Track project milestones and address operational bottlenecks
Ensure adherence to project processes and quality standards
2. Team Management
Manage and mentor field coordinator
Set clear targets, review performance and drive accountability
Conduct regular team reviews and support problem-solving
Identify capacity gaps and coordinate required training and support
3. Monitoring & Quality
Monitor implementation quality through regular field visits and reviews
Track screening, home visits, caregiver engagement, and referral activities across locations
Review field data and identify gaps requiring corrective action
Use data and field insights to improve implementation
4. Frontline Worker Support
Oversee training, refresher sessions and ongoing handholding of frontline workers
Ensure effective adoption of project tools and approaches
Support Field Coordinators in mentoring frontline workers
5. Government & Stakeholder Coordination
Coordinate with WCD and other government stakeholders at the state, district and block level
Support coordination with DEIC, DDRC, NIMHR, and other referral partner
Represent the project in relevant review meetings and stakeholder engagements
Strengthen government ownership and referral linkages
6. Data, Reporting & Documentation
Monitor dashboards and project indicators
Ensure timely and accurate reporting from field teams
Prepare operational updates and review presentations
Document field challenges, learnings, and best practices
7. Problem Solving & Scale-up
Identify operational risks and drive timely solutions
Recommend improvements to tools, processes, and workflows
Document learnings and contribute to strengthening systems for scale-up and government ownership
Desired Profile
Knowledge
Bachelor s/Master s degree in Social Work, Development Studies, Public Health, Management, or a related field
Specific Skills
Strong operations and team-management skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills
Strong problem-solving and coordination skills
Data interpretation and reporting skills
Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and digital tools
Experience
5+ years of relevant experience in the development/social sector-public health/ ECD/ disability/ community programmes
Experience managing field teams and working across multiple locations
Experience working with government departments and frontline workers such as AWWs/ASHA/ANMs
Experience in project operations, monitoring, and stakeholder coordination
Willingness to travel frequently
Ability to work in a field-based environment

Education and Experience

Assisting with the Management of Engineering Operations and Budgets

- Selects and orders or purchases new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.
- Manages parts and equipment inventory.

- Strives to improve service performance.

Description:
Here is a professional Job Description for an Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo, suitable for recruitment portals, LinkedIn, and internal hiring.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo
Department: Operations
Designation: Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)
Industry: Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) / Food & Beverage
Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Area Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: As per business requirement
About WOW! momo
WOW! momo is one of India’s leading homegrown QSR brands, known for its innovative food offerings, customer-centric approach, and fast-growing restaurant network. We are looking for energetic, customer-focused, and result-oriented professionals to join our restaurant operations team.
Job Purpose
To support the Restaurant Manager in managing day-to-day restaurant operations, ensuring excellent customer experience, maintaining food quality and safety standards, driving sales and profitability, and developing a motivated team that consistently delivers WOW! service.
Key Responsibilities
1. Restaurant Operations
Manage daily restaurant operations and ensure smooth functioning across all shifts.
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational checklists, and company policies.
Monitor opening and closing activities, equipment functionality, cleanliness, and overall restaurant readiness.
Ensure timely order preparation, accurate billing, and efficient order delivery.
2. Sales & Business Performance
Drive daily sales and achieve assigned sales targets.
Monitor key performance indicators such as average order value, customer footfall, order accuracy, and sales growth.
Identify opportunities to improve upselling, cross-selling, and customer conversions.
Support cost control initiatives and improve restaurant profitability.
3. People Management & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Team Members and Shift Managers.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective shift scheduling.
Drive employee engagement, attendance, discipline, and retention.
Train team members on product knowledge, customer service, food preparation, and operational standards.
Identify high-potential employees and support their career growth through on-the-job training and development.
4. Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service and a positive dining experience.
Handle customer complaints and resolve service issues promptly.
Maintain service speed, product consistency, and order accuracy.
Build customer loyalty through friendly, efficient, and professional service.
5. Food Safety & Quality
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food handling standards.
Monitor product quality, portion control, freshness, and adherence to recipes.
Ensure proper storage, stock rotation, and expiry-date monitoring.
Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic restaurant environment.
6. Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely stock replenishment.
Minimize food wastage, pilferage, and operational losses.
Conduct stock counts and support inventory reconciliation.
Monitor consumption, food cost, packaging cost, and other controllable expenses.
7. Cash Management & Compliance
Ensure accurate cash handling, billing, POS operations, and end-of-day reconciliation.
Maintain operational records, registers, and reports as required.
Follow company policies and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper handling of cash, inventory, and other company assets.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate preferred; candidates with relevant qualifications and QSR experience may also be considered.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in restaurant operations, preferably in QSR, food service, or retail operations.
Prior experience in team handling, shift management, customer service, and sales performance is preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Customer-first attitude and problem-solving ability.
Sales orientation and business acumen.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of inventory management, cash handling, and food safety.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as per business requirements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of restaurant sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
Food cost, wastage, and controllable expense management.
Employee attendance, retention, and manpower availability.
Food safety, hygiene, and audit compliance scores.
Order accuracy and service speed.
Team productivity, training completion, and internal promotions.
Career Growth
At WOW! momo, high-performing Assistant Restaurant Managers can develop their leadership capabilities and progress toward Restaurant Manager and higher operations leadership roles, based on performance and business requirements.
Why Join WOW! momo?
Opportunity to work with a growing Indian QSR brand.
Performance-driven work culture.
Hands-on operational and leadership development.
Career growth opportunities within the organization.
Join WOW! momo and be part of a team that delivers great food, great service, and a WOW! customer experience every day.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Perform assembly/packing/machining operation as per the SOP and work instruction.
2. Use tooling, gauges and fixtures correctly.
3. Ensure correct components and material are used during the operation.
4. Conduct in-process quality check and report abnormalities to line supervisor.
5. Meet daily production targets while maintaining quality standards.
6. Follow safety rules, PPE requirements and 5s’ practices.
7. Identify and report defect, shortages, and equipment issues timely to supervisor.
8. Support TPM, Kaizen and continuous improvement activities.
9. Maintain production records and traceability documents as per SOP.
10. Need to work on different work stations of Assembly line/machines (multiskilling).

Required Skill:
1. Basic understanding of assembly, packing and machining process.
2. Ability to understand SOP / work instruction/ drawing
3. Knowledge of quality checks and defect identification
4. Teamwork and discipline.
5. Basic problem solving skill.
AboutCompany:
About KBL:
Kirloskar Brothers Limited (KBL) is a world-class pump manufacturing company with expertise in engineering and the manufacture of systems for fluid management. Established in 1888 and incorporated in 1920. KBL is the flagship company of the $ 2.1 billion Kirloskar Group. The market leader in fluid management, KBL provides complete fluid management solutions for large infrastructure projects in the areas of water supply, power plants, irrigation, oil & gas and marine & defense. We engineer and manufacture industrial, agriculture & domestic pumps, valves and hydro turbines. KBL is the only pump manufacturing company in India and the ninth in the world to be accredited with the N and NPT certification by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME).

Description:
Academic Trainer
Company: Next Education India Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Mode: On-site / Field-based (School Visits)
Travel Requirement: 70%80%
Experience: Minimum 1 year
Industry: EdTech / Education Technology

Job Responsibilities
Plan and deliver structured, engaging training sessions for teachers, principals, and academic coordinators through in-person and online formats.
Conduct subject-specific training in assigned areas, including Pre-Primary, English, Science, and Computer Science, using interactive and activity-based teaching methodologies.
Visit partner schools to facilitate teacher training, product implementation, classroom integration, and academic support.
Train educators on the effective use of Next Educations curriculum, textbooks, digital content, learning platforms, and other educational resources.
Demonstrate teaching methodologies, digital tools, coding resources, and classroom-ready activities relevant to the assigned subject.
Develop, update, and maintain training presentations, lesson plans, teaching resources, user guides, and other academic materials.
Provide academic mentoring and guidance to teachers on subject concepts, pedagogy, classroom management, and learner engagement.
Observe classroom practices, assess training effectiveness, collect feedback, and recommend improvements in teaching and learning outcomes.
Conduct assessments, workshops, refresher training sessions, certification programs, and professional development initiatives for educators.
Collaborate with academic, content, product, and technology teams to improve training quality and support curriculum implementation.
Stay updated on curriculum changes, educational technologies, and emerging teaching and learning practices relevant to the assigned subject.
Provide ongoing academic and basic technical support to schools to ensure effective adoption of products and solutions.
Maintain accurate records of school visits, training sessions, attendance, assessments, feedback, and school-wise progress reports.
Travel extensively to assigned locations and schools as required for training and implementation activities.

Qualifications & Preferred Candidate Skills
Bachelors degree in Education, Science, Arts, Computer Science, Information Technology, Early Childhood Education, or a relevant discipline. A Masters degree or relevant professional qualification will be an added advantage.
Minimum 1 year of experience in teaching, academic training, teacher development, or academic facilitation.
Strong subject knowledge and understanding of the relevant school curriculum in the assigned subject area.
For Pre-Primary roles, a sound understanding of early childhood education, child psychology, foundational literacy, numeracy, and holistic development.
For English roles, excellent command of English language, grammar, communication, and language-teaching methodologies.
For Science roles, a strong understanding of school-level Science concepts and activity-based learning methodologies.
For Computer Science roles, familiarity with school-level computing concepts, coding fundamentals, digital learning tools, and programming platforms such as Scratch or Python will be an advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Strong presentation, facilitation, interpersonal, and classroom management skills.
Ability to engage, motivate, and mentor teachers and diverse groups of learners effectively.
Good organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple school assignments and maintain accurate documentation.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively, including 70%80% travel, to assigned schools and locations.
Key Competencies
Academic and subject-matter expertise.
Teacher training and facilitation.
Communication and presentation.
Curriculum implementation and pedagogical skills.
Digital learning and technology adoption.
Stakeholder management and collaboration.
Planning, reporting, and execution.
Adaptability and willingness to travel.

Role Overview:
Lead all engineering, technical maintenance, HSE, and AMC operations at The Client's Powai facility, ensuring a safe, compliant, and high-performing facility environment. Oversee critical building systems, statutory compliance, vendor management, and operational excellence as per Master Service Agreement requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage all technical operations, maintenance, and uptime for site systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, lifts, and water systems
Regularly review asset health, preventive maintenance schedules, system performance, and identify improvement opportunities
Plan and execute all technical preparations for meetings, conferences, client visits, and special events
Perform daily check-ins and inspections around facility to ensure high technical and safety standards
Ensure 100% compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements including labour, fire, EHS, DG, lifts, FSSAI, and environmental laws
Maintain audit-ready documentation, statutory registers, and ensure timely submissions of compliance reports
Develop and enforce SOPs for technical operations, safety procedures, and emergency response protocols
Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) preparedness, conduct drills, and coordinate emergency response procedures
Coordinate and manage AMC vendor partners: validate contract compliance, oversee maintenance delivery, and schedule preventive and corrective work
Review vendor service reports, close technical findings, and ensure quality standards are met
Manage contractors and service providers: qualification checks, safety plan reviews, EHS document control, and ongoing performance monitoring
Conduct regular technical, safety, and risk audits; investigate incidents and drive corrective action closure
Provide staff HSE and safety training; promote safety culture across facility operations
Submit all compliance, audit, incident, and performance reports accurately and on time
Maintain operational and technical records as per contract and regulatory requirements
Drive sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, technology adoption, and continuous service improvements
Collaborate with Facility Manager, site leadership, vendors, and client stakeholders on priorities, procurement, and budget management
Identify and implement best practices to help facility systems perform at optimal levels
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil) or related technical discipline
5-7 years of progressive experience in facilities management, engineering operations, or HSE leadership roles
Strong knowledge of building systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, and critical infrastructure
Understanding of statutory compliance requirements including fire safety, EHS regulations, and environmental laws
Experience with AMC/vendor management, contract compliance, and service delivery oversight
Proficiency in audit management, documentation, and regulatory reporting
Working knowledge of digital FM tools, CMMS, and technical reporting systems
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
Team leadership skills with capability to coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors
Tertiary qualifications in building management, facility management, or business management preferred
Certifications in safety, fire safety, or facility management are advantageous

Description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
Designation: Relationship Officer Tractor
Office Location:
Position description: Primary interface of the bank with the customer as well as the channels for business sourcing
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Achieve assigned targets and productivity requirements - meet the threshold targets on monthly basis2. Generate potential business leads from sourcing channels, follow up and bring it to closure 3. Assess customer profile, visit customer's place, collect necessary documentation and recommend customers to credit for approval4. Ensure physical delivery of vehicle from the dealer/channel partner - stay vigilant about asset jumping/over pricing etc. 5. Follow up and collect deferrals and post disbursement documents in a timely manner. 6. Ensure only Direct sourcing from authorised dealers and empanelled channels - no third party sourcing, includes employees of other banks and financial institutions. 7. Manage relationship with dealers, Commercial Associates, referrals and other sourcing channels to generate business volumes through these channels. 8. Ensure Asset verification and Non starter-Early default cases and build relationships9. Ensure timely servicing of customer service requests

Description:
Company Overview
OYU Green is a global climate solutions leader across 10+ countries, partnering with Fortune 500 companies and developing impactful carbon-reduction & removal projects while directing climate finance to vulnerable communities. Join the climate movementwork across renewable energy, clean cooking, energy efficiency, fuel-switching & afforestation, unlocking carbon revenues and creating tangible impact for a sustainable future.

Role Description
Own relationships. Create opportunities. Drive growth.
As a Client Relationship Executive/Manager at OYU Green, you’ll be based on-site in Bhopal & Gurugram. Client Relationship Executive/Manager is a full-time role focused on managing client relationships, generating new business opportunities, and coordinating with internal teams to support project execution and business growth. The role involves client engagement, lead generation and qualification, business outreach, proposal coordination, pipeline management, documentation, and timely follow-ups from initial contact through project execution.

Roles & Responsibilities
Own client and prospect relationships, understand requirements, address queries, and ensure a smooth experience throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify target clients, partners, and opportunities; conduct multi-channel outreach and nurture qualified leads.
Qualify opportunities, maintain CRM/pipeline records, coordinate meetings, proposals, negotiations, and follow-ups through closure.
Coordinate with clients and internal teams on documentation, deliverables, timelines, and action items to ensure smooth project execution.
Build strategic stakeholder relationships, track market and sector developments, and contribute to outreach, conversion, retention, and revenue targets.
Required Skills
3+ years of experience as a Client Relationship Executive/Manager
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build, maintain, and strengthen long-term client relationships.
Excellent follow-up, stakeholder coordination, problem-solving, and ability to proactively resolve client queries and concerns.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, project timelines, documentation, CRM records, and follow-ups accurately.
Understanding of client requirements, business development opportunities, presentation, negotiation, and effective coordination with cross-functional teams.

Description:
Manage day-to-day dyeing operations on jigger machines for woven fabrics, ensuring production targets are achieved as per the production plan.
Plan and execute dyeing batches based on fabric type, customer requirements, shade specifications, and delivery schedules.
Ensure appropriate selection of dyeing methods and process parameters for different fabrics, including cotton, polyester, viscose, blends, and other applicable materials.
Monitor machine loading, fabric movement, liquor ratio, temperature, pH, dyeing time, and other critical process parameters.
Ensure optimum machine utilization, reduced processing time, and minimum production losses.
Coordinate with pretreatment, colour kitchen, laboratory, finishing, and quality teams for smooth process flow.


B. Shade Matching Process Quality
Ensure accurate shade matching and reproducibility of approved laboratory dips and bulk dyeing batches.
Monitor shade consistency, levelness, colour fastness, and other required quality parameters.
Troubleshoot shade variation, unlevel dyeing, staining, patchiness, barriness, and other dyeing defects.
Coordinate with the laboratory and quality teams for shade approvals, corrections, and reprocessing decisions.
Establish process controls to minimize shade rejections, re-dyeing, and fabric reprocessing.


C. Dye, Chemical Recipe Management
Ensure correct execution of approved dyeing recipes, dosing sequences, and chemical additions.
Monitor dye and chemical consumption against approved standards and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Ensure proper handling, storage, and usage of dyes, auxiliaries, and process chemicals.
Work with the colour kitchen and laboratory teams to improve recipe accuracy and batch-to-batch consistency.

Position: Azure Lead
Location: Hyderabad, Indore
Duration: Full time


Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
Position Summary:
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA or master’s degree is preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
9-14 years of professional work experience with at least 6 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory & Azure Databricks.
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.

Description:
Job Summary
State Consultant - Comprehensive Skills, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, 20 Months, Remote.
Contract type: Consultant. Level: Consultancy. Location: India. Categories: Education.
Contract Duration: 20 Months
Working arrangement: Homebased
Responsibilities
The consultant, while working closely with government institutions, will provide technical support for the integration of the comprehensive skills package into the secondary education system.
More specifically, they will provide support in the following areas:
Contextualization of comprehensive skills package (including service-based learning component)
Development of a capacity building plan for education functionaries including teachers, and facilitate its implementation
Logistics support for printing and distribution of learning materials
Formation and strengthening of state and district PMUs to guide programme implementation including coordination support for research
Requirements
Education: Post-graduate degree in Education/ Social Sciences/ Humanities/ Policy
Work Experience: At least 5 years experience of work in education sector with at least some of those for 21st century skills development
Previous experience of working with education data - data analysis & report writing
Experience of working with Education Government system
Expertise in using MS-Office application software (MS Word, Excel, Power Point) essential, especially Excel
Previous experience of working with the government administration
Location required: To be based in Bhopal for the assignment. Candidates who are not residents of Bhopal but are willing to relocate to Bhopal for this consultancy will need to do so on their own expense
Language Requirements: Good verbal and written communication skills in Hindi and English required
Knowledge/Expertise/Skills: Ability to analyze data, identify bottlenecks to improve systems and provide recommendations
Ability to liaison and advocate with state & district level government officers
Ability to create a database to address contextual needs
Ability to organize, manage and participate within teams
Desirables: Previous experience of implementation of large-scale programmes with government desirable
Ability to navigate, evaluate, and create digital content

In India, it partners with governments, communities, and stakeholders to deliver programs that improve child survival, development, and protection. With a mission rooted in humanitarian aid and sustainable development, UNICEF positions itself as a leading international organization driving social impact and equity for children worldwide.

Description:
Job Summary:
Provides operations leadership for small or medium size warehouse or Distribution Center, shift or department. Manages one or multiple shifts of warehouse operations including transportation and packaging. Provide safe working environment for all Cummins and contract employees. Ensure internal and external customer requirements are met through the Cummins Operating System.
Key Responsibilities:
Provides operations leadership and improvement focus for warehouse operations including transportation and packaging operations driving results, creating and monitoring measures, providing motivation, and setting expectations in safety, quality, production and cost. Communicates with customers, suppliers, shop floor, stakeholders, and staff. Leads annual operating plan, forecasts, and other measurements for Parts Distribution Center operations. Manage and develop supply chain capability; work with employees to set goals in training and development, performance, and career planning. Set the aim for the organization and ensure individual work plans are consistent with supply chain initiatives. Responsible for ensuring Cummins values are demonstrated in the site. This includes championing diversity, community involvement and right environment initiatives. Manage daily operations across functions to ensure a dependable and efficient supply chain. Lead continuous improvement projects that align with Cummins Operating System and Functional Excellence direction and leverage common processes tools, and information systems. Support Corporate Supply Chain initiatives and lead the cross Business Unit planning processes to ensure intra-company alignment. Create common supply chain processes and procedures by establishing collaborative business partner relationships. Approach daily problem solving and continuous improvement opportunities strategically and tactically to achieve performance targets. Develop, understand and improve necessary Key Performance Indicators. Analyze operational trends and develop corrective action plans. Address supply chain failures promptly to ensure operations stability; escalate as appropriate. Prepare and manage an annual operating plan including expense resources, and capital. Manage, coach, and develop staff; work with employees to set goals in training and development, performance, and career planning.
Order Fulfillment, Logistics & Packaging Leader Job Title
Order Fulfillment, Logistics & Packaging Leader
Function
Supply Chain
Location
Manufacturing Site (SEZ/DTA)
Reports To
Supply Chain Leader / Plant manager
Role Purpose
This role is responsible for end-to-end ownership of Customer Order Fulfillment, Site Logistics, and Packaging Engineering for the manufacturing site. The position ensures reliable and cost-effective delivery performance by integrating order management, demand-supply alignment, logistics execution, and packaging design. The role drives customer satisfaction through on-time, damage-free delivery while continuously improving cost, sustainability, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Order Fulfillment (End-to-End Ownership)
Own the complete order lifecycle including:
Sales order booking (RMA, drop shipment, FOC, scrap)
Order modification, release, and hold management
Customer order board preparation and reconciliation
Manage EDI execution and schedule alignment:
Weekly schedule runs and manual scheduling
Reconciliation with customer demand signals
Ensure master data and transaction accuracy:
Customer part cross-reference
Order data integrity and system updates
Lead structured customer communication:
Weekly operational calls
Proactive communication on risks, backorders, and supply commitments
Expectation: Zero surprises to customers; high reliability and transparency
2. Demand-Supply Alignment & Performance Management
Analyze and drive performance on:
Forecast vs actual alignment
Backorders, past dues, and fulfillment gaps
Own key Customer Order Management metrics:
On-Time Delivery (OTD)
Backorder and past due reduction
Prepare and present:
Weekly dashboards and execution reviews
Monthly site reviews and leadership updates
Executive summaries and escalation inputs
Expectation: Strong control tower visibility with data-driven decisions
3. Logistics Management (Inbound & Outbound)
Plan and execute logistics operations for:
Inbound material movements from suppliers
Outbound finished goods deliveries to customers
Coordinate closely with:
Suppliers for dispatch readiness
Planners for prioritization and sequencing
Customers for delivery alignment
Drive logistics efficiency through:
Transport optimization and load consolidation
Reduction of premium freight and expedite shipments
Monitor and act on:
Transit time adherence
Exception management and delay recovery
Expectation: Right product, right time, at optimal logistics cost
4. Packaging Engineering & Optimization (Critical Ownership)
Lead development of new packaging designs for:
New product introduction (NPI)
Changes in product configuration or customer requirements
Drive packaging cost reduction through:
Material optimization
Design simplification and reuse strategies
Identify and eliminate transit damage by:
Root cause analysis of damage incidents
Redesign of packaging solutions
Collaboration with suppliers, logistics providers, and customers
Optimize packaging for sustainability by:
Reducing material usage and waste
Increasing recyclability and reuse
Supporting compliance with environmental standards
Expectation:
Damage-free delivery + lowest packaging cost + sustainable design
5. Pricing & Commercial Governance
Manage:
Finished goods pricing updates through NFA processes
Scrap pricing cycles and revisions
Ensure:
Timely updates in systems
Clear communication to customers and stakeholders
6. Customer Issue Resolution
Lead resolution of:
Customer returns and rejection cases
Short receipt and delivery discrepancies
Coordinate cross-functional teams for timely closure
Expectation: Rapid resolution with strong ownership
7. Cross-functional Coordination
Act as the single point of coordination between:
Planning
Manufacturing
Logistics/dispatch teams
Suppliers and customers
Drive alignment on:
Order priorities and commitments
Shipment decisions, including premium freight
Expectation: One version of truth for order execution
8. Compliance & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to:
SCM ISO requirements
Internal controls and NFA governance
Drive continuous improvement in:
Order management processes
Logistics efficiency
Packaging performance
9. Reporting & Governance
Maintain and update:
SCM KPI dashboards
ASCENT and operations excellence metrics
Lead:
Weekly execution reviews
Monthly governance and performance discussions
Deliver structured, insight-driven reporting
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
On-Time Delivery (OTD)
Backorder and Past Due Reduction
Logistics Cost per Shipment
Premium Freight Reduction
Packaging Cost per Unit
Transit Damage Reduction
Forecast Accuracy
Customer Satisfaction (Responsiveness & Reliability)
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging Engineering, or related field
Master s degree or supply chain certification preferred
Experience
Experience in:
Customer order management in manufacturing environment
Logistics coordination and transportation management
Packaging design, development, or optimization
Exposure to ERP systems and supply chain analytics
Experience working with cross-functional and global teams
Key Competencies
Customer Focus
Drives Results
Decision Quality
Action Oriented
Collaborates Effectively
Manages Complexity
Communicates Effectively
Plans and Aligns
Cost Awareness
Continuous Improvement Mindset
Impact of the Role
Ensures predictable, reliable, and damage-free customer deliveries
Drives cost efficiency across logistics and packaging
Strengthens end-to-end supply chain integration
Enhances customer satisfaction and trust
Supports sustainability and ESG goals
Success Profile
Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery, cost, and damage risks
Drives accountability across supply chain stakeholders
Eliminates firefighting through structured processes
Continuously improves packaging, logistics, and execution performance
Competencies:
Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Carrier Management - Supports and evaluates carrier performance through consistent monitoring of on time pick up, transit time and on time delivery measures to ensure fulfillment by published schedule and rated cost.

Mode Selection - Evaluates and selects appropriate transportation mode and equipment type by lane through shipment volume analysis against business requirements to provide optimal shipping method (balance cost, quality and time).

Trade Knowledge Application - Applies knowledge of relevant trade regulations to Cummins processes and systems to minimize trade risks and costs.

Warehouse Operations - Utilizes warehousing tools, systems, and methodologies to meet defined metrics for inbound and outbound operations of a warehouse.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a project ). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Supply Chain Knowledge - Influences, with the ability to concisely explain and/or elaborate on, the multi-disciplined and end-to-end integration of the flow of information, products, and services to achieve the desired result for the end customer within the first-fit or aftermarket business segments while balancing the tensions of inventory, cost, and delivery.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related subject required. MBA preferred.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Moderate level of relevant work experience required.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

The EHS Trainer is responsible for planning, designing, and delivering training programs related to environment, health, and safety to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards. The trainer plays a critical role in building a strong safety culture by enhancing employee awareness, knowledge, and competencies in EHS practices.
Bachelors degree in environmental science, Occupational Health, Industrial Safety, or related field.
Certification in safety (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA) preferred.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in EHS training or EHS operations in an industrial, construction, or manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of EHS legislation and safety management systems.
Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and training software/tools.
Ability to communicate in local/regional languages is an advantage.

Knowledge of financial products, insurance regulations, and market trends is a plus.

Description:
Job Summary:
To plan and maintain daily supply chain operations for critical suppliers or customers in materials, production, inventory, logistics, customer service, demand management, or order fulfillment. Ensures internal and external customers expectations and requirements are met. Achieving and continuously improving customer service levels, and/or manage inventory levels and targets, and managing supply and demand within the Supply Chain.
Key Responsibilities:
Ensures internal and external customers expectations and requirements are met. Manage the daily operational processes for a critical segment of the supply chain. Eliminate potential supply chain failures as part of the daily planning process. Champion preventive practices to eliminate expediting to supply chain leadership as appropriate to prevent problems. Lead cross functional stakeholders to develop and implement short and mid-term tactical improvements Complies with communication plans and processes to ensure stakeholders needs are met. Leverage common processes tools, and information systems Approve system strategies and advise on changes to planning systems parameters as required. Analyze and interpret KPIs to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Lead Six Sigma and functional process improvement teams. Liaise with functional stakeholders to mitigate mid-term supplier or customer constraints. Mentor and coach supply chain planners. Ensure common processes are being utilized and internal controls are in place
Objectives
Efficiently and effectively manage the end-to-end Supply Chain Operation, from procurement and production, Order Management & Customer Service, Packaging to distribution and logistics.
To create a well-coordinated, agile, and responsive supply chain that meets customer needs, maximizes efficiency, minimizing disruptions and contributes to the overall success and profitability of the organization.
To bring contribution mindset and ensure to set-up the right systems and procedures and align the TEAM for sustainable growth.
Develop and implement a strategic vision for the supply chain that aligns with the organization s overall goals.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve supply chain performance.
Key Responsibilities
Demand and Supply Planning- Collaborate with global teams to understand/track demand fluctuations and adjust supply strategies accordingly.
Develop strategic partnerships with key suppliers, and other external partners to strengthen the supply chain network and enhance overall performance.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including operations, sales, marketing, ME, Project Management and finance, to align supply chain activities with overall business vision.
Optimize warehousing, transportation, and distribution networks to reduce costs and increase efficiency.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the supply chain function.
Implement effective inventory control strategies to minimize stockouts and overstock situations.
Develop and maintain contingency plans to address disruptions and unforeseen challenges.
Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement strategies to achieve financial goals.
Participate in existing and new product planning processes to support product launches.
Continue to move the business to a scalable platform that is effective and efficient and creates a long-term competitive advantage through enhancing the Export business and create a strong pipeline and back-up strategy.

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred
Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills

With a strong emphasis on customer-centric services, digital platforms, and sustainable financing, IIFL Home Finance enables individuals and families to achieve home ownership and long-term financial security.

The ideal candidate should be proficient in creating engaging long-form and short-form videos, understand audience retention techniques, and be fluent in Tamil to effectively edit and review Tamil-language content.
Key Responsibilities
Edit YouTube videos, reels, shorts, and promotional content.
Create engaging storytelling through video editing, motion graphics, transitions, and sound design.
Optimize videos for audience engagement and retention.
Collaborate with content creators, scriptwriters, and production teams.
Add subtitles, captions, graphics, and visual effects as required.
Ensure timely delivery of high-quality video content.
Maintain brand consistency across all video assets.
Manage and organize video files, raw footage, and project assets.
Required Skills
2–4 years of professional video editing experience.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing tools.
Strong understanding of YouTube content formats and platform trends.
Experience in editing Tamil-language content.
Ability to create thumbnails and basic motion graphics is an added advantage.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Mandatory Requirements
Must be fluent in Tamil (Read, Write, and Speak).
Must be willing to work from the office.
Strong portfolio showcasing YouTube or digital content editing work.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with YouTube creators, digital media companies, or content production houses.
Knowledge of YouTube SEO, audience retention metrics, and content optimization.
Reporting To
Manager - YouTube
Employment Type
FTE

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Overview
MRF Tyres (Madras Rubber Factory) is India’s largest tyre manufacturer, established in 1946 and headquartered in Chennai. From its humble beginnings as a small toy balloon unit, the company has grown into a global leader in the tyre industry, with products exported to over 90 countries worldwide. Over the decades, MRF has built a strong presence across India with multiple manufacturing facilities and an extensive dealer network, while steadily expanding its footprint in international markets. The company’s registered office is located at 114, Greams Road, Chennai – 600006, and it operates under the name MRF Limited. Innovation is central to MRF’s success, with a dedicated Research and Design division that serves as a pioneering technology hub, focusing on safety, performance, and advanced tyre design. This emphasis on R&D has enabled the company to consistently deliver high-quality products that meet the diverse demands of passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial trucks, farm machinery, and off-the-road applications. With a strong reputation for reliability, global reach, and technological leadership, MRF continues to stand as a symbol of Indian manufacturing excellence in the international tyre market.

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Internship Trainee

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Job Purpose:
Responsiblefor evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digitalchannels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYCverification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieveseamless, paperless disbursements.
Key Responsibilities:
Evaluate digital loan applications within definedturnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules.
Perform digital KYC, bureau checks, income surrogates,and fraud screening; escalate suspicious cases.
Prepare concise credit notes/CAMs for non-STP orexception cases; recommend decisions as per DOA.
Ensure accurate documentation and track post disbursement document (PDD) closure where applicable.
Coordinate with sales/operations for clarifications,rework, and smooth disbursement.
Monitor early vintage performance/FPD for approvedcases and provide feedback to improve filters.
Adhere to underwriting policy, regulatoryrequirements, and internal audit standards, clear QA observations & PDs ofspecific cases.
Skills Required:
Strong analyticaland decision-making skills.
Knowledge ofretail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency indigital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention todetail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Graduate /Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
13 years incredit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.
