Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer with 10+ years of experience in enterprise network operations, routing switching, and Cisco ACI environments. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale enterprise and datacenter networks. The role requires strong technical expertise in LAN/WAN technologies, Cisco Nexus platforms, Cisco ACI fabric, and network troubleshooting within complex enterprise environments.

Roles Responsibilities
Design, implement, and support enterprise Routing Switching infrastructure.
Manage and troubleshoot Cisco ACI fabric including tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts, and policies.
Configure and support Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, and ISR/ASR platforms.
Perform advanced troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, WLAN, and datacenter network issues.
Handle routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, and static routing.
Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, VXLAN, and trunking.
Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity utilization.
Participate in major incident management and provide RCA for critical outages.
Implement network changes following enterprise change management processes.
Work closely with security, server, cloud, and application teams for end-to-end connectivity solutions.
Support datacenter migration, network transformation, and automation initiatives.
Maintain network documentation, diagrams, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and operations teams.

Professional Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in core routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, HSRP/VRRP, Switching, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, QoS)
Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI deployment and support.
Experience in enterprise NOC or production support environment.
Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.
Experience handling P1/P2 incidents and RCA preparation.
Experience in automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with AI-aided network observability and management tools.
Understanding of Agentic AI frameworks for network operations.
Ability to troubleshoot complex network incidents and infrastructure issues.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
Cisco certifications preferred: CCNP Enterprise CCNP Data Center CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure (preferred)

Additional Information:
The candidate should have minimum 8-10 years of experience in large enterprise network implementation and 3-4 years of experience in Network implementation.
Knowledge of cloud networking (GCP/AWS/Azure).
Experience in large enterprise or global network environments.
A 15-year full-time education is required.
This position is based at our Hyderabad/Bangalore office.

Title: Quality Engineering Lead

Description:
Project Role : Quality Engineering Lead

Project Role Description : Leads a team of quality engineers through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Applies business and functional knowledge to develop end-to-end testing strategies through the use of quality processes and methodologies. Applies testing methodologies, principles and processes to define and implement key metrics to manage and assess the testing process including test execution and defect resolution.

Must have skills :HealthEdge

Good to have skills:Health Insurance Operations
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled HealthEdge Developer to join our healthcare insurance project. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting solutions using the HealthEdge HealthRules platform. The role requires a strong understanding of healthcare insurance business processes, claims, benefits, enrollment, and payer systems.

Key Responsibilities:
-Develop, configure, and customize solutions on the HealthEdge HealthRules platform.
-Work on healthcare insurance processes including claims, benefits, enrollment, membership, providers, and pricing.
-Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into HealthEdge configurations and technical solutions.
-Configure HealthRules applications based on project-specific business requirements.
-Develop and maintain integrations between HealthEdge and external systems.
-Support claims processing, adjudication, benefit configuration, and pricing requirements.
-Perform unit testing, integration testing, defect analysis, and production support.
-Troubleshoot application and integration issues and provide root-cause analysis.
-Collaborate with Business Analysts, architects, developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders.
-Participate in requirement analysis, design discussions, code/configuration reviews, and deployment activities.
-Prepare technical documentation, configuration documents, and support documentation.
-Ensure solutions comply with healthcare industry standards, security requirements, and project guidelines.
Required Skills:
-Hands-on experience with HealthEdge HealthRules or HealthRules Payor.
-Strong understanding of US healthcare insurance/Payer domain.
-Good knowledge of Claims, Benefits, Enrollment/Membership, Provider, and Pricing processes.
-Experience with HealthEdge configuration and customization.
-Experience with healthcare application integrations and APIs.
-Strong SQL skills for data analysis and troubleshooting.
-Good understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, testing, and production support.
-Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Preferred Skills
-Experience with HealthRules Connector (HRC) or HealthRules Integration.
-Knowledge of EDI transactions, including 834, 837, 835, and 270/271.
-Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and integration technologies.
-Knowledge of healthcare standards such as HIPAA and X12.
-Experience working with US healthcare payer clients.
-Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS is an advantage.
-Experience with DevOps/CI-CD processes is a plus.
Experience
-5+ years of overall IT experience.
-3+ years of relevant HealthEdge/HealthRules experience preferred.
-Healthcare insurance/payer experience is mandatory or strongly preferred.
Education
-Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Location
Hyderabad / Bangalore
Work model: Hybrid
Role Expectations
The candidate should be able to work independently on HealthEdge-related development/configuration activities, collaborate effectively with distributed teams, and provide production support when required. Experience working with large-scale US healthcare insurance projects will be highly preferred.

Qualification
15 years full time education

Description:
ETL Testing Engineer
Job Title
ETL Testing Engineer / Data Warehouse Tester
Experience
3 -10 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled ETL Testing Engineer to validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes in data warehouse and business intelligence environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong SQL skills, hands-on ETL testing experience, and expertise in data validation and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business and technical requirements related to data migration and ETL processes.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems to target databases.
Perform data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation testing.
Verify data mappings, transformation rules, and business logic.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects through defect management tools.
Perform regression, integration, system, and UAT support testing.
Validate data quality and consistency across multiple platforms.
Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test metrics, reports, and test execution status updates.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of ETL Testing concepts and methodologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as:
Informatica
SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
Talend
DataStage
Ab Initio
Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation.
Experience with Data Warehouse concepts including:
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Fact and Dimension Tables
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
Experience with database platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
Expertise in data quality and data migration testing.
Familiarity with defect tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
Preferred Skills
Automation experience using Python, Selenium, or ETL automation frameworks.
Experience with cloud data platforms:
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Synapse
AWS Glue
Snowflake
Databricks
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (Hive, Hadoop, Spark).
Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
Performance and volume testing experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Certification in ETL, Data Warehousing, or Database technologies is a plus.

Description:
We have an opportunity to have SAP BTP Administrator - Integration & AI Transformation Manager
Position: SAP BTP Administrator - Integration
Experience Required: 10-16 Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 60 Days
Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad & Chennai
Work Timing: Rotational Shifts (2 To 11)
Required Skills:
1. Design and implement real-time integration strategies connecting SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba to ensure seamless data flow across systems.
2. Deploy and manage SAP AI Core and Generative AI technologies to automate and optimize core business processes.
3. Govern and oversee API management and event-driven architectures using SAP Event Mesh to enable scalable and secure integrations.
4. Architect and maintain robust data orchestration pipelines between cloud platforms and hyperscaler environments.
5. Administer SAP Integration Suite and Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) to build, monitor, and troubleshoot integration scenarios.
6. Develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning models using SAP AI Launchpad and related AI tools to support business needs.
7. Ensure compliance and efficient usage of communication protocols such as REST, SOAP, OData, EDI, and GraphQL in all integration workflows.
8. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities leveraging AI and integration technologies.
9. Monitor system performance and provide continuous improvements for integration flows and AI deployments within the SAP BTP environment.
10. Maintain documentation, provide training and support to stakeholders on SAP BTP administration, API governance, and AI-enabled automation solutions.Experience in SAP Technical Pre-Sales including creation of technical proposals and constructing estimates for SAP Technical work.
11. Knowledge on SAP cloud offerings like BTP, SAC, Cloud connector, etc.
12. Full cycle experience in SAP Migration and S/4 Conversion activities.
13. Strong knowledge and exposure to HANA Database and MS SQL Database.
14. Strong knowledge in BOBI, Data services etc.
15. Proficient in the use of methodologies supported by SAP best practices.
16. Strong knowledge in troubleshooting performance issues and providing solutions to fine tune the system.
17. Must be proactive and self-motivated.
18. Must be easily understood and possess excellent English communication skills, both verbal and writing skills.
19. Must Have customer facing experience and possess good negotiation skills.
20. Exposure to ITIL framework.
21. Provide SME advice to the team and Mentor team members to achieve the desired result by conducting Boot camps, learning sessions, etc.
22. Should have a good understanding of the organization structure and requirements.
23. Develop and maintain process and technical documentation.
24. Prepare and present project status reports to Clients and Senior Management.
25. Must have experience in working with cross functional and cross cultural teams across the globe.
26. Should provide escalation support and ensure all the tasks and issues are resolved within the deadline.

Description:
Hi Everyone,
Hope youre doing well!
We have an urgent opening for a SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant of our esteemed clients.

Experience Required: 10 – 15 Years
Location: Hyderabad,Bangalore,Pune,Mumbai,Noida,Chennai
Employment Type: Full-time
Education: B. Tech / M. Tech / M.Sc. / MCA

Position Overview
Job Descripition:

We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant with 9+ years of expertise in SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, global template rollouts, business process analysis, and SAP implementations. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, conducting workshops, gathering requirements, configuring SAP SD solutions, supporting testing activities, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Lead workshops with business users and stakeholders to define functional requirements.
Configure and support SAP SD processes, including Sales, Shipping, Delivery, Billing, Pricing, and O2C.
Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and global rollout projects.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments.
Support SIT, UAT, defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including MM, FI, WM/EWM, and Logistics.
Create and maintain functional documentation and provide end-user support.
Ensure solution quality, process compliance, and timely project delivery.

Required Skills
9+ years of SAP SD Functional experience.
Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
Experience in SAP implementations, enhancements, and global rollouts.
Expertise in Sales Order Processing, Pricing, Shipping, Delivery, and Billing.
Experience in business process analysis, configuration, testing, and production support.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of SAP integration with MM and FI modules.

Preferred Candidate
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.
Exposure to Agile or SAP Activate methodology.

Description:
Position - Senior Enterprise AI Architect GenAI, Agentic AI & Enterprise Applications
Location : Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai (Hybrid / Work from Office as per project requirement)
Experience : 15–25 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly experienced Enterprise AI Architect who can drive the design and implementation of AI/GenAI solutions across large-scale enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should have experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise business platforms such as:
SAP (S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP AI Core)
Oracle (Oracle ERP, Oracle CX, Oracle Cloud)
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
The role requires a blend of Enterprise Architecture, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, GenAI, Platform Integration, and Business Transformation.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise AI Transformation
Define Enterprise AI strategy and target-state architecture.
Drive AI adoption across enterprise applications and business processes.
Build AI-led transformation roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
Enterprise Platform Integration
Design and implement AI solutions integrated with:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Generative AI & Agentic AI
Architect GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using:
OpenAI
Azure OpenAI
AWS Bedrock
Anthropic Claude
Gemini
Llama
Design autonomous and multi-agent workflows.
Implement enterprise-grade RAG architectures.
AI Solution Architecture
Build scalable and secure AI platforms.
Define reference architectures, governance frameworks, and reusable AI patterns.
Establish LLMOps, MLOps, observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, and Product Owners.
Conduct architecture reviews and technical governance.
Lead client workshops, solutioning discussions, and strategic transformation initiatives.
Must-Have Skills
AI / GenAI
Generative AI
Agentic AI
RAG
LangChain
LangGraph
LLM Integration
Prompt Engineering
AI Governance
Enterprise Platforms (Critical)
Strong hands-on experience in at least one or more:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Cloud Platforms
Azure
AWS
GCP
Architecture
Enterprise Architecture
Solution Architecture
Microservices
API-led Architecture
Cloud-native Design
Preferred Skills
SAP AI Core / SAP BTP
Oracle ERP / Oracle CX
Salesforce AI initiatives
ServiceNow AI integrations
TOGAF Certification
BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, Telecom, Manufacturing experience
AI Center of Excellence leadership
What We Are Looking For
Candidates who have successfully implemented:
AI + SAP
AI + Oracle
AI + Salesforce
AI + ServiceNow
AI + PEGA
rather than profiles that are purely focused on standalone GenAI, Data Science, or AI research.
Summary -
"We are looking for a Senior Enterprise AI Architect who has implemented GenAI/Agentic AI solutions on top of enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, PEGA. The role is focused on enterprise transformation, AI integration, and business process automation rather than standalone AI development."
Detailed Job Description
Position Overview
Tech Mahindra is hiring Senior AI Architects across Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and Bangalore. This role is for senior technology leaders who can define AI architecture strategy, design enterprise-grade solutions, and guide teams from concept to production at scale.
The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on architecture and implementation leadership. It is suited to professionals who can connect business priorities, enterprise platforms, cloud ecosystems, and AI engineering practices into scalable and reusable solution patterns.
Role Purpose
The Senior AI Architect will shape and validate AI-led transformation programs for enterprise clients, with a strong focus on scalable architecture, reusable assets, and outcome-driven solution design. The role is expected to bridge business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, data and AI engineering teams, and delivery leadership across global engagements.
This role requires practical judgment on how AI should be embedded into enterprise landscapes, including business applications, integration layers, governance controls, and production operations. Strong communication with CXOs and cross-functional stakeholders is central to success in this role.
Key Responsibilities
Define target-state AI and data architecture aligned to business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, and transformation roadmaps.
Design end-to-end AI solution architectures covering data pipelines, model development, deployment, monitoring, security, and integration with enterprise applications.
Build scalable and reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, and patterns for enterprise AI adoption.
Evaluate and validate solution options across cloud, AI, and enterprise application platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Lead architecture reviews, technical due diligence, feasibility studies, and proof-of-concept direction for AI initiatives.
Collaborate with business leaders, delivery teams, product owners, security teams, and global stakeholders to shape credible and implementable solutions.
Establish good practices for testing, deployment, observability, lifecycle management, and production support of AI systems.
Drive architectural governance across responsible AI, compliance, privacy, model risk, and enterprise security requirements.
Mentor engineering and architecture teams, influence critical technology choices, and support executive-level solution positioning.
Required Experience
12+ years of overall experience in enterprise technology, architecture, or digital transformation, with strong recent experience in AI/ML solution architecture and delivery.
Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI or ML solutions for enterprise use cases.
Experience across more than one enterprise platform, preferably SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or adjacent enterprise ecosystems.
Experience working in architecture consulting, transformation programs, or complex enterprise modernization engagements.
Demonstrated ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, and multidisciplinary global teams to influence architectural decisions.
Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architecture, security, scalability, and non-functional design principles.
AI And Technical Skills
AI Architecture
End-to-end AI/ML architecture, including data ingestion, feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience with generative AI architecture, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt orchestration, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.
Ability to define reference patterns for recommendation, forecasting, NLP, computer vision, intelligent automation, and enterprise copilots.
Cloud And MLOps
Strong architecture experience on one or more cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Working knowledge of enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices such as experiment tracking, model registry, pipeline orchestration, deployment automation, and model monitoring.
Experience with tools and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow, or equivalent ecosystems.
AI Engineering Stack
Hands-on familiarity with Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools used in enterprise AI delivery.
Understanding of vector databases, knowledge retrieval patterns, API orchestration, agent frameworks, and model integration approaches for production AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services with enterprise applications, data platforms, and middleware layers using secure and scalable design patterns.
Enterprise Platform Expectations
Candidates should bring hands-on architecture or implementation exposure across at least two enterprise platforms or transformation ecosystems. Preferred experience includes SAP BTP or SAP AI capabilities, Oracle enterprise applications and data services, ServiceNow workflow and automation platforms, Salesforce ecosystem integrations, and broader enterprise application modernization patterns.
The role values professionals who can embed AI into enterprise process landscapes rather than treating AI as a standalone lab initiative. Strong grounding in business process transformation, platform interoperability, and enterprise-scale rollout models is important for success.
Leadership And Consulting Skills
Executive presence and the ability to articulate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks, and value realization clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong consulting mindset with structured problem solving, solution framing, estimation support, and transformation roadmap definition.
Ability to lead cross-functional workshops, align distributed teams, and drive decisions in complex, fast-moving programs.
Practical, solution-oriented approach with the confidence to challenge weak designs and strengthen architecture quality before implementation.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required. A master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Preferred Certifications
AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certifications.
AI/ML specialty certifications on major cloud platforms.
Enterprise architecture or platform certifications across SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or related ecosystems.
Work Locations
Hyderabad | Chennai | Pune | Bangalore

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. Description:
Job Title: Lead - Hyperion EPM & BI Infrastructure Administrator
Position: LA / AC
Experience: 10+ yrs.
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad
Position ID: J1026-1164
Work Type: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent
Qualification: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled, self-driven Lead Hyperion EPM & BI Infrastructure Administrator with over 10 years of hands-on experience to own, architect, and single handedly manage our enterprise financial systems and business intelligence infrastructure. In this role, you will be the sole point of contact and technical leader responsible for the installation, configuration, optimization, security, and migration of our Oracle Hyperion EPM Suite, Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).
You will bring deep technical expertise in administering workloads in AWS Cloud, configuring highly secure Single Sign On (SSO) via Shibboleth, and maintaining high availability through custom Apache Load Balancing topologies.

Key Responsibilities:
. End to End Environment Management: Single handedly install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Hyperion EPM (v11.2+), Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).
. Administer Hyperion Foundation Services, Shared Services, Essbase, Planning, ODI , OAS & other internal third party tools & Applications.
. Handle OBIEE/OAS server maintenance, repository (RPD) deployments, security configurations, and configure ODI agents, master/work repositories, and topology executions.
. Develop and maintain automation scripts (MaxL, CLI, ESSCMD, Windows batch, Python, Unix shell) to automate regular maintenance, data/metadata loads, backups, and environment syncs.
. Manage and tune underlying SQL Server databases and Oracle WebLogic Application Servers hosting the middleware
Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure (AWS)
. Configure, scale, and optimize AWS resources including EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, VPCs, and Security Groups.
. Use CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible to build, document, and provision environment stacks programmatically.
. Disaster Recovery (DR): Establish multi AZ high availability, backup policies, AMI custom images, snapshots, and rapid recovery strategies
Web Tier, Load Balancing & Security (Apache & Shibboleth)
. Web Server Customization: Install, configure, and harden Apache HTTP Server / Oracle HTTP Server (OHS) as the entry point reverse proxy.
. Apache Load Balancing: Configure advanced, sticky session based load balancing using Apache module proxies to distribute traffic across clustered WebLogic JVMs.
. Shibboleth SSO Integration: Single handedly implement, configure, and troubleshoot SAML header based Single Sign On (SSO) utilizing Shibboleth Identity Provider (IdP) integration with EPM/OAS/other Third party tools & Applications.
. User & Certificate Governance: Manage SSL/TLS certificates across Apache servers, AWS Load Balancers, and WebLogic keystores.
Special Focus: Vulnerability Monitoring, Tracking & Remediation
. Review and execute quarterly Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPUs) and monthly Critical Security Patch Updates (CSPUs) for Essbase 21c, WebLogic, Hyperion, and Java SE to address critical remote code execution (RCE) and takeover vulnerabilities (such as historical flaws like CVE 2021 2109 or current high severity targets).
. Monitor and remediate vulnerabilities in our DMZ web layer. Implement secure configurations, update Apache load balancers, enforce TLS protocol standards, and patch server-side request.

Must Have Experience:
. 10+ years of professional experience in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Essbase, and BI middleware infrastructure administration.
. Hands on experience with Essbase 21c, specifically configuring independent/standalone instances on top of Fusion Middleware WebLogic infrastructure.
. Proven history of handling large scale infrastructure projects single handedly, from architecture design through to post go live support.
. Production experience hosting enterprise workloads on AWS Cloud (utilizing EC2, VPC, EFS, and EBS).
. High level of expertise configuring Apache Load Balancing with WebLogic cluster plugins.
. Deep understanding of Shibboleth SSO, SAML protocol, and security certificate (SSL) management.
. Complete familiarity with ODI and OAS console, agent, and repository administration.

Job Title: Integration Architect (IDMC (CDI+CAI), BizTalk Server, Azure, SQL Server, PL SQL)
Position: LA / AC
Experience: 18 yrs.
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad
Position ID: J1026-1095
Work Type: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent
Qualification: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

. Understand and document the existing BizTalk Server architecture and integration landscape, including applications, orchestrations, ports, pipelines, maps, schemas, adapters and workflows.
. Analyze end to end interfaces to identify source/target systems, data flows, dependencies, triggers, schedules, SLAs and operational requirements.
. Assess existing integrations for complexity, business criticality, transaction volumes, performance, technical debt and migration risks.
. Develop As Is architecture diagrams, interface inventories and dependency matrices for the existing integration landscape.
. Define the To Be Integration Architecture using Informatica IICS, including CDI and CAI components.
. Develop High Level Designs (HLDs) covering integration flows, connectivity, transformations, orchestration, error handling, security, monitoring and operational requirements.
. Define the BizTalk to Informatica migration strategy and roadmap, including migration waves, prioritization, effort, risks and dependencies.
. Determine the appropriate migration approach for each interface rehost, redesign, consolidate, modernize or retire.
. Guide the conversion of BizTalk orchestrations, maps, pipelines, ports, schemas and adapters into appropriate Informatica IDMC patterns.
. Define reusable integration patterns and standards for API, file, batch, event driven, application to application, synchronous and asynchronous integrations.
. Design and review integrations using REST/SOAP, SFTP, AS2, HTTP/HTTPS, APIs, databases, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files and EDI.
. Define standards for transformations, validations, routing, filtering, enrichment, batching/debatching, acknowledgements and business rules.
. Define integration security architecture, including authentication, authorization, encryption, PGP, certificates, credentials and secrets management.
. Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, audit and compliance requirements.
. Review and approve LLDs, technical solutions, estimates and development deliverables, ensuring alignment with architecture standards.
. Provide technical leadership and guidance to Informatica developers, testing, infrastructure, security, support and external partner teams.
. Define and support SIT, UAT, performance testing, parallel/dual run validation, production cutover, rollback and hypercare activities.
. Act as the Integration Architecture SME, working with business and IT stakeholders to resolve technical risks, define integration roadmaps, drive modernization and support BizTalk decommissioning.
Your future duties and responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design, including current-state assessment and target-state architecture.
• Define and drive the BizTalk-to-Informatica IDMC migration strategy, roadmap, migration waves and technical approach.
• Develop and review HLDs/LLDs, integration patterns, interfaces, security, performance and operational standards.
• Provide technical leadership and guidance to Informatica developers and collaborate with business, IT, testing, infrastructure and security teams.
• Support development, testing, deployment, cutover, hypercare and BizTalk decommissioning, ensuring successful delivery and SLA compliance.

Job Title: D365 F&O System Administrator & Developer
Position: LA / AC
Experience: 5+ yrs.
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad
Position ID: J1026-0778
Work Type: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent
Qualification: Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Functional Consultant to partner with business stakeholders and technical teams in delivering high-quality ERP solutions. The consultant will lead requirement analysis, design, configuration, and testing of D365 F&O modules, ensuring alignment with business processes and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities
Requirement Gathering & Analysis
o Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to capture requirements.
o Perform Fit Gap analysis and propose solutions leveraging D365 F&O standard features.
o Document functional specifications and process flows.
Solution Design & Configuration
o Configure D365 F&O modules such as Finance (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, Budgeting) and Supply Chain (Inventory, Procurement, Production, Warehouse Management).
o Collaborate with technical teams on integrations, reporting, and customizations.
o Support Power Platform components (Power BI, Power Automate) where applicable.
Testing & Deployment
o Define and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
o Validate deliverables against business expectations.
o Assist in cutover, go live, and hypercare support.
Training & Documentation
o Conduct end user training sessions.
o Prepare user guides, functional design documents, and process documentation.

Required Skills & Experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in D365 F&O or Dynamics AX implementations.
• At least 3 full end to end implementations.
• Strong domain knowledge in Finance and/or Supply Chain processes.
• Expertise in functional documentation (FRD, FDD, Fit Gap analysis).
• Hands on experience with Azure DevOps for defect tracking and UAT.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
• Experience with Project Accounting / PMA modules.
• Familiarity with Embedded Copilot and automation features.
• Exposure to cloud hosting (Azure) and reporting tools.
• Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
• Ability to act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders.
• Collaborative mindset with cross functional teams.
• Commitment to quality delivery and proactive communication.

Description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Bangalore,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our .
Key Responsibilities:
Application Engineer:
This position is within the semiconductor process diagnostics and control group, which deals with advanced imaging together with cutting edge image processing algorithms in order to detect and dispose nanometer size defects.
Application engineers are supposed to maximize the performance of our new defect metrology products through a deep and thorough understanding of use-cases in close technical collaboration with leading-edge chip manufacturing customers.
At a higher expertise level, they also contribute to product development roadmap through spec definition and performance validation.
Desired qualification:
Sound fundamentals of high-NA DUV imaging/SEM and light-matter/electron-matter interaction
Open to 70% travel to leading semiconductor chip manufacturing fabs overseas
Lab/fab hands-on experience in semiconductor fabrication with layer-wise detailed knowledge of material, process tech and defectivity
Detail oriented with strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills
Ability to work in a team, and ability to work independently
Functional Knowledge
Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities
Business Expertise
Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work
Leadership
No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members
Problem Solving
Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents
Impact
Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies
Interpersonal Skills
Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
New College Grad
Travel:
Yes, 75% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
Yes

Serve as the technical escalation point for complex field issues, providing rapid resolution and root cause analysis
Develop utilities and scripts (Python) for debugging, workflow automation, and issue isolation
Innovation & Roadmap Contribution

Translate Voice of Customer (VoC) and field learnings into concrete product requirements and roadmap inputs

Masters / Bachelors degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, VLSI, or a related field
25 years of experience in semiconductor process and defectivity, with hands-on knowledge of CAD and design-based inspection concepts
Proficiency in Python; experience building scripts, tools, or analytical workflows
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying them to data analysis or product development
Comfort with GenAI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, and documentation
Willingness to travel ~50% to leading fabs globally
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams

Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Policy Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Policy Center.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Work on Guidewire Policy Center capabilities including policy administration, product configuration, underwriting rules, rating, pricing, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




Your Profile

6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Policy Center applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire modules: PolicyCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across policy and policy integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with PolicyCenter, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in PolicyCenter is preferred.

Description:
Respond promptly to requests from guests and other departments.
Fill cart with supplies and transport cart to assigned area.
Enter guest rooms following procedures for gaining access and ensuring vacancy before entering.
Replace guest amenities and supplies in rooms.
Replace dirty linens and terry with clean items.
Make beds and fold terry.
Clean bathrooms.

Description:
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Servicing Manager I and lead a team that is at the forefront of enhancing our operational services in fund accounting and administration. This role offers a unique opportunity to drive impactful change and innovation within our department. By joining our team, you will have the chance to grow your career, develop your skills, and contribute to the financial security of our clients.

As a Fund Servicing Manager I within JPMorganChase, you will oversee fund servicing operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with established policies. Your leadership will foster a collaborative team culture and drive continuous improvement initiatives, significantly impacting the department. You will leverage your broad knowledge of fund servicing principles to perform diverse activities requiring analysis and judgement, making non-routine decisions with a significant degree of latitude. Your advanced emotional intelligence will enable you to build trusting relationships and establish credibility with peers, managers, and stakeholders.

Job responsibilities
Maintain accurate accounting and securities records for each fund administered, ensuring adherence to all prescribed controls for each fund accounting process.
Investigate and resolve issues where accounting or securities transactions breach the validation tolerances of the JP Morgan system.
Ensure timely production of NAV, accounting validation, and escalate management issues, contributing to the success of the individual s and team s performance.
Provide training to new hires.
Foster a collaborative environment by leveraging emotional intelligence skills to build trusting relationships with peers, managers, and stakeholders.
Propose and implement improvements to current working methods, contributing to the efficiency and resilience of our operating platform.
Required qualifications, capabilities and skills
Demonstrated expertise in fund accounting and administration, with at least three years of experience focusing on maintaining accurate securities records, evidenced by successful management of related tasks and responsibilities.
Proven ability to recognize, prevent, and respond to fraudulent activities, protecting the organization and its clients from financial losses.
Advanced emotional intelligence, with a track record of building trusting relationships and establishing credibility with peers, managers, and stakeholders.
Proficiency in continuous improvement, with experience in applying innovation and design thinking techniques to improve the efficiency, scale, and resilience of an operating platform.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Strong presentation skills for effectively communicating fund performance and insights to stakeholders, and the ability to influence strategic initiatives and foster team collaboration.
Expertise in leading process improvement efforts and managing change initiatives to enhance fund servicing efficiency and adapt to evolving market conditions.
Proficiency in leveraging data and technology literacy to analyze fund data and implement technology-driven solutions.
In-depth market product knowledge to ensure fund services align with industry standards and client needs.
Skilled in overseeing project management activities to ensure timely and successful delivery of fund servicing projects.

Description:
Software Engineer | Navi Mumbai, India
Location :Navi Mumbai (Seawoods)
Work Model: Hybrid
About Us
Founded in 1995, Zema Global Data Corporation empowers organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and make faster, more confident decisions that drive measurable results. Over the past two years, Zema Global has accelerated its growth through strategic investment and acquisition to strengthen our global leadership. Together were helping our customers gain a Decisioning Advantage - one bold idea at a time. With a presence across global energy, commodity, and financial markets, Zema Global empowers customers to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and make faster, more confident decisions that drive measurable results.
At Zema Global, we Think Big, Make It Happen, and Win as One. We thrive on collaboration, creativity, and respect, united by a shared drive to innovate and deliver meaningful impact for our customers and communities. If youre inspired by solving complex challenges and contributing to a culture that values purpose and performance, we invite you to join us.
Position Overview
The Software Engineer plays a crucial role in developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines. This position involves close collaboration with data analysts, and other IT team members to ensure data is captured with the highest reliability and quality. You will be part of a global team of Software Engineers providing 24/7 development and support.
What You'll Be Doing
Develop and manage data feeds by sourcing data from multiple vendors and performing necessary transformations. Hands-on development will be a key aspect of this role.
Implement and advocate for best development practices, innovative frameworks, and technology solutions to accelerate business processes.
Develop, maintain, and support web applications and APIs, ensuring their smooth operation and providing technical assistance to users.
Adhere to best practices in estimation, planning, reporting, and process improvement in daily tasks.
Automate processes wherever applicable to enhance efficiency.
Create and maintain internal documentation for collection processes and frameworks.
What You'll Bring
Essential
0-2 years of proven work experience as a Software Engineer, or similar role.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong proficiency in core Java, Spring.
Experience working with Oracle databases and SQL.
Ability to work with complex data models.
Familiarity with automation and process improvement tools to increase efficiency and scalability in software development.
Strong initiative and ability to work with minimal supervision.
Excellent interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Self-awareness, confidence, and capacity for empathy.
Clear and competent communication skills, both written and verbal
Desirable
Knowledge of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and data warehousing concepts is a plus.
Good understanding of git.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, particularly in deploying and managing data solutions is a plus.
Familiarity with build and deploy pipelines like Jenkins.
Why Join Zema Global?
Global Impact
Shape the future of energy, commodities, and financial markets through innovative technology.
Innovation at Scale
Work with cutting-edge software, advanced analytics, and complex data that solve real-world challenges.
Career Growth
Join a fast-growing global organization where your ideas, development, and career progression are valued.
Exceptional People
Collaborate with talented colleagues and industry experts across North America, Europe, and Asia.
Meaningful Ownership
Take ownership of your work, influence strategic initiatives, and make a measurable impact on our customers and business.
One Global Team
Be part of a collaborative culture built on trust, respect, and our values: Think Big. Make It Happen. Win as One.
Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Equality, Diversity & Inclusion
Zema Global is committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background or protected characteristic
AboutCompany: Zema Global offers complete end to end data, analytics and integration platforms and services to customer engaged in commodities and energy sectors. Accurate data and effective data management are vital components of IT systems that run mission critical business applications. Zema's solutions provide data and analytical information to inform smarter risk, trading and operational decisions.

Description:
Apprentice

Morningstar is looking for an Apprentice, an entry-level opportunity to join our Data and Operations group. This role will help you gain practical experience by working with diverse datasets, including public equity filings, private market transactions, ESG methodologies, Managed Investment Data (Funds), and reference entity data. You'll build your knowledge of investment management, and benefit from structured training to support your growth, setting you up for long-term success.
This position will be based in our Navi Mumbai office. Candidates in this role may need to work in shifts, including night shifts.

How does a typical day at work look?
Search, collect, and verify data of basic and intermediate levels of complexity.
Attend to internal/client queries and requests to ensure data captured is aligned with data methodologies and policy guidelines.
Quickly learn our research methods and process standards to ensure productivity, quality, and timeliness.
Collaborate with your team, cross-functional teams, and external (if required) parties to resolve data issues.

You might be a good fit if you -
Only candidates graduating in 2026 with a Bachelor's degree (preferably in Finance or related non-engineering disciplines) are eligible to apply.
Candidates pursuing or holding professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, CMA, CS, ACCA, FRM, or any similar equivalent course are not eligible to apply.
BE/B. Tech, Postgraduate, and Master's degree holders are not eligible to apply.
Demonstrate strong English communication skills (written, verbal, and comprehension).
Are proficient in MS Office tools, especially Excel and Word.
Learn quickly and process information with ease.
Possess attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and natural curiosity.
Effectively prioritize tasks and perform well under tight deadlines.

Work Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai

Apprenticeship Period: Up to 12 months

Stipend: 22,000 per month

Willingness to work in shifts
Shift 1: 5:30 AM 2:30 PM
Shift 2: 2:30 PM 11:30 PM
Shift 3: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
Shift 4: 8:30 PM – 5:30 AM

Working Days: Monday to Friday (5-day work week)

About Morningstar
Morningstar is a global leader in independent investment research, supporting investors in over 32 countries with more than $300 billion in assets under management. Our mission is to empower investor success through data, research, and technology.
We build products and offer services that connect people to the investing information and tools they need. We are built on the principles of independence, transparency, and long-term thinking. By empowering investor success, we are constantly looking for new ways to help people achieve financial security.
AboutCompany: Morningstar, Inc. is a leading provider of independent investment insights in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. Role Purpose
The Operations GSC Associate is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of backoffice and transactional operational activities supporting the Trailers & Intermodal business within Multi Modal Solutions, across the order-to-billing lifecycle.

Job Title -Customer Care - Admission / OPD

Designation - Junior Officer / Officer / Senior Officer

Department - Clinical Administration

Location - Mumbai

Essential Qualification - Graduate

Additional Qualification - PG / Diploma

Relevant Experience 0-5 years

JOB REQUIREMENT (SKILLS):

• Accountable and resilient
• Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service.
• Ability to work under pressure.
• Flexibility to work as part of the team
• Able to work accurately with an eye for details

JOB PURPOSE:

Ensure that all procedural requirements and formalities in connection with the Admission of patients are quickly and satisfactory
completed to enable them to get admitted within the shortest possible time after their arrival in the hospital.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

• Close and continuous monitoring of outstanding cases.
• Timely referral of cases for obtaining concessions.
• Furnish statistical data relating to admission/ Data analysis of outstanding recoveries/necessary statistical inputs etc. for
information of Management and Finance Department for preparation of revenue budget and forecasts.
• Objective evaluation of Individual staff performance and counseling them periodically.
• Monitors monthly employee schedule ( Officer, Supervisors ,clerks, receptionist and attendant )
• Motivating staff to carry out routine activities and develop special skills for better patient/relative service delivery as well
educating them about the time management, professional etiquette, adaptability of computer usage etc.
• Developing job profiles and reviews if the position is being replaced.
• Study to enhance the processes, reduce waiting time and increase capacity utilization.
• Prepare monthly duty roster of staff.
• To keep a track of optimal utilization of beds.
• To take care of needs and comforts of the patient, while awaiting admission.
• Ensure that the patients are provided with all the information along with the leaflets and booklets pertaining to the
hospital, the services provided by the hospital and the rules and regulations of the hospital.
• Ensure that billing/ refund action is completed well in time, so that the patient/the relatives need not have to wait long by
settlement of Accounts and final discharge should be made to appear as a smooth , swift and pleasant experience to the
patient/ relatives.
• Checking of invoices is raised on credit parties to ensure that they are supported by relevant back up papers before
dispatching them to the costing department. Since the normal permissible credit period is one month from the date of
receipt of invoices by the credit party, it is essential that invoices are dispatched within two days after the discharge of
the patients.
• Ensure that after tallying the credit cards and Cheque collection, their statement are sent to accounts.
• Render assistance whenever manpower shortage is experienced in any area due to staff absenteeism etc. so that the
operative functions go on smoothly.
• Provision of indenting of stationary items from General stores on periodical basis.
• Assign extra or special duties to staff whenever is required.
• To maintain liaison with the sister-in-charge and unit clerk of the patient floors to know the general nature and extent of
treatment given , in order to ensure that the expenses already incurred on the treatment of the patients are always well
within the advance amounts collected from them.
• Sending the complete TPA/corporate files on time to finance department.
• Coordinating with corporate for resolving the queries regarding the admission or the procedure.
• Ensuring all the reports are properly send to report dispatch and the department is functioning smoothly.
• Ensure the smooth admission, OPD procedures for the High profile patients.
• To be part of the Quality Improvement initiative and protocols of the organization.
AboutCompany: Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, Andheri West, Mumbai
CompanyAddress: 0, Mandke Foundation, RAO SAHEB ACHUTROA PATVARDHAN MARG, 4 BUNGLOW Andheri West, Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Maharashtra, 400053, MUMBAI, Maharashtra, India

Insurance

Position:IT Security Associate - Governance, Compliance and Risk
Job Description:About the Role
Arrow Electronics is looking for a Governance, Risk and Compliance apprentice to join our IT Risk and Governance team in India. This role is built specifically for a student who has completed a university degree and who wants to learn how information security governance actually works inside a global technology distributor, rather than only in a textbook. You will sit with the team that owns Arrow's security certifications, risk framework and compliance programs, and you will contribute to live work from your first month.
We do not expect you to arrive knowing our frameworks. We expect curiosity, care with detail, and the willingness to ask questions in a room full of experienced practitioners. Everything else is taught, and your schedule is designed around your coursework and examinations.
About the Team
IT Risk and Governance is part of Arrow's Enterprise Security Services organization. The team maintains the Information Security Risk Management Framework, owns the security policy and standards library, runs third-party and vendor risk assessments, and delivers the certification programs that Arrow's customers and contracts depend on. Our current portfolio includes the global ISO 27001 certification program spanning the Americas, EMEA and APAC, CMMC Level 2 readiness for our aerospace and defense business, TISAX assessments for automotive customers, and the consolidation of our GRC tooling onto a single platform.
The team is deliberately small and global. Members include information security architects, IT compliance analysts, a data security analyst and project managers, working across US, EMEA and APAC time zones. The apprentice reports to the Director, IT Risk and Governance and works day to day alongside a compliance analyst and a security architect.
What You Will Work On
The work is real and it changes with the program calendar. Over the course of the apprenticeship you can expect to contribute to several of the following.
Evidence collection and tracking for the global ISO 27001 certification program, including chasing outstanding artefacts from control owners and keeping the evidence register current.
Support for CMMC Level 2 readiness activities, such as maintaining control status trackers and helping assemble documentation packages ahead of assessment milestones.
Third-party and vendor risk assessments: reviewing questionnaire responses against our Vendor Risk Assessment Standard and flagging gaps for an analyst to validate.
Migration and data quality work as we consolidate our GRC tooling onto a unified platform, including mapping controls between frameworks and cleaning up legacy records.
Maintenance of the security policy and standards governance library, including formatting, version control and tracking annual review dates.
Preparation of recurring reporting, including program status summaries and metrics that go to security leadership.
Key Responsibilities
Keep assigned trackers, registers and evidence repositories accurate and current, and raise items that are slipping before they become escalations.
Draft clear, concise summaries of findings and status for review by an analyst, architect or the director.
Follow up with control owners and other stakeholders across Arrow to request evidence, clarify responses and confirm closure of open items.
Compare documentation and questionnaire responses against published Arrow standards and applicable control frameworks, and record where they do not line up.
Handle confidential and restricted information with the discretion the classification requires, and complete all assigned security training on time.
Attend program stand-ups and take accurate notes, actions and owners.
Ask when something is unclear rather than guessing, and tell your mentor early when coursework will affect your availability.
What You Will Learn
This apprenticeship is structured as a learning path, not an administrative placement. By the end of twelve months a successful apprentice should be able to do the following.
Explain how an ISO 27001 certification cycle runs end to end, from scoping and evidence to external audit and corrective action.
Read a control framework such as ISO 27001 Annex A or NIST SP 800-171 and trace a requirement to the evidence that satisfies it.
Run the first pass of a vendor risk assessment against a published standard.
Work confidently inside a GRC platform, including control mapping, task assignment and reporting.
Write for a security leadership audience: short, factual, and clear about what changed and what needs a decision.
Who We Are Looking ForRequired
Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program at a recognized university in India, with at least one academic year remaining at the start of the apprenticeship.
Studying a relevant field such as information technology, computer science, cyber security, information systems, engineering, commerce, law or business administration. We hire for aptitude, not for a single degree.
Strong written and spoken English, since most of the team and its stakeholders are outside India.
Comfortable with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams, and willing to learn new tools quickly.
Genuinely careful with detail. Much of this work is the difference between an assessment that passes and one that does not.
Available for the agreed weekly hours and able to overlap with colleagues in EMEA and the United States for part of the week.
Preferred
Coursework, certification study or project work touching information security, audit, risk management or data privacy.
Familiarity with any control framework or standard, including ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, PCI DSS or GDPR, at an introductory level.
Exposure to a GRC, ticketing or project tracking platform, or to basic data handling in Excel or Power BI.
Student leadership, campus club, hackathon or volunteer experience that shows follow-through.
An interest in continuing in security governance after graduation. Strong apprentices are our first consideration for entry-level openings on the team.

What’s in for you
On the job skill-based training, projects, assignments, opportunity to learn new skills.

Customer Service Executive
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales?
Join our team at Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties !!!

Location : Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore) • Position Type : Full-time
Salary Range : Up to 2 LPA to 3 LPA
About Us NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Handle inbound customer calls and address their queries. Understand and fulfil customer needs for satisfaction. Build trust through clear and interactive communication. Provide accurate information using proper tools. Resolve complaints promptly and offer appropriate solutions. Follow up to ensure issue resolution. Maintain records of customer interactions and accounts. Adhere to communication guidelines and policies. Go the extra mile to engage and delight customers.
Perks & Value Proposition: Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company. . Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter. Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers. Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years. Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers: Education: Graduation or HSC qualified. Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills. Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred. Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word). Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.


Why Nobroker? At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape. Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Description:
Job description
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
03 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.
CompanyAddress: A-Wing, 15th Floor, Amar Business Zone, Near Swati Park, Veerbhadra Nagar, Baner, Pune, Maharashtra 411069

Description:
Job Summary
ISS STOXX is hiring an Index Data Research Analyst to join the dynamic Index Data Research team for our Mumbai (Goregaon East) location.
The team is responsible for the research of specific datasets and ensures its accuracy before being used in the maintenance of Indices under ISS STOXX Index mandate. The successful candidate will liaise with ISS STOXX Index Operations for day-to-day Index Data Research activities. The successful candidate will also work in close collaboration with various ISS STOXX stakeholders to ensure best practice and compliance with Index Operations Department activities, new rules definition based on clients requirements and coordination of the automation processes with the IT department.


Shift hours
6:00 AM to 3:00 PM IST (First Shift)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST (Second Shift)
2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST (Third Shift)


Responsibilities
Dividend Data Validation: Searching for procuring and processing information about global companies on a regular basis using multiple methods, techniques, and sources (Data Vendors and internet Data research on Issuers & Listed Companies in various languages). Investigate, challenge Data providers sources, and collaborate with them to ensure the integrity and timeliness of data (verification and challenge of provided information).
Quality Assurance & Controls: Perform regular audits and checks to maintain high data integrity, adhering to internal control frameworks and regulatory standards.
Process Documentation & Compliance: Maintain clear documentation of workflows and controls in line with EU BMR and IOSCO principles.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with global stakeholders and internal teams to resolve data discrepancies and support operational excellence.
Project Participation: Contribute to team-wide initiatives and projects assigned from time to time, including automation, tool enhancements, and data quality improvements.


Qualifications
Bachelors degree or above in finance, economics, data analysis, mathematics, or IT related subjects.
Up to 2 years of Experience within Financial Markets Industry, Indices, and investment products & Portfolio Management.
Has strong organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize and follow established guidelines.
Ability to communicate and work effectively in a result-oriented, team-driven organization.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data interpretation.
Be able to work under pressure and to handle multiple tasks time-efficient and autonomously in parallels and work on tight deadlines.
Be able to work and learn autonomously without minimum supervision and training (self-starter/self-learner).
Be a team-player, orientated attitude and ability to act as a proactive, independent team player with hands-on mentality.
Knowledge of MS Office applications; VBA, Python, SQL skills would be a plus.
Knowledge of market data vendors (i.e., Refinitiv, Bloomberg, SIX, ICE etc.) would be a plus.

Description:
Group Company: Galaxy Surfactants Limited (GSL)
Summary: Techno-Regulatory Process It is a dedicated Process (Department) formed to function as a single-point contact for our customers worldwide in order to provide Techno-Regulatory Support, Ensuring Techno-Legal Compliances, and maintain Quality of Doing Business through strategic technical and regulatory acumen.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory Compliance a) Working on REACH registrations. b) Registration /pre- registration/notification of chemicals in various countries as per regulations Example: REACH (EU, Korea, Turkey, Eurasia, and many other countries) c) SDS Authoring: Preparation and amendment of Safety data Sheet- in different formats d) GHS and UN compliance e) Working on non-Animal testing methods (e.g. QSAR, Computer Modelling, in-vitro) f) Haz Communication: Preparation and amendment of hazard labels and DG labels g) Understanding of regulations relevant to our industries personal care and home care (chemicals) and ensuring compliance to those regulations., CLP, Cosmetic Regulation, Detergent regulation, Transport regulations (IMDG, IATA), GHS, etc. h) Handling customer questionnaires and queries related to global regulations i) Product certifications Halal, Kosher etc.
2. Techno-legal Compliances: - Provide product pre-qualification and post-qualification regulatory documentation support, to our specified Domestic and International customers globally. - Taking care of Techno-legal compliance work viz. HS Code classification, FDA, FSSAI, Pharmacopoeias, GRAS, Natural Product Certification, BIS, ICH, Regulatory listing/status of products/components, etc. as required by the Organization for Mandatory compliance and for Future Business Growth - Leading Product Liability Management System - Development of standard product dossiers of Galaxy Products and its periodic reviews. - Developing Document Management Systems and Automation programs to fasten the customer responses - Hazardous Material Management System - Interacting/Visiting/closely working with Key customers to understand their requirements - Closely working with internal teams (QA/RD/Manufacturing) in implementing the regulatory support requirements and also suggesting new leads to them. - Keeping abreast of new product guidelines/restriction and work with internal teams for its implementation

3. Product Stewardship Product stewardship as a practice where all those involved throughout the value chain of a product take responsibility to understand and effectively reduce the Risk related to SHE, Quality, and Business, and to enhance value delivery to customers on key areas including the following: a) Portfolio Value Positioning: it involves Data mining, Customer requirements trends, Benchmarking, and Automation b) Competition Product profile Mapping c) Undertaking technical campaign on various improvement themes d) Working on global Product Eco-attestations / % Naturalness / Renewal Carbon Index e) New product requirements e.g. Generally recognised as Safe, Free-from specific impurities, product claims, etc.
