Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.
Engage with potential clients to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering guidance and support throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded.
Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective strategies for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones.
Provide accurate and timely information to clients regarding products, services, and pricing.
Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for business growth.
Utilize CRM systems to track and manage client interactions and sales activities.
Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.
Engage with potential clients to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering guidance and support throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded.
Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective strategies for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones.
Provide accurate and timely information to clients regarding products, services, and pricing.
Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for business growth.
Utilize CRM systems to track and manage client interactions and sales activities.
Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.
Assist in maintaining compliance with all pharmaceutical storage and distribution guidelines.
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.
Experience:
Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience for D. Pharma holders.
Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.

Description:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
Experience with enterprise learning technology including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
Excellent technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
Bachelors degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture certification or equivalent experience preferred.

Description:
Hiring: Customer Support (CS) & Service Desk (SD) JL2 / JL3

Job Locations: Bangalore & Pune
Work Mode: Work from Office (Mandatory)
Shift: 247 rotational shifts with rotational weekly offs

Salary Budget

- JL2: Up to 3.5 LPA
- JL3: Up to 5.5 LPA

Job Description

We are looking for candidates for Customer Support (CS) and Service Desk (SD) roles who can provide excellent customer service, handle customer queries, and resolve technical and service-related issues. Candidates will act as the first point of contact for customers and service users, assisting them through voice calls, chat, email, and other support channels.

Key Responsibilities

- Handle customer queries and resolve issues through calls, chat, and email.
- Act as the first point of contact for customer and service-related requests.
- Understand customer concerns, analyse problems, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
- Provide technical support for laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation.
- Assist with Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory-related issues.
- Handle requests related to information, system access, and other services.
- Demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Resolve customer issues independently, efficiently, and professionally.
- Maintain good time management and ensure a positive customer experience.
- Be proactive and demonstrate respect for customers' time.

Eligibility Criteria

- Qualification: Any full-time graduate with 15 years of formal education.
- Experience: 15 years, depending on the job level and profile.
- Candidates with prior technical support experience must have at least 1 year of Service Desk Technical Support experience.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Experience in laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Willingness to work in a voice support process and 247 rotational shifts.
- Rotational weekly offs and work from office are mandatory.
- Candidates must have completed double vaccination, as specified in the JD.

Note: Candidates will be screened according to the relevant CS or SD profile, experience, technical skills, and applicable salary budget.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and passionate Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have experience working across both frontend and backend technologies, possess strong problem-solving skills, and be capable of collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Design, build, and manage backend services, APIs, and databases.

Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.

Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
Integrate third-party services and APIs as needed.
Continuously evaluate and implement emerging technologies and best practices.

Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.

Experience with cloud platforms:

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have
Experience working in enterprise-scale applications.
Exposure to AI/ML integrations.
Knowledge of serverless architectures.
Experience in DevOps and infrastructure automation.

India's leading brokerage-free real estate
SELLER BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE (BDA)
Job Description | Field Sales
CompanyNoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.LocationBangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, PuneExperienceMinimum 1 year and smart freshersWork ModeFull-time | Field-basedLanguagesEnglish / Kannada English / Telugu English / Tamil English / Hindi ¢ English / MarathiCore Focus: Field Sales
ROLE SUMMARY
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.
ELIGIBILITY
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory
Smart freshers / Experience up to 2 years in field sales.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
Bike and valid Driving License.
Smartphone.
Candidates should be comfortable communicating in at least one of the required language combinations: English/Kannada, English/Telugu, English/Tamil, or English/Hindi.
PREFERRED SKILLS
Field Sales ¢ Business Development ¢ Lead Generation ¢ Customer Relationship Management (CRM) ¢ Negotiation ¢ Client Acquisition ¢ Relationship Building ¢ Sales Closing ¢ Site Visits ¢ Communication Skills ¢ Target Achievement ¢ Time Management
READY TO BUILD YOUR CAREER IN REAL ESTATE SALES?
Join a field-driven role where you will engage property owners and customers, conduct site visits, and contribute directly to successful property transactions.

We are seeking highly experienced Technical Business Analysts to support a large-scale enterprise data and analytics transformation programme within a leading global bank.

Leadership

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing algorithm engineering team.

Partner with software, HPC, and systems engineering teams across India and United States to deliver scalable and high-performance solutions.
Drive end-to-end ownership of algorithm development, from concept and prototyping through integration, optimization, qualification, and product release.
Collaborate with global teams to leverage common infrastructure, shared technology platforms, and best practices.

MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline.
10+ years of experience algorithm development on large-scale hardware-centric system.
3+ years of technical leadership experience.
Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.
Experience with algorithm development for large-scale hardware-centric systems.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on expertise in computer vision, ML/DL algorithms, and imaging systems

Description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
Role Responsibilities:
Analyze requirements, design, develop, and maintain complex software solutions.
Own feature development from design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
Define software specifications, architecture, and test strategies for new features.
Troubleshoot complex software issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement robust fixes.
Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Collaborate with product management, cross-functional teams, and customers to understand requirements and manage dependencies.
Drive engineering best practices, technical excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Minimum Qualifications & Requirements:
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field.
6+ years of experience in software product development.
Strong expertise in Core Java and modern Java features such as Streams, Functional Programming, Concurrency, and Virtual Threads.
5+ years of hands-on experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem.
4+ years of experience in software design, including HLD, LLD, OOAD, Design Patterns, SOLID, GRASP, Clean Code principles, and code reviews.
4+ years of experience designing and developing Microservices or SOA-based systems.
Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (like RabbitMQ), and asynchronous distributed systems.
Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization.
Experience using AI-powered engineering tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Rovo or similar tools to improve SDLC productivity.
Working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Willingness to travel to customer sites in the US, Taiwan and Korea as required.
Preferred Qualifications:
Semiconductor or Metrology/Inspection domain experience.
Experience in UI/front-end technologies (React, Angular, etc.).
Experience with workflow orchestration frameworks such as Temporal, Apache Airflow, or similar platforms.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
Yes

Description:
Power conversion - R&D Project Manager
Business Information:
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 R&D engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. IDC collaborates with the R&D and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries. In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.
Job Description Summary
As our R&D Project Manager you will become one of the key persons in organizing the delivery of power quality solutions to the rest of our organization. In this role you will work directly with cross-functional team members to ensure that our solutions are delivered and executed in alignment with the overall delivery project priorities
How You'll Make an Impact
You will hold the overall responsibilities for the management of assigned R&D project within the power conversion business.
Act as key contact for the project. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Managing and follow up suppliers.
Define all project plan deliverables, including scope, financial plans, and schedule.
Ensure that the project follows execution best practices and Hitachi Energy policies. Effectively monitor and control project progress and efficient resource utilization.
Monitor and control project financials according to budget and forecast of R&D work within the Power conversion domain.
Manage administrative tasks related to project management.
Stakeholder relations: Acts as key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues. Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicates with all stakeholders.
Health, safety, and environment (HSE): Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies.
Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
Proven experience in project management for R&D in software/control system development, preferably within power conversion, grid integration, or high-power converter control software domains.
Possessing a Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification, along with relevant project management experience, is considered an additional advantage.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, SAP and Microsoft Project.
Highly proactive, organised, and structured working style, with a strong focus on quality, traceability, and delivery commitments.
Strong ability to lead cross-functional and globally distributed teams, coordinating across control engineering, software, hardware, testing and cybersecurity teams.
Excellent risk, issue, and change management capability.
Excellent ability to resolve issues, lead teams and work constructively with external and internal relations.
Confident leadership presence with the ability to guide teams through complex technical challenges and field escalations
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

 Website

Job Description
Do
RESPONSIBILITIES
    Acting as a SPOC for the Customer to provide the status update whenever a major incident occurs 
    Driving the MI Bridge through involving all relevant Resolver Groups and continue the discussions till the Major incident is resolved
    Informing the key stakeholders on the status of the Major incident and after getting the confirmed service restoration.
    Coordinating with the respective SMEs for speedy resolution of the Major Incident
    Ensuring the Major incident is resolved within the SLAs agreed with the Customer
    Taking all the preventive actions to minimize the service and business impact in case resolution time seems to be high.
    Conducting a thorough analysis and preparing the Major Incident Report (MIR) for every Major Incident after it is closed.
    Ensuring that all the resolution procedures are updated in the knowledge database / Work log
    Conducting a review meeting with relevant members to identify the triggers for the Major Incidents, what caused them, and how to prevent such Incidents happening in future.
    Ensuring that the causes for all Major incidents are analyses and root cause is identified (through coordinating with problem Management process)
    Coordinating with the process managers (capacity manager, Availability manager, IT Service continuity manager, etc.) on need basis to avoid reoccurring of the major incidents
    Providing the periodical (monthly) reports on the overall status of the Major Incident Management Process.
    Conducting the training / knowledge sharing sessions across the teams/new joiners to avoid occurring of the major incidents
KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
    8-10 years exp in driving the service operations. 
    Min 8 year of experience in managing the IM and MIM processes
    Preferably ITIL Expert, or Min two ITIL Intermediate certified professional
    Strong analytical, communication, presentation and reporting skills
    Good leadership, people management and operational skills
    Should have exposure to ITIL practices.
    Good written & verbal communication skills
    Experience in helpdesk environment
    Highly motivated individual, with a positive & pro-active attitude to work, and willingness to make changes to improve operational efficiency through, innovation, process and procedure, and adopting and adapting ideas and practices from elsewhere
    Ability to work in shift and flexible schedule 
    Ability to motivate staff 
    Excellent team skills with ability to listen and contribute to discussions and meetings
    Building & Maintaining Relationships 
    End to end ownership for customer satisfaction through levels of support
    Planning and organization & working well with Virtual Team 
    Virtual Team Management Skills
    Relationship Management for services and vendors interface

Description:
The opportunity:
Hitachi Energy is a world leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure, and we collaborate with customers and partners to enable a sustainable energy future - for today's generations and those to come.
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy to date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
How you'll make an impact:
You will be a part of the GIS Steel Structural Engineering team, you will be supporting as project lead engineer to develop project specific engineering documents and drawings for submission to customer and the documents required for manufacturing of Steel Support Structures for GIS equipment (transmission and sub-transmission systems).
You will be an individual contributor who would deliver the tasks as per the given inputs and when required need to work in coordination with other colleagues and should exhibit good collaborative skills to complete the task.
You may also interact with other departments like Primary Engineering, Secondary engineering, Project Management and Production units.
Project Planning and coordination with various internal & external stakeholders for a smooth project execution.
Preparation of Design calculation (in Staad. Pro, Idea-static & Hilti profits) of Steel Support Structures for Gas Insulated Switchgears above 66kV. (Contribution to Tekla modelling will be mandatorily required in certain projects).
Ensure all necessary inputs are available from stakeholders.
Prepare project specific Civil plan for customer providing GIS loading for design of customer building floor, ceiling cranes etc., Influence of environmental conditions on GIS structure designs etc.
Self-review & peer review of documents.
Delivery of designs on time with Quality and coordinating with the other team members and project lead engineer.
Directly responsible for maintaining and updating the documentation for respective projects as per quality process.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your background:
Years of experience: 8 - 10 years with B.E/M.E. in Civil & Structural Engineering.
Hand on experience in Structural engineering using STAAD. Pro, Idea-static, Ansys & Hilti Profits software's.
Hand on experience in Tekla, Navisworks and other modelling software's.
Familiarity with codes and applicable standards necessary for Structural Modelling & Detailing (American, European, Canadian etc.) is Mandatory.
Team player with good communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge tools like AUTOCAD, MS Office etc.
Knowledge of Galvanization & painting procedures.
Knowledge of HSE standards like OSHA, DIN etc.. is mandatory.
Knowledge of international standards such as IEC/ IEEE / ANSI is preferable.
Knowledge of HV substation / HV products preferable.
Working knowledge of Tekla structures is an added advantage.

SAP FICO - Senior Consultant

Experience: 3-8 Years
Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Kolkata, Bangalore, Trivandrum, Kochi, Coimbatore

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled SAP FICO Senior Consultant with strong experience in SAP Finance and Controlling modules. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP implementations, client interactions, solution design, testing, and support activities across ECC and/or S/4HANA environments.

Mandatory Skills
3-8 years of hands-on experience in SAP FICO.
Minimum 1 end-to-end SAP implementation experience is mandatory.
Experience in Greenfield and/or Brownfield implementation projects.
Strong expertise in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience in core FICO areas:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Bank Accounting
Cost Centre Accounting
Profit Centre Accounting
Experience in business requirement gathering, configuration, and solution design.
Hands-on experience in preparing Functional Specification Documents (FSDs).
Experience in UAT planning, execution, defect management, and user support.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
Experience supporting Go-Live, Hypercare, and post-production activities.

Responsibilities
Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
Configure and support SAP FICO processes as per business needs.
Conduct Fit-Gap analysis and recommend best practices.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams.
Support integration with other SAP modules.
Lead and assist UAT activities and business user training.
Support deployment, cutover, and Go-Live activities.
Engage directly with customers and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Good to Have
SAP FICO Certification.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation or migration projects.
Exposure to data migration and cutover activities.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Note: Candidates must have experience across at least one full-cycle SAP implementation from requirement gathering/design through Go-Live and Hypercare support.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Hiring for Data Bricks Developer

Responsibilities
A day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment
You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

Description:
VP Project Management / Delivery

Location: [Mumbai /Pune/Chennai)

About the Role:
We are looking for a seasoned delivery leader to head large-scale content and learning solution projects across global EdTech clients. The AVP will own end-to-end program delivery, drive operational excellence, ensure client success, and scale delivery teams for high-quality, on-time, and profitable execution. This role requires a strong blend of strategic leadership, client management, and delivery governance in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Delivery Leadership
Own end-to-end delivery of digital learning, curriculum, and content development programs
Manage multiple large and mid-sized projects across enterprise and university clients
Ensure delivery within scope, schedule, cost, and quality benchmarks
Establish scalable delivery frameworks, SOPs, and governance models
2. Program & Portfolio Management
Oversee a portfolio of projects with cross-functional teams (IDs, SMEs, media, tech, QA)
Drive effective resource planning, utilization, and capacity forecasting
Monitor risks, dependencies, and escalations; implement mitigation strategies
Track delivery KPIs, SLAs, and financial performance (margin, cost, productivity)
3. Client & Stakeholder Management
Act as executive delivery SPOC for key enterprise and EdTech accounts
Lead client reviews, QBRs, and governance calls
Manage expectations, change requests, and long-term engagement growth
Partner with Sales/Presales for solutioning and transition of new projects
4. Team Leadership & Capability Building
Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional leads
Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability and outcomes
Drive capability development in instructional design, digital content, and learning technologies
Set performance goals and career paths for delivery teams
5. Process Excellence & Quality
Define and enforce delivery standards, quality frameworks, and review mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and automation
Implement tools and best practices in project tracking, collaboration, and reporting
Ensure compliance with client, data security, and process standards

6. Financial & Operational Ownership
Own delivery P&L levers: effort estimation, cost control, margin optimization
Improve productivity through process optimization and AI-enabled workflows where applicable
Support budgeting, forecasting, and revenue realization
Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree
15–20 years of experience in Project / Program / Delivery Management
Digital learning / eLearning development
Curriculum and content production workflows
Proven experience managing large teams (30–100+) and multi-million-dollar portfolios
Experience working with global clients
Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models
Key Competencies
Strategic delivery leadership
Executive stakeholder management
Program & portfolio governance
Risk & escalation management
People, leadership, and talent development
Data-driven decision making
Operational excellence mindset

Description:
Technical Operations Manager (JL5)
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Technical Operations Manager
to lead a team of Technical Support Engineers supporting Adobe Experience Manager
(AEM), Adobe Commerce (Magento), DAM, Scene7, and related cloud technologies. The
successful candidate will be responsible for driving operational excellence, managing
customer escalations, developing technical talent, and ensuring exceptional customer
experiences across a global support environment.
This role requires a blend of strong people leadership, technical expertise, business
acumen, and customer advocacy. The Manager will partner closely with Product,
Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Customer Success teams to deliver world-class
support services while continuously improving operational performance and customer
satisfaction. The role will oversee support domains including AEM, Commerce Cloud, CMS
technologies, web infrastructure, performance troubleshooting, and enterprise customer
support operations.
Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Talent Development


Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Support Engineers.
Drive employee engagement, coaching, career development, and succession
planning initiatives.

¢
¢
Conduct performance reviews, goal-setting discussions, and regular feedback
sessions.
Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, collaboration, and customer
obsession.
Build technical and leadership capabilities within the team through structured
learning and development programs.
Service Delivery & Operational Excellence
¢
Own day-to-day support operations and ensure consistent delivery against service
level agreements (SLAs).


¢
¢
¢
¢
Monitor and improve key performance indicators including CSAT, SLA attainment,
resolution time, backlog health, and escalation volumes.
Drive operational governance through regular business reviews, performance
analysis, and action planning.
Identify trends, risks, and recurring issues to proactively improve service outcomes
and customer experience.
Ensure compliance with support processes, documentation standards, and quality
expectations.
Customer & Escalation Management
¢
¢
¢
Serve as the primary leadership escalation point for critical customer issues and
service-impacting incidents.
Champion customer needs and advocate for customer success across internal
teams.
Lead high-severity incident management, ensuring timely communication,
stakeholder alignment, and issue resolution.
¢
¢
Build strong relationships with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders.
Drive customer retention through exceptional support experiences and proactive
engagement.
Technical Leadership
Provide leadership and guidance for complex technical issues involving:
¢
o

o
o

o
o
o
Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
Adobe Commerce (Magento)
Content Management Systems (CMS)
Cloud Infrastructure
Enterprise Web Applications
Performance Engineering

Integrations and Migrations

Review and guide troubleshooting eorts involving:
o

o
JVM Performance Tuning
Heap Dump Analysis
Thread Dump Analysis
Web Application Performance
Database Performance Issues
Infrastructure Challenges
Security Vulnerabilities
¢
Partner with Engineering and Product teams to resolve product defects and drive
permanent corrective actions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
¢
¢
¢
¢
Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Customer
Success, and Professional Services teams.
Inuence product improvements by sharing customer feedback, recurring issues,
and enhancement opportunities.
Participate in strategic initiatives, product readiness programs, and support
transformation eorts.
Drive alignment across global teams to improve customer outcomes and
operational eiciency.
Knowledge Management & Continuous Improvement
¢
Drive creation and maintenance of knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides,
runbooks, and operational documentation.
¢
¢
¢
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) reviews for critical incidents and recurring issues.
Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and service innovation.
Promote a knowledge-sharing culture to improve rst-contact resolution and
reduce escalations.
Required Qualications


Education
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology,
Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience
¢
¢
7-12 years of experience in enterprise software support, cloud operations, technical
services, or customer support organizations.
¢
Minimum 2 years of experience leading technical support or customer-facing
engineering teams.
¢
¢
Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, cloud, CMS, or e-commerce platforms.
Proven experience managing customer escalations and service-critical incidents.
Technical Expertise
Strong understanding of:

Cloud Hosting Platforms and SaaS Architectures

Data-Driven Decision Making
Continuous Improvement Orientation

Ability to Lead During Ambiguity and Critical Situations
Excellent Communication and Presentation Skills
Success Metrics
Success in this role will be measured through:

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to lead a highly skilled team supporting some of the world's most
recognized digital experience and commerce platforms. You will play a critical role in
shaping customer success, driving operational excellence, inuencing product
improvements, and building the next generation of support leaders and technical experts.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced QA Analyst/Test Engineer with strong P&C Insurance and Claims domain knowledge. The candidate should have hands-on experience in functional testing and end-to-end validation of insurance applications.
Key Responsibilities:
Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
Perform Functional, SIT, Regression, and UAT testing.
Test P&C processes including Policy Issuance, Underwriting, Claims, Billing, Endorsements, and Renewals.
Execute test cases, identify defects, perform retesting, and track defects to closure.
Validate integrations between insurance applications and third-party systems.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and collaborate with BA, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders.
Prepare testing status, metrics, and risk reports.
Required Skills:
3+ years of Functional Testing experience in P&C Insurance applications.
Strong knowledge of Policy Administration, Underwriting, Claims, Billing, Endorsements, and Renewals.
Experience in test case design, execution, defect management, and reporting.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/IT/Engineering or related field.
Good to Have:
Experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter.
Guidewire implementation, migration, transformation, or upgrade experience.
Guidewire certification is an added advantage.
AboutCompany:
BANGALORE STRATEGIC SOLUTIONS PVT LTD was originally started in the year 1999, as BANGALORE SOFTWARE SERVICES, Re Purposed in 2021 and has since ventured 20 years into the Manufacturing, Non IT and BFSI Staffing domain, providing services, solutions and products to Enterprises worldwide.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - EWM / WM Senior Associate, you will be at the forefront of delivering impactful solutions within our SAP Supply Chain and Operations practice. You will engage with clients directly, leveraging your skills to address complex business challenges from strategy to execution. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will utilize a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from industry trends, enhancing client engagements and driving process quality.
As a Senior Associate, you will develop meaningful client connections and anticipate their needs, using critical thinking to navigate complex situations. You will guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages growth and learning. Your role will involve maintaining professional standards and adapting to diverse perspectives, all while building your personal brand and technical skills.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team that supports global delivery capabilities, providing cost-effective services that enhance client engagement processes. Your contributions will be pivotal in upholding the firm's code of ethics and business conduct, confirming quality and relevance in all deliverables.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing complex supply chain processes to identify areas for improvement and optimization
- Leading the implementation of SAP Supply Chain Management solutions to enhance operational efficiency
- Coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver client-focused supply chain transformation projects
- Utilizing data modeling and analysis to support demand forecasting and inventory management strategies
- Developing procurement strategies and managing project budgets to achieve cost efficiency
- Overseeing warehouse management system implementations to streamline operations and reduce lead times
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to foster professional growth and development
- Building and maintaining relationships with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions
- Applying critical thinking to solve unstructured problems and drive process improvement initiatives
- Leveraging industry trends and insights to inform strategic planning and decision-making.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Requirement - Business Analyst
Hexagram FinTech, a products company in the Investment Management space is looking for young and energetic Functional Specialists to supplement the current product team. The product is deployed in several of the top mutual fund and insurance companies in India and South East Asia and will expose you to the capital markets in these regions.
Finance professional with 2+ years of experience in any Financial Services Industry viz; Asset Management / Portfolio Management / Wealth Management / Mutual Fund / Treasury and other related industry are preferred.
Exposure / Understanding of the following areas is a pre-requisite:
• Understanding of all asset classes (Equities, Bonds, Derivatives, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds , Forex etc.) and examples of each type
• Attributes of each of these asset classes.
• Investment Accounting (General Ledger)
• Understanding of various types of corporate actions
• Understanding of NFO, IPO, Primary Market, Secondary Market etc
• NAV Calculation
• Various types of fees associated with a trade and basic understanding of each fees
• Basic understanding of how accounting is done for each type of transaction.
• Knowledge of Pricing, Valuation, Gain / Loss computation, Interest computation, Amortization, Reconciliation and Reporting
• Knowledge of SQL / Microsoft Excel / Microsoft PowerPoint / Microsoft Word.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Part of the Functional team at Hexagram and will be responsible for Implementation of Hexagrams software products at its client sites
• Assisting the product development team in Testing and validation of functionality
• Providing support to existing clients on the products
• As part of Implementation, will be responsible for supporting the users in user acceptance tests, conducting user training, coordinating with Technical teams, documenting user requirements, assisting in data reconciliation and reporting
• Manage releases from the product team to the client installations, conduct detailed tests, contributing to continuous enrichment of user guides / manuals
• Ability to work as per clients working hours.
Educational Background: Graduate / Post Graduate in Finance
Should be either from BA background or accounting background.
Experience in Front/ Mid /Back end roles on Investment System is a plus.

Mail your resume to rizwan.basha@kfintech.com
AboutCompany: KFintech serves the mission-critical needs of asset managers with clients spanning mutual funds, AIFs (alternative investments), pension, wealth managers and corporates in India and abroad. The company provides SaaS based end-to-end transaction management, channel management, compliance solutions, data analytics and various other digital services to asset managers across segments, as well as outsourcing services for global players.

Job description
Roles and Responsibilities
Manage key client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.
Develop and execute account plans to drive business growth and revenue expansion.
Collaborate with internal teams to deliver exceptional client service and support.
Identify new opportunities for upselling and cross-selling within existing accounts.
Analyse market trends and competitor activity to inform strategic decision-making.
Desired Candidate Profile
4 -8 years of experience in Key Account Management or a related field (e.g., Client Account Management).
Proven track record of success in managing multiple clients simultaneously.
Strong understanding of Key Client Management principles, including relationship building, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively under pressure, prioritising tasks efficiently while meeting deadlines
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.
