Position: Assistant Manager Sales & Specifications
Saint Gobain India Pvt Ltd- Insulation Business (Glasswool & Stonewool)

Role Purpose
To drive sales and business growth for Saint-Gobain Insulation by engaging key stakeholders such as Architects, Structural Consultants, PMCs, and Contractors, and converting project opportunities into revenue.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver sales targets (volume, value, profitability) in industrial and building segments
Develop strong relationships with Architects, Structural Consultants, PMCs & OEMs to drive product specifications
Generate, track, and convert a strong project pipeline/inquiry database
Influence projects at design stage and ensure conversion of specifications to orders
Provide techno-commercial solutions including thermal/acoustic calculations and energy-saving proposals
Prepare and close technical and techno-commercial bids independently
Collaborate with HVAC, PEB, insulation contractors, drywall and roofing partners for system-based solutions
Drive product differentiation and convert alternative insulation materials to SG solutions
Coordinate with internal teams for seamless execution and market feedback

Key Requirements
Experience in PEB / HVAC / Process Industry preferred
Strong network with Architectural & Structural consultant community
Good career stability
AboutCompany: Saint-Gobain INDEC (International Delivery Centre) is part of the Saint-Gobain Group, a global leader in sustainable construction and building materials. Its key areas include SAP, application development, data engineering, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure management, enabling digital transformation and operational efficiency across the organization.

Python programming
Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering

Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Search and vector databases

Git, Docker, and SQL/NoSQL databases

LLM fine-tuning and model evaluation
MLOps / LLMOps
NLP and machine learning fundamentals
Production monitoring using Azure monitoring tools
Experience with enterprise-scale AI deployments

Description:
Engineering Senior Specialist - Reliability

Are you a highly motivated, creative individual and passionate about sales and proposals
Would you like to be a part of successful team

Join our team!
Baker Hughes is a leading global provider of reliability solutions. We work with the world s largest resources, power, utility, and manufacturing companies. Pioneers of best practice approach, we are fundamentally changing the way Industry manages reliability to achieve a step change in asset performance.

Partner with the best
We are looking for a senior level RCM consultant and reliability engineer. Candidates should be a highly effective coach and mentor, and skilled in training others in reliability methodologies and approaches. Our RCM (Reliability-Centred Maintenance) and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) consulting services help industrial facilities identify equipment failure risks and build data-driven maintenance plans.

As an Engineering Senior Specialist - Reliability, you will also be responsible for:
Applying a wide variety of reliability techniques across diverse industries and client organizations.
Managing projects and demonstrating leadership capabilities in influencing and developing others.
Acting as an advisor and coach/trainer in a wide variety of reliability methods and approaches.
Actively engaging in business development with a deep understanding of the different approaches to ASM and APM and how to identify the optimal outcomes for client success.
Leading by example, creating multiple options to achieve optimal outcomes and demonstrating behaviors which enhance the success of others.
Working as part of a team and often as a team leader, to lead and influence fellow Engineers and Consultants.
Applying broad knowledge of principles and practices in a specific practice area. Independently evaluating, selecting, and adapting standard techniques, procedures, and criteria.
Acquiring general knowledge of principles and practices of related fields, and ability to function on multidisciplinary teams.
Working on multiple projects of moderate size or portions of major projects.
Fuel your passion!
To be successful in this role you will:
Hold a bachelor s degree in engineering or STEM Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math).
Have at least 10 years of professional experience.
Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory for cross-border communication and client-facing roles.
Be willing to travel as required nationally and internationally (up to 25%).

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Engineering Senior Specialist - Reliability

Company Profile:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
Job Title: SAP Basis Consultant
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Experience: 5 -10 Years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: General
Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Position ID:
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
Position Description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior Consultant – SAP Basis & SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) with expertise in SAP Cloud ALM to design, implement, administer, and optimize SAP landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in SAP Basis administration, SAP BTP services, cloud integration, system monitoring, and lifecycle management. You will work closely with functional, technical, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing SAP environments.
Responsibilities:
Administer, maintain, and support SAP Basis landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments.
Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain SAP systems including S/4HANA, ECC, and NetWeaver.
Implement and manage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services and subaccounts.
Configure and support SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, implementation, operations, and integration scenarios.
Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
Manage transport management, client administration, and system refresh activities.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams for SAP deployments, upgrades, and migrations.
Ensure system availability, security, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance with SAP best practices.
Support SAP integration with cloud and third-party applications.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in production support and on-call activities as required.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years of experience in SAP Basis Administration.
Strong hands-on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP).
Experience implementing and administering SAP Cloud ALM.
Expertise in SAP system installation, upgrades, patching, kernel upgrades, and migrations.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, ECC, NetWeaver, and HANA Database administration.
Strong knowledge of transport management, client administration, and system monitoring.
Experience with SAP security concepts, user administration, and authorizations.
Knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and database administration.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting SAP workloads.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with SAP Solution Manager.
Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite and SAP Cloud Connector.
Experience with automation and scripting using Shell, Python, or PowerShell.
SAP Basis, SAP BTP, or SAP Cloud ALM certifications.
Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
Life at CGI:
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons
Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Job Description: iOS Developer
Job Title: iOS Developer
Experience: 5to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Swift, iOS SDK, and mobile application development with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party libraries/services.
Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following coding standards.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Ensure applications comply with Apple's App Store guidelines.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Swift.
Expertise in iOS SDK, UIKit, and/or SwiftUI.
, Interface Builder, and iOS development tools.
Good understanding of MVC, MVVM, VIPER architecture patterns.
Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks.
Knowledge of Core Data, SQLite, UserDefaults, and data persistence.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems.
Understanding of mobile security, memory management, and performance optimization.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Push Notifications).
Knowledge of XCTest, Unit Testing, and UI Testing.
Experience with CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or Carthage.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Published applications on the Apple App Store.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Agile environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Keywords: Swift, Objective-C, iOS SDK, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, REST API, Core Data, Firebase, MVVM, Mobile App Development, Git, XCTest, App Store Deployment.

Job Summary
Seeking a Senior Specialist with 7 to 11 years of experience in project governance to ensure effective project delivery and alignment with organizational goals.
Responsibilities
Lead and oversee project governance frameworks to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to monitor project progress and implement best practices.
Utilize expertise in project and program management to support project planning and execution.
Analyze project performance data to identify risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the project management processes.
Facilitate communication between stakeholders to ensure transparency and alignment.
Support senior management in decisionmaking through detailed reporting and insights.
Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies throughout project lifecycles.
Establish and maintain project governance structures and processes.
Monitor project milestones deliverables and timelines to ensure successful completion.
Provide guidance and mentorship to project teams on governance best practices.
Coordinate with program managers to align project objectives with overall program goals.
Conduct regular project reviews and audits to assess compliance and performance.
Identify potential issues and escalate risks to appropriate stakeholders.
Prepare detailed project reports and presentations for senior leadership.
Facilitate governance meetings and workshops to drive stakeholder engagement.
Ensure continuous alignment of projects with strategic business objectives.

Description:
Years of Experience
5-9 Years

Position Requirements
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling expert with hands-on solution design, configuration, testing and deployment experience; preferably with an accounts/finance and cost/management accounting background.
Strong, demonstrable expertise in CO sub-modules: CO-CCA (Cost Center Accounting), CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting), CO-PC (Product Costing) product cost planning, standard cost estimates, cost estimate with/without quantity structure, mixed costing, variance analysis, WIP calculation, and settlement — Material Ledger (ML) and Actual Costing — multi-level actual costing run, periodic unit price, alternative valuation runs, parallel currencies/valuations — along with Profitability Analysis (CO-PA — costing-based and/or account-based), Internal Orders, and Overhead Cost Controlling, alongside FI-GL, FI-AR, FI-AP, Asset Accounting and ICMR.
Proven, hands-on experience configuring Controlling building blocks end-to-end: cost element/cost center hierarchies, activity types and planning, allocation cycles (assessment/distribution), costing sheets, cost component structures, Material Ledger activation and actual costing configuration, and profitability reporting structures.
Full lifecycle exposure to Product Costing and Material Ledger solutions — from requirement gathering and design (blueprinting/fit-gap), through configuration, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover, and post-go-live deployment support.
Ability to mentor and manage multiple teams and projects, with CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design ownership across workstreams.
Participate in design discussions, providing deep expertise on SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling capabilities (e.g., universal journal-based CO-FI real-time integration, margin analysis, Material Ledger as the valuation backbone in S/4HANA).
Work with business/controlling users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions for cost allocation, product costing, inventory valuation, and profitability reporting.
Develop a collaborative, cohesive team culture with a “One Team” mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance, Controlling and management accounting processes, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop, configure and test integrations between CO/Product Costing/Material Ledger and other modules — MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly cost flows from procurement, production, and project systems into Controlling and inventory valuation objects.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable real-time transactional-level matching.
Understanding of AIF, field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Hands-on experience in S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR), backed by a solid accounting, finance, and controlling background.
Demonstrated functional experience in Intercompany Reconciliation processes in SAP.
Knowledge and experience implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

Preferred Knowledge
Hands-on, configuration-level knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling, including Product Costing and Material Ledger, other integration workstreams, CFIN, and ICMR, with the ability to drive projects through full design-configure-test-deploy cycles.
Understanding of different project delivery methodologies, especially Agile and Scrum frameworks, applied to CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design and testing cycles.

Preferred Skill
Hands-on configuration and design experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with demonstrable depth in Controlling (CO), Product Costing, and Material Ledger design, configuration and testing.
Familiarity with onsite/offshore delivery models and hands-on experience across system landscape environments (e.g., Dev/QA/Prod, transport management for CO/Product Costing/ML configuration).
Familiarity with Implementation, Support, Rollout, and Training delivery models — including testing phases specific to Product Costing and Material Ledger (cost estimate testing, actual costing run validation, integration testing across MM/SD/PP, UAT, and cutover/deployment support).
Familiarity with role matrix/role testing and ability to assist technical team members on CO/Product Costing/ML-related developments (reports, BAdIs, enhancements).
Familiarity with both Waterfall and Agile approaches to software/configuration delivery.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ownership and commitment, flexible timings.
Expertise in JIRA and Agile delivery model.

Professional and Educational Background
Senior Associate — 5-9 years of experience.
5+ years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance with a strong Controlling, Product Costing and Material Ledger component, with a minimum of 2 end-to-end implementations involving CO/PC/ML design, configuration, testing and deployment.

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Job Summary
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive
We re a global, multi-disciplinary team that s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment


Responsibilities
Build and evolve Jenkins pipelines to automate build, test, packaging, and deployment.
Administer Git repositories and Gerrit reviews; define branching, tagging, and release strategies.
Maintain consistent build environments; use Docker to containerize and standardize pipelines.
Integrate static code analysis and quality gates (e.g., CodeSonar) and drive remediation with teams.
Manage artifacts in JFrog Artifactory, including versioning, promotion, and retention policies.
Orchestrate release readiness with development, QA, and validation; plan and execute customer releases.
Ensure end-to-end traceability from source to builds, tests, artifacts, and deliveries; craft clear release notes.
Troubleshoot CI/CD issues and lead continuous improvement and automation initiatives.


Requirements
Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins.
Strong proficiency with Git and code review workflows (Gerrit preferred).
Practical experience with Docker for build and runtime environments.
Expertise managing software artifacts with JFrog Artifactory.
Familiarity with static code analysis and quality tools (e.g., CodeSonar, SonarQube, Coverity).
Solid scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Groovy) and comfort with YAML and REST-based integrations.
Working knowledge of release management and SDLC practices using tools like Jira and Confluence (IBM RTC a plus).
Able to work from Bangalore.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
A systems thinker who connects code, builds, tests, and releases into a seamless flow.


Skills
Jenkins CI/CD pipelines
Git and code review workflows (Gerrit preferred)
Docker for build and runtime environments
JFrog Artifactory
Static code analysis tools (CodeSonar, SonarQube, Coverity)
Scripting (Python, Bash, Groovy)
YAML and REST-based integrations
Jira and Confluence (release management and SDLC practices)
IBM RTC a plus

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity:
At Ericsson, we re passionate about building software that solves problems. We count on our DevOps Engineers to drive excellence and reliability into our products and services.
As a leader in DevOps, you will lead a team focused on delivering automation and DevOps solutions and implementations in customer NW for 4G and 5G product portfolio for different Business Cases.
What you will do:
- Gather and analyze metrics from both operating systems and applications to assist in performance tuning and fault finding.
- Partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.
- Participate in system design consulting, platform management.
- Create sustainable systems and services through automation and uplifts.
- Balance feature development speed and reliability with well-defined service level objectives
- Rollout automation in customer environment
- Good in troubleshooting during the Live Node Activities
The skills you bring:
Work with the development teams to design scalable, robust systems using cloud native architectural principles.
- Build automation using industry standard tools to deploy hundreds of different services.
- Outstanding collaboration, communication, and innovation skills!
- Develop, manage and maintain automation assets of the Service Delivery Global DevOps Platform
- Develop automation to manage platform infrastructure, applications, and services.
- Continuous improvement of Platform reliability, quality, uptime, and Customer Satisfaction
- Provide primary operational support, lifecycle management, and engineering Platform systems and services.
Required Qualification:
- Git (Must have) GitLab (Preferred) Azure DevOps GitHub Ansible (Must have) Puppet/Chef, Cloudflare (Access), SonarQube (SAST) Docker (Preferred) Artifactory, OSs and Enterprise Environments, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04-RHEL 7/8 (Must have) Kubernetes, Python (Must have) Bash Scripting (Must have) json/yaml.!
- Project management and methodologies
- Scrum, Agile and DevOps ways of working (Preferred)
- Experience with public cloud platforms i.e. Azure, AWS, GCP
- Expertise in DevOps pipeline orchestration and automation
- Experience with common software development tools, such as- Source Code Management, Configuration Management, Security and Compliance, Registries and Artifact Repos, OSs and Enterprise Environments, Desired Programming languages, Monitoring Tools.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, thats why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled API Test Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of APIs. The candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and automating API test cases using modern testing tools and frameworks.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and execute API test cases for REST and/or SOAP services
Perform functional, integration, regression, and performance testing of APIs
Validate API responses, status codes, headers, and payloads
Automate API test cases using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or Karate
Work closely with developers and product teams to understand API requirements
Identify, report, and track defects using defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA)
Validate data consistency across services and databases
Participate in CI/CD pipeline integration for automated tests
Ensure API security and authentication testing (OAuth, JWT, etc.)
Create and maintain test documentation and reports
Required Skills
Strong understanding of API testing concepts
Experience with REST APIs, JSON, XML
Hands-on experience with tools like:
Postman
SOAP UI
RestAssured / Karate / Newman
Knowledge of HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)
Experience with automation frameworks
Understanding of status codes and API validations
Basic knowledge of databases (SQL queries)
Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines
Strong analytical and debugging skills
Good to Have
Programming knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript
Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner)
Understanding of microservices architecture
Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes
Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber)
Education
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
Soft Skills
Strong communication skills
Detail-oriented mindset
Ability to work in Agile/Scrum environment
Problem-solving attitude
Tools & Technologies
API Tools: Postman, SOAP UI
Automation: RestAssured, Karate
CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions
Defect Tracking: JIRA
Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI-enabled products.
Required Skills

Hands-on experience with LLMs, GenAI frameworks, and AI application development.
Expertise in Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, and Agent Orchestration.
Experience integrating REST APIs, SDKs, and enterprise platforms.
Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong knowledge of Data Engineering, SQL, ETL pipelines, and Vector Databases.
Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP, or similar AI frameworks.

Your Role

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Architect with 15 years of experience in Salesforce development and architecture to design, lead, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing Salesforce solutions. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working within Agile development methodologies.



What You'll Love About Working Here

Shape your career with flexible career paths and internal mobility across the Capgemini Group.
Access comprehensive wellness benefits, including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage, and new-parent support.
Work on cutting-edge Salesforce projects with global clients, contributing to solutions that address complex business, societal, and environmental challenges.

Description:
Strong hands-on expertise in cloud-native architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices and event-driven design, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and API-led integration patterns. Proficient in designing for scalability, resilience, high availability, and observability, with strong command of DevOps/CI-CD practices and security protocols (OAuth2, JWT, mTLS). Technical Architecture Skills
Strong businesstechnology alignment, with the ability to translate business capabilities into target architecture and solution architecture blueprints
• Ability to articulate complex architecture constructs (microservices, distributed systems, integration patterns) to business and technical stakeholders
• Expertise in driving architecture governance, design reviews, and ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards
• Analyze system landscapes, legacy architectures, and technical constraints to design scalable, resilient, and cloud-native solutions
• Demonstrate technical leadership, ownership, and accountability while mentoring teams and enforcing engineering best practices

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AI Engineer – Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving software and product innovation within our Technology Consulting practice. You will focus on developing innovative software solutions that enhance business performance and drive digital transformation for our clients. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will leverage your growing business knowledge to identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm, leading with integrity and authenticity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and identifying the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system, effectively mentoring others, and addressing conflicts or issues with clients and team members. You will uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading software engineering projects to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance
- Designing, coding, and testing applications using Python, React Native, and Flutter to deliver exceptional user experiences
- Managing application development and lifecycle management to optimize software solutions
- Implementing microservices architecture to improve system scalability and reliability
- Developing solution architecture and system software to support innovative product development
- Overseeing software project management to confirm successful planning, budgeting, and execution
- Mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in difficult conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
- Validating professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct
- Encouraging the use of innovative technologies and methodologies to enhance delivery and inspire teams
-Proven delivery of production full-stack systems (React + Python) and AI/ML or GenAI solutions
-Strong architectural judgment across front-end, back-end, and LLM/agent orchestration
-Deep familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, ReAct) and LLM orchestration
-Experience with enterprise integrations, distributed systems, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and security best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Excelling in application development and software design
- Utilizing Python and scripting languages for innovative solutions
- Managing software project lifecycles with Agile methodologies
- Leading teams in microservices architecture and system development
- Developing solutions with React Native and Flutter frameworks
- Troubleshooting complex issues in software engineering environments

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job description
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:Driving NetPromoter Score
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs plan
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company
training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to
execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions
are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards
SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
Store upkeep & maintenance

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role: 
To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Must have Smart Phone, Bike & Helmet
2. Candidate must have a zeal for Growth
3. Candidate should have good market knowledge
4. Must have done a Channel Sales Role before with 5 Member Sales Team handled before
5. Must understand concepts of distribution, expansion, metrics
6. Must have experience in getting team earn Lucrative Incentives

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. More than 3 years experience in Channel & Distribution
2. Team handing experience is a must
3. Good in Excel & data tools required in Sales

Education:
Graduate or above / Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
2. Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3. A solid 360-degree feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.

A Day in the Life
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
This is a temporary position.
Responsible for performing and supporting research for teams operating within a service group, product group and/ or project group.

Provides analysis, reporting and internal communication services with team members.
Develops knowledge of industry and organizational processes.
OFFICE SUPPORT CAREER STREAM: Individual contributors who provide organizational related support or service (administrative or clerical) for other members within the organization. The majority of time is spent in the delivery of support services or activities, typically under supervision.
DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS
Autonomy: Entry-level position typically requiring little to no prior experience.
Works on well-defined administrative and clerical tasks.
Work is routine or follows standard procedures and is closely supervised.
Organizational Impact: Works to deliver on day-to-day objectives with some impact on achievement of results for the job area, including limited disruption or expense.
Delivers job responsibilities following a defined standard output or set of procedures.
Innovation and Complexity: Provides data and information when minor changes may be required based on review.
Problems faced are routine and solutions clearly prescribed.
Communication and Influence: Communicates with contacts typically within immediate job area.
Obtains and provides information requiring little explanation or interpretation.
Leadership and Talent Management: N/A Job at this level are focused on self-development.
Required Knowledge and Experience: Requires no or little job knowledge of systems and procedures.
0 years of experience required.
Physical Job Requirements

Recruitment Fraud Alert
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses.

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com .

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role: 
To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Must have Smart Phone, Bike & Helmet
2. Candidate must have a zeal for Growth
3. Candidate should have good market knowledge
4. Must have done a Channel Sales Role before with 5 Member Sales Team handled before
5. Must understand concepts of distribution, expansion, metrics
6. Must have experience in getting team earn Lucrative Incentives

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. More than 3 years experience in Channel & Distribution
2. Team handing experience is a must
3. Good in Excel & data tools required in Sales

Education:
Graduate or above / Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
2. Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3. A solid 360-degree feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.
