Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
Designation: Relationship Officer Two Wheeler
Office Location: Ferozepur Road Ludhiana Ludhiana
Position description: Primary interface of the bank with the customer as well as the channels for business sourcing
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Achieve assigned targets and productivity requirements - meet the threshold targets on monthly basis 2. Generate potential business leads from sourcing channels, follow up and bring it to closure 3. Assess customer profile, visit customer's place, collect necessary documentation and recommend customers to credit for approval 4. Ensure physical delivery of vehicle from the dealer/channel partner - stay vigilant about asset jumping/over pricing etc. 5. Follow up and collect deferrals and post disbursement documents in a timely manner. 6. Ensure only Direct sourcing from authorised dealers and empanelled channels - no third party sourcing, includes employees of other banks and financial institutions. 7. Manage relationship with dealers, Commercial Associates, referrals and other sourcing channels to generate business volumes through these channels. 8. Ensure Asset verification and Non starter-Early default cases and build relationships9. Ensure timely servicing of customer service requests

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead Sourcing Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-

We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India
Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Lead implementation and execution of procurement processes with existing and new vendors/ partners
Develop detailed sourcing strategy and category plans to maximize effectiveness and efficiency
Embrace change, utilize and champion new & existing digital tools and portals applicable to the role.
Build and maintain strong relationships with local suppliers to ensure reliable and consistent steel supply.
Lead negotiations to achieve the best possible pricing, payment terms, and cost efficiencies through volume aggregation and strategic partnerships.
Ensure that all procured steel products meet the company's quality standards and comply with industry regulations.
Continuously monitor steel market trends, price fluctuations, and emerging risks to inform procurement strategies and make informed purchasing decisions.
Conducting supplier reliability assessment, developing KPIs, joint action plan and providing feedback to identify areas of improvement
Identify potential supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure continuous steel supply and business continuity.
Continuously assess and improve procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce lead times, and drive cost savings.
Provide updates about procurement related progress and potential delays on a daily basis to the Sourcing/ Category Lead
Exposure of MSME universe preferably in the Raw Material procurement sector.
Maintain an awareness of pricing and industry market conditions. Provide pricing and product availability to all customers basis the guideline and processes outlined.
Strong team player and comfortable with new categories and customer profile.

Work experience:

Atleast 10 years of proven experience in purchase/ procurement in one or more industries/ market/ commodity segments such as EPC, Manufacturers, OEMs, Automotive, Building materials
Entrepreneurial and business owner mindset (startup experience a big plus) owning some big accounts themselves
Passion and energy to drive hyper growth in a new yet rapidly growing business segment
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

GM Marketing - Engineering Plastics PAN INDIA
Objective:
You are responsible for leading commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds. (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET / PMMA/Nylon/Poly/ POM Blends)
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P-L, and build B2B partnerships.
Oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics across target industrial segments
Principal Accountabilities / Key Responsibilities
F Develop, obtain approval and implement a strategic sales and marketing plan for domestic and export markets, with focus on PP Compounding and non-auto plastic applications.
F Responsible for creating and executing national sales strategies to drive revenue growth.
F Achieve targeted sales volumes, price premia, market share and segment-wise growth in line with the approved marketing plan.
F Devise pricing strategies within defined guidelines to maximize product premia and shareholder value.
F Drive continuous improvement in profitability through regular assessment of customer, product and application portfolios.
F Lead sales & business development for engineering plastic compounds across PAN India
Business Development
F Lead business development for PP Compounding and Plastic Injection Moulding applications for:
F Non -Automotive Industry
F Support customer engagements related to material selection, application development, trials, validation and commercialization.
F Expand Co’s footprint other than non-auto industry
F Analyzing market trends and identifying new business opportunities,
F Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer demand to refine sales strategies and identify new business opportunities.
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and partners.
F Drive Metal-to-Plastic and polymer material replacement projects
F Manage key accounts to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction
Customer, Key Account Management & Relationships:
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and Non-Auto OEM accounts.
F Understand customer needs in terms of products, technologies, processing (injection moulding) and service expectations.
F Act as a senior interface between the Co. and key non-auto customers.
F Managing key client relationships and ensuring consistent sales performance across all regions.
F Coordinate customer requirements, forecasts, dispatches and inventory planning
F Participate in exhibitions, seminars, technical presentations and customer meetings
F Work closely with technical, R&D, production and quality teams
People Management & Leadership
F Build, mentor and develop a high-performing sales & marketing team.
F Setting sales targets, managing and coaching a national sales team,
F Ensure all team members work in alignment with Co’s strategic objectives and HR policies.
F Promote a culture of performance, accountability, knowledge sharing and ethical conduct.

Preferred candidate profile
1. BE with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET/ PMMA/ Nylon/ Poly/ POM Blends) or chemical raw materials.
2. Proven experience in new project development
3. Strong technical understanding of polymer applications and material selection
4. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills
5. Strong exposure to Plastic Injection Moulding processes and their linkage with material performance.
6. Hands-on experience handling Non- Auto Industry suppliers and OEM businesses.
7. Proven sales track record and experience in customer support (preferred).
8. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
9. Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain strong client relationships.
10. Effective time management and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
11. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
12. Willingness to travel PAN India

Director Fund Raising And CSR (Philanthropy)
Responsible for cultivating relationships with donors, planning and executing fundraising campaigns and events, researching prospective donors, writing grant proposals, managing donor databases, and tracking financial goals to secure financial support for a non-profit's mission. Responsibilities include strategic planning, communication, donor stewardship, budget management, and reporting on fundraising progress to ensure organizational sustainability and growth.
Key Responsibilities>:
Donor Cultivation & Stewardship: Developing and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with individual, corporate, and foundation donors to secure ongoing financial support.
Campaign & Event Management: Planning, organizing, and executing fundraising campaigns and events, including community-led initiatives and major donor cultivation events.

Fund Raising

Manage and maintain donor databases and records.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align fundraising efforts with our mission
and objectives.
Monitor and report on fundraising progress and results.

2. The ability to develop and implement successful fundraising strategies that align with organizational goals.
3. Proven track record of successful fundraising efforts, with a focus on raising immediate funds.
4. Organizational: Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple projects and events simultaneously.
5. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including writing, editing, and public speaking.
6. Strong abilities to build and nurture relationships with diverse groups of people, including donors,
Career Focus
1. Fundraising in philanthropy is a people-focused role that requires strong empathy and communication to understand what inspires potential donors and to articulate the benefits of their support.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. Our client’s reach span across several countries across the globe.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Management Level : 09- Consultant/ 11- Analyst
Location: Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune
Must have skills: SAP oracle
Good to have skills:

Are you an outcome-oriented problem solverDo you enjoy working on transformation strategies for global clientsDoes working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest
Then, is the right place for you to explore limitless possibilities.
As a part of our practice, you will help organizations reimagine and transform their supply chains for tomorrowwith a positive impact on the business, on society and on the planet.
Together, lets innovate, build competitive advantage, improve business, and societal outcomes, in an ever-changing, ever-challenging world. Help us make supply chains work better, faster, and be more resilient, with the following initiatives:
Bring deep expertise to strategize and implement Oracle Digital Core by operating at the intersection of Business and Technology.
Support business assessment and roadmaps for our client, advise clients on Oracle Supply Chain functionality and new features to overcome current challenges and optimize key business processes.
Demonstrate the differentiating factors of Fusion SCM and explain value proposition to the client.
Drive the business blueprint workshops sessions for the SCM (Procurement, Planning, Inventory etc.) modules.
Streamline logistics cycle of warehouse management spanning areas such as inbound logistics, outbound logistics, internal warehouse movements, physical inventory process, advanced SCM functions and so on.
Define the knowledge discovery in databases for the business related to the SCM modules.
Support team of technical consultants for tasks related to configuration, testing, UAT, cutover, Go-Live post Go-Live support activities.
Demonstrate understanding of processes and best practices to help clients improve outcomes.
Support practice leadership on solutioning for new business opportunities.
Contribute to knowledge-sharing efforts , reviews and continually improves processes so that the team and firm capture and leverage knowledge.
Develop cutting-edge points of view and articles that drives Accenture equity in the market.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Impeccable team management skills with an ability to engage effectively with multiple stakeholders
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight
Strong analytical and writing skills to build viewpoints on industry trends
Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

Roles Responsibilities:

Professional Technical Skills:
3-8 years of relevant post qualification experience
Good, in-depth experience in working in one or more of the following areas:
Oracle Applications solution design : Ability to support the business need discussions and mapping the requirements to Oracle applications/Fusion applications and design the process for supply chain management. Should have skillset to do the configuration as per designed solution.
Oracle Applications business case and roadmap development: Understanding and ability to develop business case around Oracle applications and devise a roadmap to integrate with other applications.
Oracle applications solution development, testing and deployment : In depth knowledge of solution development in Oracle SCM. Ability to support Oracle solution deployment considering the industry best practices.
2+ project lifecycle experiences with demonstrated experience in Oracle ERP or Fusion applications implementations
Domain knowledge in one or more supply chain management areas related to procurement planning, inbound logistics, manufacturing, fulfilment, outbound logistics, warehouse operations is a must
Understanding of end-to-end cycle of Oracle project like Blueprinting, Configuration, testing, UAT, Cutover, Go-Live, Post Go-Live is preferable
Good knowledge on integration aspects of SCM with other modules such as Finance, Resource planning (ERP), HCM etc.


Qualification
Experience: 3-9 years post qualification
Educational Qualification:
MBA or Masters degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or Supply Chain Management from Tier-1 college is preferred
Bachelors degree in Engineering with good academic record

Description:
SC GN SAP Platform ; Manager, Senior Manager

Find endless opportunities to solve our clients'' toughest;;challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech and leading companies across industries.

Summary: Looking for Candidate having In-depth S/4 HANA platform Experience across functions (Supply Chain Operation, Finance) with expertise in one or multiple industries under Resources/Products/CMT. Candidate must have extensive experience in SAP Platform Pre-Sales with solutioning, orchestrating of RFP/Proposals in various capacities like Solution Architect, Subject Matter Experts in Collaboration with multiple teams. Candidate must have proven client facing skills who can set the client discussion narratives with all levels of client business participants. From delivery perspective - candidate must have experience of executing and managing complex SAP transformation engagements.

Practice: Strategy Consulting, Capability Network, GN SAP Platform COE

Areas of Work: S4 HANA Transformation

Level: Manager, Senior Manager

Location India: Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kolkata

Years of Exp: 10+ years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you an business outcome-oriented problem solver Do you enjoy working on transformation strategies for global clients Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest

Then, Accenture Strategy and Consulting is the right place for you to explore limitless possibilities.

The Practice ; A Brief Sketch

As a part of our Strategy Consulting Global Network practice, you will help organizations reimagine and transform their business for tomorrow;with a positive impact on the business, on society and on the planet.

Together, let;s innovate, build competitive advantage, improve business, and societal outcomes, in an ever-changing, ever-challenging world. Help us make client business work better, faster, and be more resilient.

If you have proven experience and expertise in the following areas, please reach out to us!

Industry and Function Expertise:


Demonstrate industry focus through deep knowledge and expertise in one or more related industries. We serve clients in multiple industry sectors like Resources (Energy/Utilities/Chemicals), Manufacturing (Automotive/Life Science/Consumer Goods/Retail/High-Tech/Software/Semi-Conductors) etc.

Possess deep functional expertise that helps you have technology-agnostic business process conversations with senior client leadership. We are looking for expertise across all functions: Finance and Cost accounting, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, maintenance, logistics, sales etc.


Solution Architecture Leadership:


Help clients realize value from transformation initiatives by understanding challenges, gleaning opportunities for improvements, identifying how SAP capabilities deliver value to business.

With a deep understanding of client context, opportunity context, industry context and business challenges, lead or work with proposal teams to build the solution and proposal.

Bring Accenture assets and offerings from multiple teams to differentiate proposal responses.

Take an end-to-end (cross-functional) ownership, work with the SMEs for individual areas to define the orchestrate proposal responses.


Project Delivery:


Use deep knowledge of S/4HANA capabilities, lead design workshops with the client and be responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, gap analysis in one/multiple areas of S4.

Lead teams in client facing roles on projects across the lifecycle from blueprint, design, development, and implementation of new and improved business processes.

Bring together the end-to-end solution working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders while managing project risks, plan and budget.

Support Pre-Sales Activity, business assessment and roadmaps for clients, Client advisory on S/4HANA led transformation to overcome client;s business challenges


Networking and Business Development


Create and manage relationships with clients and internal stakeholders

Support project and practice leadership in expanding opportunities with existing clients through proactive identification of pain points and innovative solutioning

Support practice leadership on identifying and solutioning for new business opportunities.

Lead Accenture;s pursuits related to S/4HANA opportunities by bringing together experts and building responses to Requests for Proposals and/or Requests for Information.


Developing Thought Leadership and Assets


Support/develop cutting edge Point of View (POV)/articles on bringing differentiation, Innovation to SAP led transformations.

Design and build assets that distinguish Accenture capabilities to drive additional business in S4 HANA


Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:


Ability to build trusted relationship through delivering outcomes, perseverance and following through on committed actions.

Demonstrate a forward-looking approach through negotiation and identifying ways to resolve challenges and roadblocks.

Impeccable team management skills with an ability to engage effectively with multiple stakeholders

Bring together various solution components to deliver business outcomes specific to the client;s industry context.

Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

Strong analytical and writing skills to build viewpoints on industry trends

Excellent communication and interpersonal.

Excellent power point slide creation and presentation skills.

Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

Ability to travel on a short notice.


Your experience counts!


MBA from Tier 1 and 2 business school.

Prior experience of working on 4-5 large scale transformation and implementation delivery programs for global clients.

Must have worked as an end-to-end SAP Solution / Functional Architect for at least 4-5 Request for Proposal (RFP) requests.

Proven success in client-facing roles for 5-6 engagements.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager, you re not just generating and managing group sales - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
You will deliver lasting impact as you work alongside the extremely skilled team, combining overseas client-site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing. Practice Overview:Capability Network CFO & Enterprise Value (CFO & EV) team supports CFOs / Finance organizations to craft and implement strategies anchored on digital disruption, new age operating models, best in class practices to drive market differentiation and creating value. We take pride in performing
End to End Transformations, delivering tangible results and outcomes for our client on back of path breaking thought leadership, deep CXO relationships, digital investments & assets and collaborating with our other Accenture businesses like Technology and Operations. CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Finance Transformation Transform the core finance function from strategic vision through value realization, into a more efficient and effective capability and operating model, enabled by intelligent automation (RPA through AI), data and analytics strategies, and new ways of working.
Tax Transformation includes tax function assessment and process transformation, tax operating model transformation, automation of tax systems and end to end tax transformation. o Treasury & Working Capital Management includes treasury management and operating model, total working capital assessment, treasury and working capital technology solutions and digital innovation. Enterprise Planning & Analysis Developed integrated, cloud enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation.
Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year.
Location Gurgaon/Mumbai/Bangalore Travel Percentage Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100%
Principal Roles And Responsibilities -
Seeking for candidates with strong and deep finance knowledge, process, and operational acumen in various aspects of finance coupled with strong consulting skills around problem identification, creative thinking, problem solving, strong and clear communication and presentation skills, stakeholder management, etc. Candidate will be operating in one of the above domains with opportunities to move across domains over the years. Working closely with our clients, consulting professionals and help in building and implementing strategies that can enhance business performance.
Opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives coupled with Accentures leading assets, are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape. Few day-to-day responsibilities include: Identifying, assessing, and solving complex business problems for area of responsibility, where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
Demonstrating strong finance process knowledge and understanding to work with client process owners across accounting, management and reporting, taxation, etc. Assisting clients in developing and building the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practices deep industry, functional and business process acumen to leverage our assets and capabilities for greatest strategic impact. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate and implement programs. Assisting leadership teams in developing offerings and assets

Qualifications - Chartered Accountant, only rank holders or first attempters in both group for both CA Final and PE II levels. Experience Minimum 3 years of experience in a reputed CA firm with strong experience around taxation, maintaining books of accounts, consolidation and close process, audits and internal controls, audits of financial institutions including risk analysis, client relationship management, etc. Key Competencies and Skills Must Have Strong analytical skills, with ability to analyze data, interpret the trends and produce results in presentable manner. Should possess advanced excel skills and PPT skills with minimum 2+ years of working experience. Ability to convert complex data into effective displays that are consumable by clients/end-users.
Well-versed in Finance processes with 2 to 3 years of basic experience. Required Soft Skills: Demonstrate analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and creativity to solve non-standard analytics problems. Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. Strong communication and presentation skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Self-starter with strong organizational, time management and multi-tasking skills. Description:
Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.
Hiring Details

Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, customer management, negotiation, and business development.

Description:
Responsibilities
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into backend functionalities for GenAI and Agentic AI projects.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions, including event-driven architectures and integration with external systems/APIs.
- Manage data storage solutions using relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases to support AI applications in production.
- Utilize containerization (Kubernetes) and implement DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Build and integrate APIs using Python frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) and collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and DevOps teams for seamless AI model deployment.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Proficient with LLM interaction frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and LlamaIndex, and experienced in integrating, scaling, and deploying GenAI and agentic applications in production.
- Skilled in setting up data pipelines for both model training and real-time inference to support AI workloads efficiently.
- Advanced Python expertise including OOP, asynchronous programming (asyncio), concurrency (multithreading, multiprocessing), design patterns, memory management, and performance optimization for scalable GenAI systems.
- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design principles (SOLID, clean architecture), and hands-on experience with cloud-native development on Azure/AWS, including serverless, microservices, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
- Experience with additional OOP languages (Java, C++, C#) and familiarity with WebSocket implementations for real-time application functionality.

Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

- Skilled in building scalable, collaborative AI ecosystems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen to orchestrate complex, multi-agent workflows efficiently.
- Experienced in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs that enable smooth integration of AI agents with diverse cloud platforms and third-party systems.
- Strong background in implementing comprehensive observability and monitoring frameworks to ensure high performance, reliability, and maintainability of AI systems in cloud environments.
- Proficient in managing data with SQL databases and leveraging tools like Agent Core and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and accelerating the development of AI Code Assistants.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Plant Financial Controller
You are responsible for managing all financial operations, cost accounting, and internal controls at a manufacturing site or production plant. They partner with plant management to track manufacturing costs, improve efficiency, and ensure regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities
F Cost Accounting & Variance Analysis: Track standard costing, bill of materials (BOM), cost of goods sold (COGS), and analyze variances between actual and budgeted production costs.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

Experience with large-scale data processing and expertise in NLP or computer vision.
Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
Experience with cloud integrations, big data technologies, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with security standards and regulatory compliance in AI solutions.
