Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity:
Ericsson is looking for a diligent and competent Domain Support Specialist. to strengthen our Service Delivery team. In this role, you will ensure seamless Operations & Maintenance (O&M), manage incidents and emergencies, and provide advanced technical troubleshooting.
What you will do:

- Deliver O&M support, ensuring availability and performance of core and cloud systems.
- Lead incident and emergency handling, providing timely resolution and RCA for critical events.
- Support project execution including new node acceptance tests and technology rollouts.
- Drive automation and AI initiatives for predictive maintenance, proactive fault detection, and operational efficiency.
- Monitor and review TT, CR, and AT performance, ensuring adherence to MSTOP guidelines.
- Ensure MIR release and user access controls in line with Ericsson standards.
- Interface with regional and global support teams for escalated issues and knowledge sharing.
The skills you bring:

- 2-5 years in Telecom O&M, Service Delivery, or Customer Support.
- Hands-on experience with Ericsson Charging System preferred.
- Exposure to AI/ML-driven operations or automation frameworks is an advantage.
- Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes.
- Intelligent Networks (IN), CAMEL, INAP.
- Voice Call & Signaling Routing, Network Architecture & Protocols.
- End-to-End Performance Audit & Optimization.
- Knowledge of AI-based monitoring and data analytics tools.
- ITIL, Oracle, CCNA, Red Hat.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Description:
Job Title: Python Developer _Data Test Engineer/Backoffice (Associate/Sr Associate/ Delivery Lead/ Manager)
Location: Gurgaon/Bangalore/Pune
Work hours: 10am to 7pm IST
Department: Data Technology Services
Experience Level : 4-10 years
Job Purpose
Were hiring a hands-on engineer to design and build a reusable Pythonframeworks that spans front-end integrations, backend/middle-tier services, andcloud execution. Youll translate complex, post-trade data flows into robustdata models, stored procedures, and regression automation, and ownCI/CDincluding scripts to run AutoSys/batch jobs and stored procs acrossenvironments. The ideal candidate brings pragmatic engineering discipline,capital-markets data intuition, and a builders mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with BAs, QEs, and traders/ops to clarify requirements and codesign testable acceptance criteria; maintain living technicaldocumentation and run-books.
Champion reusability: templates, golden pipelines, sample datasets, and coding standards that scale across engagements
Key Competencies
410 years of hands-on softwareengineering with Python (incl. packaging, virtual envs, unit/integrationtesting); strong use of libraries such as pandas, SQL Alchemy/ pyodbc, andasyncio /celery for pipelines and services
Expert SQL skills and stored-proc development (SQL Server/Oracle/Postgres), query tuning, and execution-plan analysis for largedatasets.
Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines and automating promotion (code + data + DB objects) with Azure DevOps/Jenkins/GitLab; strongGit practices and code-review hygiene.
Comfort with schedulers (AutoSys/Control-M/Airflow) and shell/Python scripting for batch or chestration; familiarity with secretsmanagement and environment configuration.
Domain understanding of post-trade data flows and how to encode the m into repeatable regression checks.

Join our Team
About this opportunity:
Ericsson is looking for a diligent and competent Domain Support Specialist. to strengthen our Service Delivery team. In this role, you will ensure seamless Operations & Maintenance (O&M), manage incidents and emergencies, and provide advanced technical troubleshooting.
What you will do:
- Deliver O&M support, ensuring availability and performance of core and cloud systems.
- Lead incident and emergency handling, providing timely resolution and RCA for critical events.
- Support project execution including new node acceptance tests and technology rollouts.
- Drive automation and AI initiatives for predictive maintenance, proactive fault detection, and operational efficiency.
- Monitor and review TT, CR, and AT performance, ensuring adherence to MSTOP guidelines.
- Ensure MIR release and user access controls in line with Ericsson standards.
- Interface with regional and global support teams for escalated issues and knowledge sharing.
The skills you bring:
- 2-5 years in Telecom O&M, Service Delivery, or Customer Support.
- Hands-on experience with Ericsson Charging System preferred.
- Exposure to AI/ML-driven operations or automation frameworks is an advantage.
- Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes.
- Intelligent Networks (IN), CAMEL, INAP.
- Voice Call & Signaling Routing, Network Architecture & Protocols.
- End-to-End Performance Audit & Optimization.
- Knowledge of AI-based monitoring and data analytics tools.
- ITIL, Oracle, CCNA, Red Hat.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Job

Summary:

HR Strategy & Transformation is a team of HR Professionals who specializes in select areas within HR to help our clients target and deliver values for their HR and Talent investments using a distributed delivery model, and can be deployed globally - onsite, near shore and offshore.


Roles & Responsibilities:
HR Operating Model HR Op Model Design, Organization Design, Capability Enhancement
Competency Based Talent Management Competency Modelling, Design, Assessment and Integration with HR & Talent processes
Workforce Management Workforce effectiveness analysis, planning and optimization
HR Shared Services HR Shared service Assessment, Design and Deployment
Process Excellence HR & Talent Processes design, innovation & Implementation
HR SaaS Implementation SaaS Process design, configuration, training & Change Enablement


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:



Knowledge and application of Business Process Re-engineering
HR and TM Process Design experience
HR system implementation experience
Conduct HR Policy Design and harmonization
Project Management of large HRT engagements
Design and deployment of HR Service Delivery Model across diverse set of organizations
Desired knowledge of Cloud HR Platforms (SuccessFactors/Workday/Oracle/SAP)
Knowledge of outsourcing business model of key HR processes.
Talent Management Processes including Talent Acquisition and Performance Management and Rewards.
Talent Availability and Competency Modeling and Assessment
Sourcing Strategy, Recruitment Process Optimization
Performance Measurement, Rewards Audit and Strategic Role Assessment
Minimum 3 plus years of work experience after masters degree and significant years of experience in Human Resource Transformation and Talent Management related projects is desired.
This individual must be comfortable working at the highest levels of client organizations and interacting closely with the C level executives in a range of environments
The individual should be comfortable functioning in a broadly positioned and highly diverse consulting firm
The individual should be comfortable with the Pre sales ,sales and delivery cycle in a global client engagement model
The individual should possess an impressive executive demeanor, a team oriented and collaborative approach, and excellent presentation skills, including strong oral and writing capabilities





Additional Information:


Leadership responsibilities: Focus on growing the practice by ensuring the right strategies and actions are in place. Achieve the target metrics on productivity, utilization, geographic penetration, head count growth, controlling attrition and high degree of engagement from the team and maintaining exception delivery quality


Engagement Management: Manage engagement risk, project economics including planning and budgeting, manage account receivables, define deliverable content, ensure buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client/ client team


Business Development: Work as part of a joint global sales team to identify and win potential opportunities.
People Development: Performs role of counselor and coach, provides input and guidance into the firms staffing process, and actively participates in staff recruitment and retention activities.
Domain Development: Development of assets and methodologies, development of point-of-view, research or white papers, support development of marketing collateral, public speaking and publication in industry periodicals.

Description:
Role Summary
Support fund accounting, financial reporting, investor reporting, and operational activities across private equity funds, co-investment vehicles, SPVs, GP entities, and management companies.
Perform accounting, reconciliations, capital activity processing, and quarter-end close within a complex alternative investment environment.
Partner with finance, fund administration, audit, tax, compliance, and investor relations teams to ensure accurate reporting and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and post journal entries independently using supporting schedules, transaction documentation, and bank statements.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate outstanding reconciling items.
Review and process fund and management company invoices and validate expense allocations.
Record accruals, prepaid amortization, management fees, and other period-end accounting adjustments.
Track and record capital calls, distributions, commitments, and investor transactions.
Support Investran reconciliations and maintain integrity between accounting and reporting systems.
Perform end-to-end quarter-end and year-end close activities.
Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules in accordance with reporting requirements.

Description:
Tech Transformation delivery leader- Associate Director
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale complex AI led Technology Transformation programmes for our most strategic clients across the globe. You will lead the execution of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that drive strategic business outcomes, operational excellence, and sustainable value creation across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Tech Transformation delivery leader
Level: Associate Director
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 17+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability:Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity.Revenue Management and Financial Governance:Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M-$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Integration and Dependency Management:Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level Global Delivery Leadership:Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership:Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings


Role Summary
As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.



Key Responsibilities

Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;


Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.


Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.


Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.


Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.


Accountability for the account P&L manage budgets of $5M-$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.


Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.


Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.


Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.


Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.


Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.


Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.


Qualification

What We're Looking For

17-20 years' total experience; 3-5 years proven experience managing and delivering complex portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M.


Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.


Demonstrated track record of C-suite stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.


Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.


Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.


Strong executive presence:communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.


Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernization, Mainframe Modernisation, AI Enterprise Transformation, Complex Delivery, Enterprise Agility

Set yourself apart:
Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programmes leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient





Qualifications & Certifications

Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); Master's / MBA strongly preferred.


PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.


SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.


Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) - advantageous.

What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions - underpinned by the world's largest delivery network - Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. In practice, Digital Core brings the integrated client solution and team together, while the Engines continuously strengthen the skills, tools, methods, and AI-enabled delivery that those teams use. And Client Success will ensure our solutions are commercially strong, repeatable, and aligned to what clients truly need - bringing the full strength of Accenture to every engagement. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Digital Core Reinvention Partner's services include those provided by our Global Network - a distributed organization that provides advisory and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world.

Description:
Position Title-Delivery Lead- Salesforce Business Partner
Department-Sales operations
Location-Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Colombo
Position reports to-Associate Director - Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.

(5-8) years of relevant consulting experience in IT Service Management, with hands-on exposure to ITSM assessments, process design, and operating model development. Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.
For more details about us, please check:
Visit : HIAL Website or watch: About HIAl Job Description:
Looking for an experienced content creator who has proven ability to develop content and experience of writing good quality engaging articles. Has an ability to conduct extensive research on the assigned topic. A team player who has good coordination skills to collate the data at hand from different stake holders. The right candidate will be the one who is able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables and take ownership of the expected output without supervision.
About The Role:
As a content writer / you shall get to create content that shares HIAL's story, vision and brand to the world and make an impact across many different digital / social / media platforms.
Responsibilities:
1.Write, edit, publish content for websites, blogs, vlogs, videos, social media campaign (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc).
2.Creating compelling headlines and body content that will capture the attention of the target audience.
3.Write content for Annual Report, Newsletter and other internal communication initiatives.
4.Design content marketing strategy.
5.Optimise content considering SEO.
6.Should have the ability to work independently and with cross functional teams.
7.Should be able to come up with fresh ideas and take ownership of projects.
8.Ensure that the content adheres to required branding and style guidelines and is relevant for our target audience.
9.Scripting for audio-visual, written and other media content.
10.Plan and Execute Events and Conferences that are integral to HIAL.
11.Monitor HIAL's Social Media and online presence and timely preparing high quality content for promoting HIAL brand value.
12.Prepare HIAL Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly) collating data as required from all stakeholders.
13.While ensuring that they adhere to standards and goals of the HIAL, write and produce high-quality materials for effectively communicating to the key audience at appropriate platforms.
14.Create creative content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to maintain an active online presence for HIAL.
15.Content for press releases, media briefings etc for HIAL's media relations across radio, print, digital, and television.
16.Assure uniformity in all content by serving as key brand guardian of HIAL.
17.Maintain the content of HIALs website by making sure it is correct, up to date, and persuasive.
18.Have an eye for detail and make sure all output is of a high quality.
19.Able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables.

KRA:
1.Written content for communication with HIAL's stakeholders.
2.Preparation and circulation of Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly), brochures/ manuals, etc.
3.Branding and marketing related content.
4.Support in promoting the events organised time to time with valuable content for marketing and branding.
5.Social Media: Preparation of high quality and engaging content for all the social media handles as per tentative schedule mentioned below with SEO.
1. Instagram: Ensure daily effective posts.
2.Any Event: Instant Posting.
3.Facebook: Ensure daily effective posts.
4.Twitter
5.LinkedIn
6.Website
6.Content for the Events:
1.Annual Conferences & Festivals, promotion activities (Sun & Earth, Education, Entrepreneurship, Energy Studies).
2.Workshops.

7.I Live Simply (ILS).
1.Manage content related activities for ILS.


Preferred Educational Background:
1.Graduate or Master's in Mass Communication/ English literature or equivalent.
2.Good command over English.
3.Proven experience working under strict deadlines and the ability to work quickly.
4.Creative skills and usage of photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, etc
The above is relaxed for the right candidate who can prove excellence in lines with the requirement with proven track record.
Preferred Work Experience:
1.Minimum of 2-5 years in similar roles.
2.Ability to work independently and reliably with minimal supervision.
3.Experience in SEO will be preferred.
4.Creative writing.
Compensation:
As per industry and region standards.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

F&B Production 2-4 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.

Description:
style="margin-bottom: 0px;"> Sous Chef-Indian Cuisine
F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrad programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Conduct detailed physical inspections of used cars at dealer locations, customer locations, yards, and designated inspection centers. 
Assess key vehicle systems including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, tyres, steering, electrical systems, AC, and other mechanical components. 
Inspect the exterior and interior condition of vehicles, including body panels, paint quality, dents, scratches, accidental repairs, and signs of structural damage. 
Identify critical vehicle issues such as flood damage, major accidents, odometer tampering, structural damage, and significant mechanical defects. 
Conduct road tests to evaluate vehicle performance, drivability, handling, braking, and overall condition. 
Verify VIN/chassis number, engine number, registration details, and other relevant vehicle documents. 
Use diagnostic tools, inspection equipment, mobile applications, and digital platforms to conduct standardized vehicle assessments. 
Prepare accurate and detailed inspection reports with photographs, observations, identified defects, and recommendations. 
Identify approximate refurbishment/repair costs and clearly highlight major repairs or quality concerns. 
Complete inspections and reports within defined Turnaround Time (TAT). 
Clearly communicate critical defects, major repairs, and vehicle quality concerns to internal teams and dealer stakeholders 
Follow defined inspection SOPs, checklists, quality standards, and safety protocols. 
Maintain accurate inspection records and ensure data quality on the inspection platform/mobile application. 
Identify recurring vehicle quality issues and provide actionable feedback to improve inspection processes, standards, and quality controls. 
What we are looking for:
ITI, Diploma, or Graduate qualification in Automobile Engineering. 
3–5 years of relevant experience as an Automobile Evaluator, Mechanic, Service Advisor, Assistant Service Advisor, or similar role. 
Experience working with passenger vehicles and strong understanding of automotive systems and components. 
Strong multi-brand vehicle technical knowledge. 
Ability to identify accidental damage, mechanical defects, structural issues, and major repair requirements. 
Hands-on experience with vehicle diagnostic tools and inspection applications will be preferred.
Strong attention to detail with excellent observation and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and unbiased inspection reports. 
Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and digital inspection platforms. 
Willingness to travel extensively for vehicle inspections. 
Valid driving licence and practical driving skills preferred. 
What we will give you:
Opportunity to work with modern digital inspection platforms, diagnostic tools, and technology-enabled processes. 
A fast-paced environment where your technical expertise directly influences vehicle quality and business decisions. 
A role with strong ownership, autonomy, and visibility in a growing automotive business. 
A performance-driven environment with opportunities for learning, growth, and career progression.

Description:
I hope you are doing well.
I am reaching out regarding an exciting opportunity with BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) for the position of Deputy Manager Medical Affairs based in Chandigarh.
This role is ideal for a healthcare professional who enjoys engaging with clinicians, building KOL relationships, driving clinical education initiatives, and partnering closely with commercial teams to enhance healthcare outcomes.
About the Role
As a Deputy Manager Medical Affairs, you will play a key role in executing clinical strategies across the region by:
To execute and implement Clinical Strategies for MDS in the respective regions / territory in line with the market requirements and the country business plan with the purpose of creating clinically differentiated market position.
Principal Responsibilities
Conduct Clinical Marketing Education Programs, Seminars, Promotional Events and In-service Programs in the respective region in order to improve BD MDS value proposition amongst both clinical and economic buyers, by engaging KOLs towards MDS business outcome and achieve regional business objectives.
Clinical capability building (administering trainings, continuous evaluation) amongst regional MDS direct selling organization and amongst channel partners in line with the country clinical objectives in order to enhance their ability to adequately differentiate the brand MDS in the market and thus achieve targeted business outcomes.
Creating and implementing the regional calendar of engagements with the potential / existing customers in order to create strong brand awareness and creating door openers at the relevant levels.
Support / assist sales organization with product evaluations, clinical audits in hospitals, setting protocols and processes in hospitals and 'critical to business' technical challenges (including but not limited to troubleshooting and product applications) in order to attain high levels of product penetration, query resolution and trouble free product application.
Leading edge key customer relationship management and creation of regional KOL network in order to ensure usage of full array of BD MDS products by leading client organizations and using these customer relationships to drive the conversions.
Coordinate on the timely completion of clinical /economic studies initiated in the region in order to ensure that the clinical / economic studies planned for the year are completed within the stipulated timelines.
Conduct Induction Training Programs (Clinical & Product Training) to Sales Organization, provide clinical Updates, annual / quarterly Product refreshers and run Clinical Proficiency Tests on a need basis / from time to time.
Preferred Background
We are particularly interested in professionals with:
MBBS qualification (MBA preferred)
3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Medical Affairs
Clinical Affairs
Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL)
Clinical Education
Scientific Affairs
Clinical Applications / Clinical Specialist roles
Strong experience in:
KOL development and physician engagement
CME/CNE programs
Clinical training and education
Hospital stakeholder management
Product demonstrations and evaluations
Cross-functional collaboration with commercial/sales teams
Exposure to:
Medical Devices
Diagnostics
MedTech
Pharma
Critical Care
Infusion Therapy
Infection Prevention
Vascular Access
Willingness to travel extensively (70-80%) across North India.
Why Consider BD?
BD is a global leader in medical technology, advancing the world of health by improving medical discovery, diagnostics, and the delivery of care. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals, clinicians, and healthcare decision-makers while contributing to meaningful patient outcomes.
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career aspirations, I would be happy to connect and share further details.
Please feel free to reply with your updated resume and a suitable time to speak.
Looking forward to hearing from you.
AboutCompany: BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world and is advancing the world of healthTM by improving medical discovery, diagnostics and the delivery of care. The company supports the heroes on the frontlines of healthcare by developing innovative technology, services and solutions that help advance both clinical therapy for patients and clinical process for healthcare providers. BD and its 75,000 employees have a passion and commitment to help enhance the safety and efficiency of clinicians' care delivery process, enable laboratory scientists to accurately detect disease and advance researchers' capabilities to develop the next generation of diagnostics and therapeutics. BD has a presence in virtually every country and partners with organizations around the world to address some of the most challenging global health issues. By working in close collaboration with customers, BD can help enhance outcomes, lower costs, increase efficiencies, improve safety and expand access to healthcare.
CompanyAddress: 5th and 6th Floor Signature Tower - B, Signature T ower - B, South City - 1, South City - 1 , GURGAON, Haryana, India

Description:
Job Summary

Delhivery is looking for an experienced operations leader to head Fulfillment Center (FC) Operations, drive operational excellence, improve productivity, optimize costs and ensure seamless end-to-end fulfillment. The role requires strong expertise in large-scale warehouse operations, supply chain management, inventory control, process improvement and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and oversee end-to-end fulfillment center operations, including inbound, receiving, put-away, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, dispatch and returns.
Develop and implement operational strategies to improve productivity, throughput, order accuracy, service quality and overall efficiency.
Drive operational excellence through process standardization, automation, technology adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
Manage operational budgets, cost optimization, resource utilization and productivity targets to achieve business objectives.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including fulfillment accuracy, inventory accuracy, turnaround time, throughput, SLA adherence and cost per shipment.
Lead large operations teams, build leadership capability and drive a performance-oriented culture across fulfillment centers.
Drive capacity planning, manpower planning, infrastructure utilization and peak-season readiness in line with business volumes.
Collaborate with transportation, linehaul, first-mile, last-mile, technology, planning and customer experience teams to ensure seamless end-to-end operations.
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS), data analytics and automation to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Ensure adherence to operational SOPs, safety standards, statutory requirements and audit processes.
Identify operational bottlenecks, conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Lead facility expansion, operational transformation and scalable process implementation to support business growth.


Required Qualifications and Experience

Proven experience managing large-scale fulfillment or warehouse operations, preferably across multiple facilities or locations.
Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse processes, inventory management, order fulfillment and distribution operations.
Demonstrated success in improving operational KPIs, productivity, service levels and cost efficiency.
Experience in budget management, capacity planning, resource optimization and operational governance.
Proven ability to lead large teams and develop senior operational leaders.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
Experience with warehouse management systems, operational dashboards and process improvement methodologies.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider. With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
CompanyAddress: PLOT NO. 5 SECTOR 44 GURGAON , GURGAON, Haryana, India

About the Role

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join the Marketing team at upGrad. In this role, you'll create compelling video content that supports brand campaigns, performance marketing, social media, product launches, and learner engagement. You'll collaborate with marketers, designers, content creators, and creative strategists to deliver high-quality videos that drive awareness, engagement, and conversions.

Key Responsibilities

Create engaging short-form and long-form video content, including ads, reels, explainers, testimonials, webinars, and promotional videos.
Add motion graphics, text animations, transitions, sound effects, and color correction to enhance visual storytelling.
Repurpose existing content into multiple formats optimized for different platforms.
Collaborate with marketing, branding, and content teams to understand campaign objectives and creative briefs.
Maintain consistency with upGrad's brand guidelines across all video assets.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.
Stay updated with video editing trends, social media formats, and emerging AI-powered editing tools.


Required Qualifications –

Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Multimedia, Film, Design, or a related field (preferred).
2–5 years of experience in video editing, preferably in a digital marketing, media, startup, or edtech environment.
Strong portfolio showcasing marketing videos, social media content, and promotional campaigns.


Required Skills –

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
Experience with color grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
Understanding of social media video formats and performance marketing creatives.
Familiarity with AI-powered editing tools is a plus.
Strong storytelling, pacing, and visual composition skills.
Excellent time management and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.


Why Join upGrad?

Opportunity to contribute to one of India's leading EdTech organizations.
Exposure to large-scale digital campaigns and brand initiatives.
Collaborative and high-growth work environment.
Learning and development opportunities across diverse business functions.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.

Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications
