Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Responsible for supporting all aspects of Concierge functions in accordance with hotel standards.
Maintains a concierge service and management philosophy that serves as a guide to respective staff.
Assists in developing and maintaining the acknowledgment and service of all guests visiting the location.
Supports management to ensure all departments are aware of all guests needs and information prior to arrival that will lead to a unique, memorable and personal stay.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration or related major; no prior work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Concierge Goals
- Coordinates day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Supports concierge team to keep them focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
- Supports the establishment of an effective database to be used by all team members for restaurant and local attractions.
- Establishes relationships with local attractions, restaurants and other businesses to enhance guests experiences.
- Provides recommendations and arranges services for guests as requested (eg, car rental, airline and train tickets, office services, beauty and barber services, baby sitting, repairs, shopping).
- Maintains awareness of cultural differences needed to meet guests specific needs and requirements.
- Provides check-in and check-out services and handles reservations when needed.
- Maintains knowledge of rooms and their locations, services and facilities of the hotel.
- Ensures repeat and VIP guests are receiving appropriate service and ensures their requests are carried out.
- Responds to emergency situations using appropriate procedures.
- Maintains awareness of daily operations and events at the hotel.
- Maintains knowledge of daily house-count, arrivals/departures, VIPs, scheduled in-house group names, background, activities, locations, and times as well as special requests/arrangements
- Provides warm welcome and anticipation of guest needs throughout their stay.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Ensures concierge team effectively handles guest requests and adheres to all hotel policies, procedures and standards while striving towards total guest satisfaction.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Assists in ensuring the concierge team provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Supports employees understanding of customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives and the peers on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the front of house goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) Banking & Financial Services

Job Summary
We are looking for a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) to manage customer relationships, drive cross-selling of financial products, and support business development. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a customer-focused approach, and an interest in banking, insurance, and financial services. Freshers with strong sales skills are welcome to apply.

Roles & Responsibilities
Manage customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
Drive cross-selling of insurance, mutual funds, Fixed Deposits (FD), Recurring Deposits (RD), and personal loan products.
Generate business through company-provided leads and personal references.
Identify customer needs and recommend suitable banking and financial products.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth.
Coordinate with internal sales teams to improve customer engagement and conversions.
Resolve customer queries and provide effective after-sales support.
Maintain customer records and follow up on leads regularly.

Desired Candidate Profile
Experience: 01 year; freshers can also apply.
Qualification: Graduate in any stream, preferably Commerce, Finance, or Business Administration.
Good communication, interpersonal, and customer-handling skills.
Basic understanding of banking, insurance, and financial products.
Interest in sales, cross-selling, customer relationship management, and business development.
Target-oriented, confident, and willing to work in a sales-driven environment.

Key Skills
Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Banking Sales, Cross Selling, Insurance Sales, Mutual Funds, FD, RD, Personal Loans, Financial Products, Lead Generation, Customer Service, Client Relationship Management, Business Development, Sales Target Achievement.

Benefits
Incentives based on performance
Convenience allowance
Leads provided by the head office, along with opportunities to generate business through personal references.

Job Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan

Interested candidates can share their updated CV or contact us for further details at TAMANNA.RAI@mahindrafinance.com or 9252148448 (WhatsApp only)
AboutCompany:
Mahindra Finance is Indias leading financial services provider committed to the needs of underserved customers in rural and semi-urban markets. We are on a journey to transform lives and uplift communities through financial growth.
Our assets under management exceed Rs. 82,770 crores and our extensive network of over 1386+ offices nationwide serves our growing base of 9 million customers. With a strong local presence across the pulse of India, we pride ourselves on being able to anticipate market needs and offer unique solutions.
Our comprehensive range of financial products include Vehicle Loans, SME Finance, Personal Loans, Insurance Broking, Housing Finance, Fixed Deposits and Mutual Fund schemes. As the sole non-banking Indian financial company to be listed on the Dow Jones Sustainability Index for Emerging Markets, we are invested in sustainable growth and support our customers by opening up opportunities and simplifying finance.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Job Description (JD) Diploma Apprentice Trainee
Position: Diploma Apprentice Trainee - Production/Quality
Department: Production / Manufacturing
Location: Plant Operations
Reporting To: Production Line Manager / Shift In-Charge
Job Purpose
To assist the Production Line Manager in day-to-day manufacturing operations, ensure smooth production flow, support achievement of daily production targets, and develop practical knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality standards, safety practices, and productivity improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Assist the Line Manager in monitoring and executing daily production activities as per the production plan.
Support achievement of daily, shift-wise, and monthly production targets.
Ensure availability of materials, tools, and components at the production line.
Monitor production processes and report abnormalities, breakdowns, or quality issues to the supervisor.
Maintain production records, reports, and process-related documentation.
Support implementation of 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and company manufacturing procedures.
Follow all safety guidelines and promote a safe working environment.
Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Production Planning teams for smooth operations.
Assist in reducing line stoppages, rework, rejection, and wastage.
Participate in line balancing, productivity improvement, and cost reduction activities.
Perform any other production-related assignments as directed by the Line Manager.
Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Mechatronics, Automobile, or related Engineering Discipline.
Apprenticeship registration as per applicable apprenticeship regulations.
Required Skills
Basic understanding of manufacturing and production processes.
Knowledge of quality concepts and safety practices.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
Strong learning attitude and problem-solving capabilities.
Key Competencies
Discipline and accountability
Attention to detail
Continuous learning mindset
Team collaboration
Time management
Safety consciousness
Learning Outcomes
During the apprenticeship period, the trainee will gain exposure to:
Shop floor operations and manufacturing processes
Production planning and monitoring
Quality management systems
Lean manufacturing and productivity tools
Safety and statutory compliance practices
Cross-functional coordination in a manufacturing environment
Career Path: Successful apprentices may be considered for future opportunities based on performance, business requirements, and available vacancies.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
Position: Customer Relationship Executive (CRE)
Gender: Female candidates only
Location: jaipur - mi road , bais godam c scheme
Job Type: Full-time
Department: Client Relations / Customer Support
timings - 10;30-8;00
Role Overview
We are seeking a clear, articulate, and customer-focused Female Customer Relationship Executive (CRE) to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, responsible for managing client interactions, addressing queries, building positive long-term relationships, and ensuring a seamless client experience. High proficiency in English communication (both verbal and written) is mandatory.
Key Responsibilities
Client Interaction & Engagement: Act as the main liaison between the company and clients, handling inbound and outbound calls, emails, and meetings.
Relationship Management: Build, maintain, and strengthen trust-based relationships with new and existing clients.
Query & Issue Resolution: Timely respond to client inquiries, provide accurate information, and resolve complaints or issues efficiently.
Client Onboarding & Support: Assist new clients through the onboarding process and guide them on company products/services.
Feedback Collection: Gather client feedback and coordination with internal teams to continuous improve service quality.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of client interactions, correspondence, and feedback in the CRM database.
Key Requirements & Qualifications
Gender: Female candidate required.
Education: Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: [0-2 years / 2+ years] of experience in customer service, client relationship management, or front-desk administration.
Language Skills: Fluency in English (verbal and written) is mandatory. Outstanding tone, grammar, and articulation.
Interpersonal Skills: Warm personality, active listener, empathetic, and strong negotiation/problem-solving abilities.
Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word) and familiarity with CRM software is an added advantage.
Key Competencies
Excellent telephone etiquette and professional demeanor.
Strong multitasking and time management capabilities.
Ability to stay calm and composure under pressure or when handling difficult client situations

Description:
Ways of Working - Mandate 3 : Employees to be located in their place of posting / respective office base location.
About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Description: Client Relationship Executive
Company Name: MB Sons Jewellers
Position Title: Client Relationship Executive
Department: Client Relations / Customer Experience
Location: On-site (Showroom)
Employment Type: Full-time
About MB Sons Jewellers
MB Sons Jewellers is renowned for exquisite craftsmanship, timeless luxury, and an unyielding commitment to trust and excellence. We pride ourselves on creating memorable luxury shopping experiences and building lifelong relationships with our valued patrons.
Job Summary
We are looking for an eloquent, warm, and sophisticated Client Relationship Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary ambassador for our brand, focusing exclusively on high-touch client interaction, customer engagement, and relationship management. In this role, you will elevate the showroom experience, maintain personalized engagement with our esteemed clientele, and ensure every patron feels valued and cherished.
Key Responsibilities (Focused on Client Interaction)
High-Touch Client Engagement: Warmly welcome high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) and walk-in clients, ensuring an inviting, luxurious, and hospitable atmosphere.
Personalized Consultation: Listen actively to clients' preferences, style choices, and occasions (weddings, anniversaries, corporate gifting) to assist them through their high-end jewellery selection process.
Relationship Building & Retention: Maintain a detailed client portfolio; follow up with clients post-purchase, celebrate special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries), and extend exclusive event invitations.
Brand Representation: Communicate the story, heritage, and unique craftsmanship of MB Sons Jewellers with passion, elegance, and in-depth product knowledge.
Client Advisory: Offer tailored advice on custom jewellery inquiries, bespoke orders, and maintenance/care services.
Feedback & Service Excellence: Act as the direct touchpoint for client feedback and ensure any service queries or special requests are addressed with utmost care and promptness.
Qualifications & Requirements
Experience: 13+ years of experience in client-facing roles, high-end retail, hospitality, or luxury customer service (Experience in fine jewellery/luxury lifestyle brands is a strong plus).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal communication and interpersonal skills with an articulate, polite, and refined demeanor.
Languages: Proficiency in English and local languages (Hindi/regional language fluency required).
Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and crafting memorable client journeys.
Grooming & Presentation: Immaculate personal presentation and grooming consistent with a luxury brand environment.
Key Competencies
Active Listening & Empathy
Polished Interpersonal & Networking Skills
Warm, Welcoming, and Professional Demeanor
High Emotional Intelligence (EQ) and Tact
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary with attractive performance-based incentives.
Opportunity to represent a premier luxury jewellery brand.
Professional growth and long-term career advancement in high-end retail management.
A vibrant, luxurious, and supportive working environment.

Core Responsibilities:
Review and assess a broad range of complex loan applications within defined guidelines and accordingly take decision or recommend for approval to higher authorities.

Conduct personal discussion with customers to establish credit worthiness and ensure completion of credit/KYC documents and verification- telephonic, field & collateral visits.

Description:
Job Title - HCM Business Partner CB, IB Operations Controls, AVP
Location - Bangalore, Jaipur (India)
Role Description
About Human Resources
As a team, we partner with the business to drive an inclusive and sustainable performance culture. We take fair and transparent people decisions that are in the banks best interest. Our advice and products are focused, fact-based, relevant and improve employee experience in moments that matter. We shape Deutsche Banks working environment to enable our people to be the best they can be for our clients, the bank and society.
Overview
As the HR Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the people strategy for Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB) Operations Controls divisions in India, and drive HR initiatives to support business objectives. You will partner closely with senior leadership to provide both strategic and operational HR leadership for the identified divisions in the country.
Core expectations of this role are:
Functional leadership and partnership across HR
Governance, controls, and culture of excellence
Business partnership, ownership and accountability
Team / People leadership
Your key responsibilities
Implementation of HR s people strategy in partnership with Global, Divisional and Regional HR leadership
Provide HR functional leadership by fostering strong partnership, collaboration and engagement with the broader HR function, including regional and global stakeholders across business partner, product, country teams and process owners to deliver relevant HR solutions
Establish strong HR business partnerships by building trusted advisor relationships with regional and local stakeholders, providing independent HR guidance and advice, and taking ownership and accountability for all HR delivery and activities in India
Strengthen leadership effectiveness and build a robust talent pipeline for key senior roles in India

Description:
Job Summary
Role Purpose Objective: Drive acquisition of new Unsecured loans customers from open market; Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations; Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers; Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivans products customer profile needs.
Responsibilities
Drive acquisition of new Unsecured loans customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations
Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers
Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivans products customer profile needs
Size of the Role
5-7 Cr. Loan portfolio
Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role Business/ Financials
Develop and execute strategies to acquire new unsecured loan customers
Collaborate with the liabilities team to cross-sell unsecured loans
Follow up on leads provided by team various channels within defined TAT
Achieve monthly loan disbursement targets through acquisition of new customers and conversion of existing customers
Coordinate with Products Marketing department to carry out marketing drives at his/her assigned and catchment areas for unsecured loans
Prospect new customers, maintain database of the leads, meet convert select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
Attend center meetings to generate leads for unsecured loans and actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into SBL customer
Cross sell other products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective officers/staff
Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Branch Head and Area Manager Microfinance
Provide inputs pertaining to revision of product and credit policies to the respective teams on the basis of geography specific considerations
Customer
Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services and establish professional relationship with them, with a long-term perspective
Conduct the appraisal process of potential customers in a courteous manner without compromising quality
Guarantee confidential treatment of all the information gathered from customers
Internal Process
Carry out the pre- and post-loan activities related to unsecured loans, perform simple financial analysis, present the loan applications to the sanctioning authority by adhering to the set TAT, prioritize repayment of loans to maintain best portfolio quality

Description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO:

New Business Acquisition
Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular

PTL freight movement needs.
Run the full sales cycle: prospecting, cold outreach, discovery calls, site visits, commercial proposals, and deal closure.
Focus on accounts with 50500 MT/month PTL potential across (but not restricted to) sectors such as FMCG, Auto-Components, Pharma, and Industrial Goods.

Revenue & Target Ownership
Own a monthly revenue target for your assigned territory and be accountable for delivery against it every billing cycle.
Maintain a healthy pipeline of 34x target coverage using Delhivery's internal CRM tools; update pipeline status weekly.
Track shipment volume, revenue, and yield per client; flag at-risk accounts proactively to your reporting manager.

Client Engagement & Retention
Conduct regular check-ins with newly onboarded clients to ensure smooth ramp-up of freight volumes post-onboarding.
Coordinate with the PTL Operations and Customer Success teams to resolve transit delays, damage claims, or POD issues that affect client experience.
Identify upsell opportunities — such as dedicated lane commitments, cross-dock usage, or value-added services — within the first 90 days of account activation.

Market Intelligence & Reporting
Map the competitive surface freight landscape in your territory — identify accounts held direct competition or regional players.
Share weekly market feedback on competitor pricing, new product launches, or shifts in client freight patterns with the regional BD head.

Job Title: Business Development Manager/Senior Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role
We are seeking a dynamic and execution-focused Business Development Manager to lead market expansion and partnership initiatives in Kolkata/Bangalore/Rajasthan. The role will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, driving site acquisitions (if retail/F&B), building strategic alliances, and delivering revenue targets in line with the companys regional expansion strategy.
This is a high-ownership role requiring strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and on-ground market intelligence.

Key Responsibilities
1 Market Expansion & Strategy
Develop and execute growth strategy aligned with regional objectives.
Identify high-potential micro-markets within Kolkata/Hyderabad/Haryana and secondary cities.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Title: Presales Executive | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)
About Paytm Group:

Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):

Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:

2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem

Description:
We are now looking for an Alarm Monitoring Engineer to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through proactive alarm monitoring and incident management.
You will play a key role in identifying network faults, performing first-level analysis, and collaborating with technical and field teams to drive timely fault resolution. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericssons vision of a fully connected, intelligent world.
What you will do
• Perform 24x7 alarm monitoring and first-level fault analysis for network elements across multiple technologies.
• Identify, analyze, and prioritize network faults using Ericsson and multi-vendor NMS/EMS tools.
• Escalate and coordinate with Level 2/Level 3 support teams and field engineers to ensure service restoration within defined SLAs.
• Execute proactive monitoring to detect early warnings and prevent service degradations.
• Track and manage incidents through their lifecycle, ensuring accurate documentation in fault management systems.
• Support incident, problem, and change management processes in compliance with Ericssons Global Service Center (GSC) standards.
• Generate and analyze network performance and health reports, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Participate in shift-based operations to provide round-the-clock network surveillance coverage.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a differenceevery day.
As an ABAP - Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Business Application Consulting team, specializing in SAP Technology. Within our Advisory practice, you will help clients optimize operational efficiency by analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This position offers the opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, while using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
- Managing SAP technology installations, configurations, and administration tasks
- Developing and maintaining SAP products and technologies to optimize operational efficiency
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for software development and customization
- Collaborating with teams to drive business transformation and process improvement initiatives
- Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori for enhanced data visualization and insights generation
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
- Applying strategic technology planning to align SAP solutions with client objectives
- Embracing change and fostering innovation within SAP technology projects
- Mentoring junior team members to enhance their technical skills and professional growth
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
SAP BODS / Data Migration Consultant
Experience: 1-2 yrs | 2-5 yrs | 5-9 yrs | 9-18 yrs
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli, Navi Mumbai
Work Mode: Hybrid

Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and maintain SAP BODS ETL jobs and workflows.
Execute end-to-end data migration activities for SAP implementation and transformation projects.
Perform data extraction, transformation, cleansing, validation, and loading.
Collaborate with business and functional teams to understand migration requirements.
Prepare data mapping documents and migration strategies.
Conduct data reconciliation, mock loads, and migration testing.
Support cutover activities and ensure successful go-live migrations.
Troubleshoot and resolve data migration and ETL-related issues.
Mandatory Skills
SAP BODS (BusinessObjects Data Services)
SAP Data Migration
ETL Development
Data Extraction, Transformation & Loading (ETL)
Data Cleansing & Data Validation
Data Mapping & Reconciliation
SQL
SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA
Migration Testing & Cutover Support
Preferred Skills
SAP S/4HANA Migration
SAP Migration Cockpit
LSMW
Master Data Migration
Transactional Data Migration
Data Quality Management
Note
Hands-on experience in SAP BODS and Data Migration is mandatory.
Candidates with SAP S/4HANA migration project experience are preferred.
Experience in ETL development, data validation, and reconciliation is required.
Candidates with SAP BODS, SAP Data Services, or SAP Migration expertise are eligible.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

This role involves leveraging your skills in Workday Technology to support client needs and drive impactful results. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will have the opportunity to use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. This position offers a chance to deepen your understanding of business contexts and how they are evolving, while also maintaining professional and technical standards.
Responsibilities
- Implementing Workday HCM solutions to support client workforce transformation initiatives
- Collaborating with teams to optimize Workday integration processes and enhance system functionality
- Utilizing Workday Prism Analytics for data analysis and reporting to drive business insights
- Leading Workday projects and managing deliverables to align with strategic technology planning
- Developing Workday Extend applications to automate and streamline business processes
- Engaging in process improvement and optimization to enhance client service delivery
- Applying analytical thinking to solve complex problems and support business transformation efforts
- Embracing change and fostering AI-human collaboration to innovate digital tooling solutions
- Guiding teams in Workday Studio for efficient design automation and reporting tasks
- Building relationships with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions

13996 | AI Specialist / Senior AI Engineer (P4 I)
Location Bangalore & Noida
Experience - 9-14 years

Mandatory Skills
Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, GraphRAG, AI Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Python, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Vector Database, MLOps, LLMOps, Databricks, NLP, Cloud Computing, AI Governance.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Engineer (P4-II) to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), AI application engineering, cloud-native architectures, and MLOps practices.
This role requires hands-on technical leadership, the ability to drive projects independently, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
AI Solution Development
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
Develop Agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent.
Create scalable AI APIs and microservices using Python and modern backend frameworks.
Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms and business applications.
Machine Learning & Data Science
Develop and deploy predictive models using supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
Perform feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
Build NLP, classification, recommendation, forecasting, and anomaly detection solutions.
Implement model monitoring and performance measurement frameworks.
Generative AI & LLM Engineering
Work with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and other foundation models.
Design prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks.
Implement advanced RAG, GraphRAG, memory systems, and agent collaboration patterns.
Fine-tune models when applicable and evaluate model quality, safety, and performance.
Drive Responsible AI practices and governance requirements.
Platform Engineering & MLOps
Design AI deployment pipelines using CI/CD best practices.
Implement MLOps and LLMOps frameworks for model lifecycle management.
Build observability, logging, tracing, and performance monitoring capabilities.
Optimize model costs and infrastructure utilization.
Work with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native deployments.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior AI engineers and data scientists.
Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and reusable AI components.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Key Role Related Areas
Technical Support & Stakeholder Management
SQL, MS Excel & Data Analysis
Product Support & UAT
Process Improvement & Cross-functional Collaboration
Incident Resolution & Troubleshooting
Role Objective
We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer in a techno-functional capacity who has a good understanding of technology and is confident in working with internal stakeholders. The primary responsibility will be aligned to the support of our internal product, ensuring seamless coordination between Technology and Business teams while delivering exceptional operational support.
Role Responsibilities
Product & Technical Support
Serve as a single point of contact between the Technology team and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide day-to-day support for the organization's internal products and resolve functional and technical queries.
Ensure timely resolution of issues while maintaining high service standards.
Business & Stakeholder Collaboration
Support the Business team during the project lifecycle, especially during UAT cycles, by assisting with process and product-related queries.
Work closely with Product and Technology teams to ensure successful implementation of product enhancements.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and project execution.
Analysis & Problem Solving
Utilize SQL and MS Excel to analyze data, troubleshoot issues, and generate insights.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
Stay updated with trending technologies to improve support effectiveness.
Process Improvement
Participate in internal initiatives focused on process improvement, product enhancement, and implementation of best practices.
Recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency and user experience.
Contribute to documentation and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Collaboration & Delivery
Work independently to complete assigned tasks within timelines while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Interface with Product and Technology teams in the development of technology products and service standards.
Support development efforts to maximize business impact and customer satisfaction.
Qualification & Experience
Work Experience (Essential)
0-1 years of experience in Technical Support, Application Support, Product Support, or a techno-functional role.
Experience supporting business applications and working with cross-functional teams.
Exposure to UAT support and stakeholder management is preferred.
Knowledge / Skills (Essential)
Good understanding of SQL and MS Excel.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Good understanding of technology and current industry trends.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Self-starter with a positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Education (Essential)
B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
Good to Have (Desirable)
Exposure to Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Experience with ticketing or project management tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
Basic understanding of APIs and software troubleshooting.
Experience working in a SaaS or Product-based organization.

Description:
SAP BASIS Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Must have experience of computer skills including the use Microsoft office suite, ERP and Engineering BOM systems
Must have experience of using TechData Editing tools in SGML, XML or other format (ADAM Author, PTC Arbortext, Notepad etc.)
Must have experience of using TechData Managing tools (ADAM Manager or other)

About Fractal

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
5-10 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

EXP: 2 TO 10 YEARSLocation: PAN INDIA ETL Testing - Datawarehouse testing , Bigdata testing Skills:Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and data models.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test strategies.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
Perform source-to-target data validation and reconciliation testing.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Verify data quality, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Conduct data warehouse, migration, and reporting validation testing.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and data engineers to resolve data-related issues.
Validate incremental loads, batch jobs, and scheduling processes.
Support end-to-end testing in Data Warehouse and BI environments.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to quality improvement initiatives.
Required Skills
3 to 8 years of experience in ETL Testing and Data Warehouse Testing.
Strong expertise in writing and executing complex SQL Queries.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, SSIS, DataStage, Pentaho, or similar tools.
Experience in validating ETL workflows, mappings, transformations, and data pipelines.
Knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact and Dimension tables.
Experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or Snowflake.
Strong understanding of Data Migration and Data Validation techniques.
Hands-on experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
Understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Big Data Testing using Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or Databricks.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience in testing data lakes and modern data platforms.
Knowledge of automation tools for ETL validation.
Familiarity with BI reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or Business Objects.
Experience with Python or Shell scripting for data validation.

Description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)
Description
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
Responsibilities
Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
Critical Situation management
SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
Data Analytics & System trend analysis
Typical Skills and Background
4+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
ServiceNow ITOM Developer
Experience: 2-6 Years
Location: Pune / Bangalore / Noida/Mumbai
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Developer with 2-6 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITOM modules, particularly Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB.
The candidate will be responsible for developing, configuring, integrating and supporting ITOM solutions to improve infrastructure visibility, service health and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Configure, customize and develop ServiceNow ITOM solutions based on business and technical requirements.
Work on ServiceNow Discovery, including Discovery Schedules, Credentials, MID Server, Discovery Patterns, Probes and Sensors.
Configure and maintain Service Mapping to identify application and infrastructure dependencies.
Work on Event Management, including event ingestion, event rules, alert management, CI binding and event correlation.
Maintain and enhance CMDB, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation.
Work with MID Servers and troubleshoot connectivity, credential and discovery-related issues.
Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and third-party monitoring/infrastructure tools using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB-related issues.
Develop and maintain ServiceNow scripts using JavaScript where required.
Work with infrastructure, network, application and cloud teams to resolve ITOM-related technical issues.
Analyze and resolve issues related to CI discovery, duplicate CIs, incorrect relationships and failed discovery.
Support CMDB data quality, accuracy and governance initiatives.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in knowledge-sharing activities.
Follow ServiceNow development and implementation best practices.
Required Skills
26 years of experience in ServiceNow development/ITOM.
Hands-on experience with one or more ITOM modules, preferably:
Discovery
Service Mapping
Event Management
CMDB
Good understanding of MID Server architecture and configuration.
Knowledge of Discovery Patterns, Probes, Sensors and Discovery Schedules.
Understanding of Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) and CI identification.
Knowledge of CI classes, relationships and CMDB data model.

Description:
Capgemini is hiring for Agentic AI Developer role

Locations: Mumbai/ Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Noida/Gurugram
Work mode: Hybrid
Experience range: 2 years to 6 years
Job Description
We are looking for a Agentic AI Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying intelligent, autonomous AI agents that can plan, reason, and act toward achieving complex goals. This role blends expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and orchestration frameworks to build systems that go beyond static responses enabling dynamic, goal-driven behaviour.
Key responsibilities
Build autonomous agents using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI that can plan, reason, and execute tasks iteratively.
Integrate and fine-tune LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for use in agent workflows, including prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Develop systems where multiple agents collaborate, delegate tasks, and adapt strategies based on real-time feedback.
Enable agents to interact with external systems (e.g., APIs, databases, web apps) to perform actions autonomously.
Use tools like LangSmith, Grafana, and Splunk to monitor agent behavior, performance, and reliability.
Work closely with data scientists, architects, and product teams to align agentic solutions with business goals.
Ensure all solutions are well-documented and comply with data privacy and security standards.
Technical Skills
Languages: Python (mandatory), JavaScript, C# (optional)
Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Hugging Face Transformers
LLMs: GPT-4, GPT- 4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, Gemini
Vector Databases: FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate
Cloud Platforms: Azure (OpenAI, ML Studio), AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI)
DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring Tools: LangSmith, Grafana, Splunk
Other Tools: Streamlit, FastAPI, Flask for UI/API development
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field
213 years of experience in AI/ML development, with at least 12 years in Gen AI or Agentic AI
Strong understanding of autonomous systems, planning algorithms, and multi-agent coordination
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
