Description:
The Opportunity
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency - Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk & Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
In this role we are looking for an experienced SAP FI Senior Consultant to join our growing SAP Finance team. In this role, you will lead and support SAP FI design, configuration, and implementation activities across a range of projects. You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions within the SAP FI landscape
Your Key Responsibilities
The primary function of this position is to work as a team member in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively to the area of SAP FI General Ledger, Accounts Payables, Accounts receivable, Bank Accounting Taxation, and Fixed Assets functionalities with a preferred background in the relevant industry.
The Specialist will work in the implementation of all the above modules as part of the S4HANA Finance Transformation project, ensuring seamless integration with other thirdparty systems.
Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, youll also
You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
Followup on the action items from the workshops
Knowledge of SAP – BPC (Consolidation), Special purpose ledger, SOX, US GAAP, Various of Exits, Background on the Technical and Functional upgrade, Report painter, Report writer etc.
Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
Prior client facing consulting experience.
SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus
What we look for
Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 3-7 years
Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.
SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.
SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
Knowledge on CO-PA & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling).
FI integration with MM, SD, HR & PS.
Excellent business communication skills
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. 
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Description:
Job Summary
The Role: Lead Software Engineer (Data Engineer)
The Team: We are looking for a junior Data Engineer to join our offshore team in India. This role is focused on supporting data onboarding, pipeline support, and basic platform activities. You will work under the guidance of senior team members to assist with routine tasks related to data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-native data platform operations. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suitable for someone starting their career in data engineering or looking to develop core skills in a modern data platform environment leveraging AWS.


Responsibilities

Data Onboarding & Support
Assist in onboarding new data assets to the enterprise platform following established procedures.
Support existing data pipelines by monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing routine maintenance.
Help ensure data quality and consistency during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Follow documented processes and checklists to support data ingestion and transformation tasks.
Support data storage and processing using Amazon S3 as the core cloud storage layer, ensuring data is organized, secure, and accessible.
Support metadata management and data cataloging using AWS Glue Data Catalog to facilitate discoverability and governance.
Assist in implementing data validation, quality checks, and lineage documentation.
Write and maintain Python scripts and Big data processing engines transformations for data ingestion, processing, and automation tasks.


Platform & Pipeline Maintenance
Support the team in maintaining data pipelines, fixing issues, and implementing small enhancements.
Assist with data validation, metadata tagging, and basic lineage documentation.
Help monitor pipeline health and escalate issues as needed.
Support operational activities such as deployment, testing, and routine monitoring.
Contribute to automation of deployment and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.


Collaboration & Documentation
Work with senior engineers to understand platform standards and best practices.
Document onboarding steps, pipeline configurations, and operational procedures.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders about progress and issues.


Operational Support
Participate in production incident response and troubleshooting.
Support routine deployment, testing, and monitoring activities.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing and documentation efforts.


Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data support, or related roles.
Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, and Big data processing engines.
Hands-on experience with programming in Python or similar languages for data processing and automation.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks or similar.
Understanding of data onboarding, data quality, metadata, and lineage concepts.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS IAM, and AWS CloudWatch.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Description:
Job Description: Deal Desk Associate (Offshore)
Role Overview
The Deal Desk Associate serves as the foundational execution engine for daily, high-volume quote-to-order operations. Acting as a critical operational bridge between frontline field sales and the onshore Deal Desk, this role focuses on case triage, administrative execution, system workaround resolution, and standard quote generation.
The primary objective of this role is to eliminate operational friction and scale senior Deal Desk capacity by managing standard and recurring activities as the team evolves into a strategic "Revenue Architecture" engine.
Core Objectives & Impact
Accelerate Transaction Velocity: Drive high throughput and rapid SLAs for routine Deal Desk requests and activities.
Maintain Absolute Data Hygiene: Ensure data accuracy across Salesforce (SFDC) and CPQ systems to eliminate downstream billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition bottlenecks.
Deflect Administrative Drag: Triage incoming cases, enforce self-service engagement for basic queries, and route non-commercial tickets to cross-functional teams.
Enable Strategic Onshore Focus: Handle foundational operational tasks so onshore Deal Desk resources can focus on strategic, complex, nuanced and high dollar value activities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Case Triage, Queue Management & Deflection
Monitor regional Salesforce case queues (AMER, EMEA, or APAC) and apply priority tags to maintain intake governance.
Validate intake completeness (e.g. Custom SKU requests) and clarity of incoming requests before handing them off to onshore Deal Desk teams.
Redirect sellers asking basic operational or "how-to" questions to self-service enablement platforms (e.g., Genie, Assistant, Highspot job aids).
Identify and transfer out-of-scope non-commercial requests (e.g., VAT updates, billing address changes, standard NDAs) directly to Legal or Accounting.
2. Quoting & Administrative Execution
Manage standard "generate paper" requests due to seller system limitations or specific segment use cases (e.g., public sector, WORD for redline requests).
Manually adjust Subscription Orders (SO) and Statements of Work (SOW) to complete data requirements or format to meet customer requirements.
Fulfill and attach standard pre-signed contract exhibits, including DORA, DPA, BAA, Code of Conduct, Security Standards, and Letters of Authorization, within guidelines.
Generate ad-hoc $0 amendment orders for standard policy terms (e.g., Generative AI opt-in agreements).
Support the M.A.C.S. process.
Track Sales Order rejections in coordination with Order Management to resolve data mismatches.
Resolve routine CPQ lockout errors and quote save failures for Sales.
Execute ad-hoc Salesforce user acceptance testing (UAT) on enhancement requests.
Required Skills & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 0-2+ years of experience in business support or order management.
System Proficiency: Hands-on experience or familiarity with enterprise CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and CPQ tools.
Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision in checking data inputs, contract terms, and system configurations.
Process Compliance: Strict adherence to established playbooks, workflows, and escalation protocols.
Communication: Clear, concise communication skills.
Problem-Solving & Coachability: Strong desire to learn, adapt to workflow changes quickly, and take feedback constructively.

Description:
About the opportunity:
Ericsson is seeking an experienced L2 Operations Engineer with deep expertise in the NetCracker BSS suite to support 2nd-level assurance, incident and problem management, system administration, and billing operations. The role requires hands-on technical experience across NetCracker components, UNIX/Linux platforms, signalling protocols and telecom network performance. You will provide production support in a 24/7 environment and act as a primary escalation point for customers.
Core responsibilities:
Own operational health and stability of the production environment; provide proactive monitoring and assurance activities.
Lead technical triage, coordinate investigations, drive incident resolution and perform root-cause analysis across NetCracker components (CRM, Billing, Order Management, etc.).
Manage end-to-end bill run activities (mid-month and month-end), including pre-bill checks, mock bill runs and post-bill validations.
Perform Linux/Unix administration, troubleshoot performance issues, resolve bottlenecks and tune the platform using scripting and database tools.
Coordinate and execute releases, patches and configuration changes with minimal service disruption; validate post-change behavior.
Act as main point of contact for internal teams and clients; build strong relationships with customer IT/business stakeholders and advocate for customer needs.
Maintain runbooks, produce post-incident reports and contribute to process and automation improvements.

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a passionate and skilled Information Security Consultant with hands-on experience in
ISO 27001:2022 implementation and information security audits, particularly in the banking and
finance domain. The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and
demonstrate the ability to manage end-to-end compliance projects.
Key Experience & Skills Required:
Proven experience in the implementation of ISO 27001:2022 for clients, including gap
assessments, risk treatment plans, and ISMS documentation.
Hands-on experience in conducting risk assessments and information security audits onsite
at client location (internal and external).
Experience in comprehensive IS audits specifically within the Banking, Financial Services and
Insurance(BFSI) sector.
Strong background in developing, reviewing, and maintaining information security policies,
procedures, and SOPs.
Familiarity with industry-recognized cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as:
NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
ISO 27001: 2022 standard
RBI CSF, ITGRC, Outsourcing services master directions
IRDAI Cyber Security Guidelines
SEBI CSCRF
UIDAI Guidelines
SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type 1/ Type 2
Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules
Other relevant circulars, guidelines, and regulatory frameworks.
Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly
convey technical information to stakeholders at all levels.• Ability to manage multiple assignments independently while maintaining quality and
timelines.
Ability to prepare detailed Audit checklists and reports as per the scope mentioned for the
project.
Mandatory Certification:
ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification (IRCA CQI Certified) and CISA certification (ISACA).
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage end-to-end implementation of ISO 27001:2022, including scoping, risk
assessments, and creation of ISMS documentation.
Perform risk identification, assessment, and treatment in accordance with ISO 27001 and
organizational context.
Plan and conduct internal audits, external audit, and deliver IT security awareness and
training sessions onsite at client location.
Should have conduct audit based on Banking, Insurance, Aadhaar, SEBI Guidelines onsite at
client location.
Develop and maintain audit checklists, detailed audit reports, and corrective action plans.
Design, review, and update information security policies, procedures, and process-related
documentation in line with applicable standards and business requirements.
Support ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of the Information Security
Management System (ISMS).
Coordinate with stakeholders and clients to ensure timely and effective execution of audit
and compliance tasks

Description:
Job Role: Safety & Security Supervisor
Job Title: Senior Officer / Executive Protection & Privacy
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time
Business: Godrej Living
Location: As per project requirements

About the Role:

This role is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of premises, employees, and visitors. The position involves implementing and maintaining safety protocols, monitoring security operations, conducting inspections, and responding effectively to emergencies to provide a safe and secure environment.

What Impact Will You Create?

Supervise security staff, assign tasks, provide training in daily procedures, first aid, and customer service.
Maintain and update security policies, checklists, and procedural manuals.
Monitor building security systems, fire alarms, and life safety equipment, ensuring compliance with regulations.
Manage manpower records, schedules, and training for on-roll and contract staff.
Conduct physical patrols, access control, and surveillance to safeguard premises and occupants.
Investigate incidents and prepare reports on security events.
Track material movement and manage lost-and-found items.
Communicate regularly with Property Manager, team members, and stakeholders on incidents, staffing, and recommendations.
Approve hiring and interview contract security personnel.
Provide briefings to staff on security and safety protocols.
Coordinate vendor meetings and share minutes of meetings with stakeholders.
Review after-hours reports and monitor performance of security personnel.
Respond promptly during emergencies, coordinating with tenants, medical personnel, and local authorities.
Draft and implement disaster management plans in coordination with management and security SMEs.
Participate in performance and behavior assessments of security staff.
Prepare and manage budgets related to security staffing and operations.

Qualification and Experience

Graduate in any discipline.
Relevant years of experience in security management, preferably within facility management.

Skills Required

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to lead, train, and manage a security team effectively.
Attention to detail and logical problem-solving skills for short- and long-term security planning.
High integrity and reliability in executing assigned responsibilities.

Whats in it for you?

Opportunity to manage safety and security across dynamic living and working environments.
Exposure to end-to-end security operations, emergency management, and compliance.
Collaborative work culture with learning and growth opportunities.
Enhanced Maternity & Paternity support.
No place for discrimination at Godrej Gender-neutral anti-harassment policy
We are selfish about your wellness, hence we offer comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family.
Godrej Way Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business-level achievements Performance-based earning opportunities.

An inclusive Godrej

Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been over a century. Its not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse - especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities - helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognize merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, color, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.

If this sounds like a role for you, apply now! We look forward to meeting you !!

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting Track and analyze partner satisfaction, retention rates, and performance metrics.

Prepare regular dashboards and insights to identify trends and areas for improvement.

Recommend data-driven interventions to improve partner experience and operational outcomes.

Key Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

3–6 years of experience in on-ground partner management, fleet engagement, or delivery operations, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or mobility sectors.

Strong people management and relationship-building skills. Ability to analyze data and drive actionable insights.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to travel locally and work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Description:
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBrokers products and services, and converting leads into successful customers. The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.

Role & responsibilities

Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBrokers plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.

Preferred candidate profile

Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory

About the Company:

NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Summary:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Salesforce QA to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality and functionality of our Salesforce Revenue Cloud implementation by performing thorough testing and validation of various Salesforce features and integrations. This role involves working closely with developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and test accordingly.
Key Responsibilities:
Test Planning and Design:
Collaborate with business analysts and developers to understand functional requirements and create detailed test plans and test cases.
Design and develop test scripts for functional, system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
Test Execution:
Execute test cases and document results for Salesforce applications, integrations and mobile testing 
Identify, document, and track defects and issues using appropriate tools and ensure their resolution.
Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionalities are unaffected by new changes.
Collaboration and Communication:
Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
Provide regular status updates and test results to stakeholders.
Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
Continuous Improvement:
Stay up to date with the latest Salesforce features and updates.
Recommend and implement improvements to the testing process and tools.
Experience:
48 years of overall IT experience with at least 3+ years in Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ & Billing) implementation projects.
Proven experience in Mobile testing(both iOS and Android operating systems).
Understanding of Salesforce platform, including Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Billing, Revenue Cloud, and custom applications.
Hands-on experience in end-to-end Lead-to-Cash process covering quoting, pricing, invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA, Confluence, ADO etc.
Skills:
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Experience working with Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud features and functionalities.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce Revenue Cloud QA - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in delivering client-focused solutions within our Salesforce practice. You will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and develop deliverables that meet client needs. As a Senior Associate, you will navigate ambiguity and use critical thinking to build meaningful client relationships and guide junior team members. You will be responsible for maintaining professional standards and using a broad range of methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on relationship building and managing others, while developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions within the Commercial & Service Excellence network. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.

Description:
The SR DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER will be a key member of the Campaign Analytics team, responsible for transforming marketing intelligence through AI, automation, advanced analytics, and performance insights. This role will drive data-driven decision-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 812 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
AtkinsR alis is one of the world s leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our peoples diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. Its thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us and youll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.
We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic self-starter to join our team as an Assistant Ecology Consultant. This role will be based at our AtkinsR alis office in Bangalore, IN.
Your role
Authoring technical ecological reports.
Analysing bat sound data.
As a proficient user of GIS, supporting with desk studies, scoping sites, records of protected species and biodiversity net gain assessments.
Working to tight timescales and following an approved methodology will be key feature of the role.
Being a team player and delivering responsibilities by meeting deadlines.
Developing your technical skills through Continuing Professional Development.
Managing your own time and workload in collaboration with other team members.
Liaising with the UK team on a daily basis and building a good working relationship.
Managing work enquiries and preparing bids under the guidance of more senior staff.
Carrying out additional ad hoc activities as required by process leads.
About you
A degree in ecology/environmental sciences/environmental engineering.
2-4 years of experience working on ecology projects with experience in the UK region preferred.
Experience in Anabat Insight/ Kaleidoscope.
Proficient GIS skills (QGIS/ArcGIS).
Working knowledge of UKHab classification and the Defra Metric will be preferred.
Proficient ability to interpret, review and analyse data to produce reports.
Understanding of UK and EU Wildlife Legislation, planning policies, and licensing requirements.
Previous experience of working in international projects.
Project management experience including technical, financial and quality assurance aspects.
Membership of the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM).
Highly motivated and proactive, focused on achieving and delivering technical excellence.
Excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills with effective communication abilities.
Strong in report writing, verbal communication, and presentation.
Quick to learn and adapt on the job.
Effective at prioritizing and managing multiple tasks concurrently.
Capable of working independently or as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Logical and organized in project delivery, following senior team members instructions and guidance.
Aware of how delivery time affects financial performance and proactively manages time, resources, and budget.
Able to identify and communicate project or team concerns to the immediate Line Manager.
Open to discussing career goals and aspirations.
Willing to share information and knowledge with team members.
Demonstrates initiative and basic leadership skills to direct a small work group.
Compliant with Health and Safety Policies and Procedures.
Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsR alis
Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.
Worker Type Employee
Job Type Regular
At AtkinsR alis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

We are looking for an experienced SAP Security & GRC professional with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Security, SAP Fiori Security, SAP GRC Access Control, audit compliance, security testing, and SAP BTP Security. The role involves leading role design and authorization management, user access governance, SoD analysis, access reviews, audit support, and security activities for SAP implementations, upgrades, and migration programs.

Key responsibilities include managing SAP security operations, configuring GRC modules (ARA, ARM, EAM, UAR), supporting Fiori and BTP security, driving compliance and access certification activities, leading security testing and cutover support, and collaborating with business, functional, technical, and audit teams. The role also involves mentoring junior consultants and supporting security governance across SAP SaaS applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, SAC, Datasphere, IBP, and Fieldglass.

Description:
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 8–12 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
Role- Individual Contributor
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.
Your role
Key Responsibilities:
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks, Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking
Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Microstation (add on)
BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)
Required Skills Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
About you
Qualification
Graduate Engineers (Bachelor's degree) with up to 3 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record
Desirable Experience
Canada infrastructure or consultancy project experience
Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

The Ivalua Consultant is responsible for the design, implementation, configuration, and management of Ivalua SourcetoPay (S2P) solutions. Depending on the level, the role ranges from execution support and configuration to solution architecture, delivery ownership, and people leadership.
Core Responsibilities (Applies Across Levels)
Implement and support Ivalua S2P modules including:
Sourcing
Supplier Management (SIM)
Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)
ProcuretoPay (P2P)
Invoicing Spend Analysis
Translate procurement and business requirements into Ivalua solutions
Configure forms, workflows, approvals, and business rules
Support integrations with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, others)
Conduct testing (SIT/UAT), cutover, and golive support
Prepare functional documentation and training materials
Ensure adherence to best practices and solution quality standards



Your Profile

Assist in requirement documentation and configuration
Perform basic Ivalua setup and data validation
Execute test cases and defect tracking
Support postgolive activities and issue resolution
Basic understanding of S2P / procurement processes
Exposure to Ivalua platform
Strong documentation and learning aptitude
We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise andstrong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Design integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite.

Description:
Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Consultant
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 5+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..
Role Summary
Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
About Accenture:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions - underpinned by the world's largest delivery network - Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at
About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network - a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit

Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Consultant
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network

Level: Consultant

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..
Role Summary
Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Client Experience & Operations | Smartworks

Role purpose
Maintain consistent operating standards across the city through detailed building rounds, practical supervision and verified closure of service and presentation gaps.

Conduct regular rounds across every building using the common India operating checklist.
Review reception, visitor experience, housekeeping, washrooms, cafeteria service, common areas, basements and parking.
Check signage, lighting, furniture, carpets, walls and overall upkeep; ensure visible defects are addressed.
Review hygiene, odour, pest control, waste handling and availability of essential consumables.
Check frontline grooming, service conduct and vendor deployment against agreed requirements.
Assign corrective actions with Centre Heads, follow up on deadlines and physically verify closure.
Identify repeat gaps, coach site teams and ensure improvements are sustained.
Use client feedback and service complaints to prioritise visits; coordinate technical observations with the City Chief Engineer.
Daily priorities
Review pending complaints and overdue actions; undertake planned building rounds; get immediate gaps corrected; agree owners and deadlines for remaining work; recheck previous closures and update the Regional Head on material exceptions.
Candidate profile
Graduate in Hospitality, Hotel Management, Facilities Management or a related discipline, with approximately 10-12 years of relevant operations experience. Exposure to multiple properties is preferred. Strong attention to detail, practical knowledge of soft services and the ability to drive closure with site teams. Regular travel within the city is required.
